server/AbsenceSummary.luau:
-- Absence accounting consumes actual server executions, never reconnect-price guesses.
-- The market/positions/profiles are saved together in the fenced world checkpoint.
local Absence={}
local function mark(engine,key)
 local b=engine.Books[key];return (b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick
end
-- Use the saved return price, including for summaries created before full P&L was stored.
-- Keep the since-departure deltas for accounting, separate from the displayed trade P&L.
function Absence.WithPnl(engine,summary)
 if not summary then return nil end
 summary.Unrealized=0
 for _,row in ipairs(summary.Rows)do
  row.Unrealized=row.Remaining>0 and (row.CurrentPrice-row.Entry)*row.Remaining*row.Direction*engine.Books[row.Contract].Spec.Multiplier or 0
  summary.Unrealized+=row.Unrealized
 end
 return summary
end
function Absence.Depart(engine,p,now)
 if p.Absence then return end
 local a=engine.Accounts[p.Account];if not a then return end
 p.AbsenceSequence=(p.AbsenceSequence or 0)+1
 local absence={Id=tostring(p.Run)..":"..p.AbsenceSequence,Account=a.Id,At=now,Step=engine.Step,Time=engine.Time,Positions={}}
 for key,pos in pairs(a.Positions)do
  absence.Positions[key]={Id=pos.Id,Contract=key,Direction=pos.Direction,Entry=pos.Entry,Quantity=pos.Quantity,
   DeparturePrice=mark(engine,key),Multiplier=engine.Books[key].Spec.Multiplier,Closed=0,Realized=0,RealizedChange=0,Exits={}}
 end
 p.Absence=absence
end
function Absence.Closed(p,row)
 local absence=p.Absence
 local item=absence and absence.Positions[row.Contract]
 if not item or row.PositionId~=item.Id or row.TradeId<=(item.LastTradeId or 0)then return end
 item.LastTradeId=row.TradeId
 item.Closed+=row.Quantity;item.Realized+=row.Pnl
 item.RealizedChange+=(row.Exit-item.DeparturePrice)*row.Quantity*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
 local reason=row.Reason or "Trade"
 local exit=item.Exits[reason] or {Reason=reason,Quantity=0,Realized=0,Change=0,Notional=0}
 exit.Quantity+=row.Quantity;exit.Realized+=row.Pnl;exit.Change+=(row.Exit-item.DeparturePrice)*row.Quantity*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
 exit.Notional+=row.Exit*row.Quantity;item.Exits[reason]=exit
end
function Absence.Return(engine,p,now)
 local absence=p.Absence;if not absence then return end
 p.Absence=nil
 if absence.Account~=p.Account or not next(absence.Positions)then return end
 local a=engine.Accounts[p.Account]
 local summary={Id=absence.Id,Seconds=math.max(0,now-absence.At),MarketSeconds=math.max(0,engine.Time-absence.Time),
  Realized=0,RealizedChange=0,UnrealizedChange=0,Rows={},
  Coverage="Exits use actual exchange trades while the server runs. The market pauses when no server is running; no missing prices or outcomes are invented."}
 local ordered={};for key in pairs(absence.Positions)do table.insert(ordered,key)end;table.sort(ordered)
 for _,key in ipairs(ordered)do
  local item=absence.Positions[key];local held=a.Positions[key]
  local remaining=held and held.Id==item.Id and held.Quantity or 0
  local current=mark(engine,key)
  local delta=(current-item.DeparturePrice)*remaining*item.Direction*item.Multiplier
  local exits={};for _,exit in pairs(item.Exits)do table.insert(exits,exit)end
  table.sort(exits,function(x,y)return x.Reason<y.Reason end)
  table.insert(summary.Rows,{Contract=key,Direction=item.Direction,Quantity=item.Quantity,Remaining=remaining,
   Entry=item.Entry,DeparturePrice=item.DeparturePrice,CurrentPrice=current,Realized=item.Realized,
   RealizedChange=item.RealizedChange,UnrealizedChange=delta,Exits=exits})
  summary.Realized+=item.Realized;summary.RealizedChange+=item.RealizedChange;summary.UnrealizedChange+=delta
 end
 summary.Total=summary.RealizedChange+summary.UnrealizedChange
 summary.CarriedIn=summary.Realized-summary.RealizedChange
 p.AwaySummary=Absence.WithPnl(engine,summary)
end
function Absence.Acknowledge(p,id)
 if p.AwaySummary and p.AwaySummary.Id==id then p.AwaySummary=nil;p.LastAwaySummary=id;return true end
 return p.LastAwaySummary==id
end
return Absence
server/AccountUpgradeTests.luau:
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local CP=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local T=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
local Tools=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ChartTools)
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Tests={}
local function fresh()
 local e=E.new(C,712);local f=F.new(e,L,C);f:Join("101");return e,f,e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
end
local function restore(e)
 local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(712),Agents={}},P)
 local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),C)
 return r,F.new(r,L,C)
end
local function open(e,a,side,qty)
 assert(T.Submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Type="Market",Quantity=qty or 1,Direction=side}))
 return a.Positions.BX
end
local function printPrice(e,price)
 local n="print:"..e.NextOrder;local b=e.Books.BX
 e:AddAccount(n,1e9,1e6,.99,false)
 T.Offer(e,"BX",-1,1,price)
 assert(e:Submit(n,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
 assert(b.Last*b.Spec.Tick==price,"Fixture did not execute the requested price")
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,err=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(err)})end
 test("Legacy earned awards receive the current permanent bonus once",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  p.Awards.FirstWin={At=1,Title="Green Spark",Goal=25};p.Awards.Trades5={At=2,Title="Tape Reader",Goal=100}
  f:Evaluate("101",true);assert(f:StartingBalance(p)==22500 and a.Balance==10000)
  for _=1,3 do f:Evaluate("101",true);f:Join("101")end
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(f:StartingBalance(p)==22500)
  assert(p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus==5000 and p.Awards.Trades5.StartingBonus==7500)
 end)
 test("Saved bonuses increase on reload, never stack or shrink, and fund the next reset",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  for _,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do p.Awards[m.Id]={At=1,Title=m.Title,Goal=m.Goal,StartingBonus=m.StartingBonus/10}end
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");a=e.Accounts[p.Account]
  local view=f:View("101");assert(view.StartingBonus==250000 and view.StartingBalance==260000)
  assert(a.Balance==10000 and f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==0)
  for i,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do assert(view.Milestones[i].Earned and view.Milestones[i].StartingBonus==m.StartingBonus)end
  local revision=p.Revision
  for _=1,3 do assert(#f:Evaluate("101",true)==0);f:Join("101")end
  assert(p.Revision==revision and f:StartingBalance(p)==260000)
  -- A later lower tuning must preserve an already-earned larger reward.
  p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus=6000
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(p.Awards.FirstWin.StartingBonus==6000 and f:StartingBalance(p)==261000)
  assert(f:ResetAccount("101",p.Account));assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==261000)
  assert(f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==0);e:Audit()
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==261000 and f:StartingBalance(p)==261000);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Reset liquidates both directions, cancels pending entries and records closed trades",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101");local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   held.Stop=held.Entry-side*2;held.Target=held.Entry+side*4
   assert(e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BT",Type="Limit",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Price=C.Contracts.BT.Last-100}))
   table.insert(e.PendingStops,{Owner=a.Id,Contract="BX",Position=held.Id})
   f:Depart("101",100);local id=a.Id;local trades=e.NextTrade
   T.Offer(e,"BX",side,2,held.Entry)
   assert(f:ResetAccount("101",id));assert(not f:ResetAccount("101",id))
   local nextA=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")];assert(nextA.Balance==10000 and not next(nextA.Positions)and not next(nextA.OpenOrders))
   assert(e.NextTrade>trades and f:Earned(p)==0 and f:_counts(p)==1 and not next(p.Awards))
   assert(not p.Absence and not p.AwaySummary)
   e:ProcessStops();e:AdvanceClock(.25);e:Audit()
   e,f=restore(e);assert(not next(e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")].Positions));assert(f:_counts(f:Profile("101"))==1);e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Earned balance and permanent rank survive healthy resets; reset tokens and ownership are enforced",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local p=f:Profile("101")
  p.Awards.FirstWin={StartingBonus=500};p.RankId="Apprentice";f:Evaluate("101",true)
  assert(not f:ResetAccount("101","player:other:single:1"))
  for _=1,L.ResetLimits.Burst do local id=p.Account;assert(f:ResetAccount("101",id));assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==15000 and p.RankId=="Apprentice")end
  assert(not f:ResetAccount("101",p.Account));e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Open positions remain open; gains before disconnect are excluded; summary acknowledgment persists",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+2);f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false)
  printPrice(e,entry+3);e:AdvanceClock(.25);f:Return("101",160)
  local p=f:Profile("101");local summary=p.AwaySummary
  assert(a.Positions.BX and summary.Seconds==60 and summary.Realized==0 and summary.UnrealizedChange==50 and summary.Total==50)
  assert(summary.Unrealized==150 and summary.Rows[1].Unrealized==150 and f:View("101").AwaySummary.Unrealized==150)
  local id=summary.Id;f:Return("101",170);assert(p.AwaySummary.Id==id)
  assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",id));assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",id))
  e,f=restore(e);assert(not f:Profile("101").AwaySummary);e:Audit()
 end)
 for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
  test((side==1 and "Long"or "Short").." offline "..field.." latches from executed history and settles once",function()
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2);local entry=held.Entry
   local threshold=entry+(field=="Stop"and -side or side)*4;held[field]=threshold
   printPrice(e,entry+side);f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false)
   printPrice(e,threshold)
   assert(held.Triggered==(field=="Stop"and "Stop loss"or "Take profit"))
   -- Real executable counterparties fill the protective reduction.
   T.Offer(e,"BX",side,2,threshold);e:ProcessStops()
   assert(not a.Positions.BX,"Protection must close against offered liquidity")
   printPrice(e,entry);e:ProcessStops()
   local count=f:_counts(f:Profile("101"));assert(count==1)
   e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",200)
   local p=f:Profile("101");local summary=p.AwaySummary
   assert(summary and #summary.Rows[1].Exits==1 and summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Reason==(field=="Stop"and "Stop loss"or "Take profit"))
   assert(summary.RealizedChange==(threshold-entry-side)*side*2*50 and summary.UnrealizedChange==0)
   assert(summary.Realized==(threshold-entry)*side*2*50 and summary.Unrealized==0)
   assert(summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Realized==summary.Realized)
   e:ProcessStops();assert(f:_counts(p)==count);e:Audit()
  end)
 end end
 test("Liquidation while absent uses an intervening execution, not recovered reconnect price",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,5);local entry=held.Entry
  f:Depart("101",100);e:SetConnected(a.Id,false);printPrice(e,entry-40)
  assert(a.Depleted and held.Triggered=="Account depleted")
  T.Offer(e,"BX",1,5,entry-40);e:ProcessStops();printPrice(e,entry)
  f:Return("101",200);local summary=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary
  assert(summary.Total==-10000 and summary.Rows[1].Exits[1].Reason=="Account depleted");e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Partial offline exits split carried-in, realized change and remaining unrealized change",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,2);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+2);f:Depart("101",100)
  assert(T.Submit(e,a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}))
  printPrice(e,entry+3);f:Return("101",140);local s=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary
  assert(s.Realized==100 and s.CarriedIn==100 and s.RealizedChange==0 and s.UnrealizedChange==50 and s.Total==50)
  assert(s.Unrealized==150 and s.Realized+s.Unrealized==250)
  assert(s.Rows[1].Remaining==1);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Paused returns show full entry P&L for long and short gains and losses",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,move in ipairs({-8,8})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   printPrice(e,held.Entry+move);local expected=e:Summary(a).Unrealized
   f:Depart("101",100);e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",200)
   local summary=f:View("101").AwaySummary
   assert(expected==move*side*2*50 and summary.Unrealized==expected)
   assert(summary.Total==0 and summary.Realized==0 and summary.MarketSeconds==0)
   e:Audit()
  end end
 end)
 test("Older saved summaries recover full P&L from their return price without changing with live quotes",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,1,2);local entry=held.Entry
  printPrice(e,entry+8);f:Depart("101",100);f:Return("101",200)
  local p=f:Profile("101");p.AwaySummary.Unrealized=nil;p.AwaySummary.Rows[1].Unrealized=nil
  e,f=restore(e);p=f:Profile("101");printPrice(e,entry+10)
  local summary=f:View("101").AwaySummary
  assert(summary.Unrealized==800 and summary.Rows[1].Unrealized==800 and summary.Total==0)
  assert(f:View("101").Open==1000 and p.AwaySummary.Unrealized==nil and p.AwaySummary.Rows[1].Unrealized==nil)
  assert(f:AcknowledgeAway("101",summary.Id));assert(not f:View("101").AwaySummary);e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Price-history absence never creates returns while simulation is paused",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();open(e,a,-1);f:Depart("101",100);e,f=restore(e);f:Return("101",86400)
  local s=f:Profile("101").AwaySummary;assert(s.MarketSeconds==0 and s.Total==0 and s.Rows[1].Remaining==1 and #s.Rows[1].Exits==0)
 end)
 test("Drag-created SL/TP validates both directions, stale quantities, wrong sides and duplicates",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
   local e,f,a=fresh();local held=open(e,a,side,2)
   for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
    local price=held.Entry+(field=="Stop"and -side or side)*2
    local req={Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection=field,Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=2,Price=price}
    assert(e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req))
   end
   assert(held.Stop and held.Target)
   e:CancelProtection(a.Id,held.Id,"Stop")
   local req={Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection="Stop",Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=1,Price=held.Entry-side*2}
   assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));req.ExpectedQuantity=2;req.Price=held.Entry+side*2;assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req))
   req.Price=0/0;assert(not e:AmendProtection(a.Id,req));e:Audit()
  end
 end)
 test("Soft magnet chooses nearest OHLC, holds near ties and releases at different zoom levels",function()
  local c={Time=100,Open=100,Close=104,High=108,Low=96}
  for _,scale in ipairs({1,4,20})do
   local function y(p)return (110-p)*scale end
   local hit=Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)+.5);assert(hit and hit.Field=="High")
   assert(Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.Low)+.5).Field=="Low")
   assert(Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)-9,hit).Field=="High")
   assert(not Tools.SoftSnap(c,y,y(c.High)-12,hit))
  end
  assert(Tools.ProtectionField(1,100,99)=="Stop" and Tools.ProtectionField(1,100,101)=="Target")
  assert(Tools.ProtectionField(-1,100,99)=="Target" and Tools.ProtectionField(-1,100,101)=="Stop")
 end)
 test("Leaderboard projects raw account balance without changing negative accounting",function()
  local e,f,a=fresh();a.Balance=-125;a.Realized=a.Balance-a.Base;a.Stats.UntrackedNet=a.Realized;a.Stats.Trades=1;a.Stats.Losses=1
  assert(Ranking.Row(f,"101").Cents==-12500 and a.Balance==-125)
 end)
 test("Reset confirmation keeps its original run token after a lost response",function()
  local M=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketClient);local session=M.New(nil,true)
  session.Preview=false;session.CanTrade=true;session.AccountToken="new-run"
  local captured;session.Remote={FireServer=function(_,request)captured=request end}
  assert(session:ResetAccount("confirmed-old-run"));assert(captured.ExpectedAccount=="confirmed-old-run")
  session:Destroy()
 end)
 return rows
end
return Tests
server/AmountInputTests.luau:
local Parse=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.NumberInput).Parse
local Protection=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.TradeProtection)
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local Progression=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local L=require(script.Parent.TestLiquidity)
local Tests={}
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,err=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(err)})end
 test("Plain, currency and decimal shorthand parse without losing magnitude",function()
  for text,expected in pairs({["145"]=145,["145000"]=145000,["145k"]=145000,["145m"]=145000000,
   ["145.4k"]=145400,["145.4M"]=145400000,["145K"]=145000,["  $145,000.25  "]=145000.25,
   ["$145.4 K"]=145400,[".5m"]=500000,["0.001k"]=1,["1b"]=1e9,[".001T"]=1e9,
   ["1,234.56k"]=1234560,["0"]=0,["-1k"]=-1000,["+2k"]=2000})do
   assert(Parse(text)==expected,text.." parsed incorrectly")
  end
 end)
 test("Malformed, ambiguous and nonfinite numeric text is rejected",function()
  for _,text in ipairs({""," ","$",".","k","145kk","145km","145q","145.4.5k","1e6","nan","inf",
   "1$45","1,45k","1,,000","1234,000","1 45k","145k extra",string.rep("9",400).."m"})do
   assert(Parse(text)==nil,"Accepted "..text)
  end
  assert(Parse(145)==nil and Parse({})==nil)
 end)
 test("Large preferences save without quantity-dependent clamping",function()
  local e=E.new(C,901);local f=F.new(e,Progression,C);f:Join("amount-input")
  for _,text in ipairs({"145000","145k","145m","145.4k","1b"})do
   local n=Parse(text);local prefs={StopOn=true,TargetOn=true,StopDollars=n,TargetDollars=n}
   assert(f:SetProtectionPreferences("amount-input",prefs))
   assert(Protection.SamePreferences(prefs,f:View("amount-input").ProtectionPreferences))
  end
 end)
 for _,key in ipairs(C.ContractOrder)do for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
  test(key.." "..side..": large dollar stops reach filled positions",function()
   local spec=C.Contracts[key]
   for _,text in ipairs({"145000","145k","145m","145.4k","1b"})do
    local e=E.new(C,902);local a=e:AddAccount("amount-input",1e9,1000000,.9,true)
    local n=Parse(text);local resolved=assert(Protection.Resolve(spec,1,n,spec.Last,side,"Stop"))
    local ok,result=L.Submit(e,a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=n})
    assert(ok,tostring(result));local p=assert(a.Positions[key]);assert(p.Stop==resolved.Price)
    assert(math.abs((p.Entry-p.Stop)*side*spec.Multiplier-n)<=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier/2+.001)
    e:Audit()
   end
  end)
  test(key.." "..side..": far targets and raw ticks are accepted without the old cap",function()
   local e=E.new(C,903);local a=e:AddAccount("amount-input",1e9,1000000,.9,true)
   local price=C.Contracts[key].Last-side*10*C.Contracts[key].Tick
   local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price,TargetDollars=145e6})
   assert(ok,tostring(result));assert(e.Orders[result.Id].TargetTicks==Protection.Resolve(C.Contracts[key],1,145e6).Ticks)
   assert(e:Cancel(a.Id,result.Id))
   ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=price,StopTicks=10001})
   assert(ok,tostring(result));e:Audit()
  end)
 end end
 test("Protection amount and raw tick bounds reject invalid requests atomically",function()
  local e=E.new(C,904);local a=e:AddAccount("amount-input",1e9,1000000,.9,true)
  for _,value in ipairs({0,-1,.001,1e9+.01,math.huge,0/0,"145k"})do
   assert(not Protection.Resolve(C.Contracts.BX,1,value))
   assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=value}))
  end
  for _,value in ipairs({0,-1,1.5,math.huge,0/0,Protection.MaximumTicks(C.Contracts.BX,1)+1})do
   assert(not e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopTicks=value}))
  end
  assert(not next(a.Positions)and not next(a.OpenOrders));e:Audit()
 end)
 return rows
end
return Tests
server/BotExitRetry.luau:
-- Derived liquidity checks are shared by blocked bot exits. Actual fills still go
-- through Submit, including ownership, reduce-only, capacity and price safeguards.
local Policy=require(script.Parent.PlayerExecution)
local Retry={}
local function revision(book)return book.ExitLiquidityRevision or 0 end
local function liquidity(e,b,side)
 e.BotExitLiquidity=e.BotExitLiquidity or {}
 local key=b.Key..":"..side;local cached=e.BotExitLiquidity[key]
 if cached and cached.Step==e.Step and cached.Revision==revision(b) and cached.Eligibility==e.EligibilityRevision and cached.Fair==b.FairReference then return cached.Available end
 local available=false
 for _,level in ipairs(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)do
  if not Policy.Allows(e,b,level.Price,side)then break end
  for _,o in ipairs(level.Orders)do
   local a=e.Accounts[o.Owner]
   if a and e:_available(o,true)>0 then available=true;break end
  end
  if available then break end
 end
 e.BotExitLiquidity[key]={Step=e.Step,Revision=revision(b),Eligibility=e.EligibilityRevision,Fair=b.FairReference,Available=available}
 return available
end
local function remember(e,b,p,attempted)
 local prior=p.BotExitRetry
 p.BotExitRetry={At=e.Time+(e.Config.BotExitRetrySeconds or 4),Revision=revision(b),Eligibility=e.EligibilityRevision,Fair=b.FairReference,
  Reason=p.Triggered,AttemptStep=attempted and e.Step or prior and prior.AttemptStep}
end
function Retry.Ready(e,a,key,p)
 if a.Player or p.Triggered=="Take profit"then return true end

-- Passive, finite liquidity. Risk is funded by existing equity, never a cash top-up.
local Liquidity={}
local Signals=require(script.Parent.BotSignals)
function Liquidity.Protect(population,a)
 local e=population.Engine;local account=e.Accounts[a.Id];local p=account.Positions[a.Key]
 if not p or p.Triggered then return false end
 local c=population.Config.BotLiquidity;local b=e.Books[a.Key]
 local ticks=math.max(c.MinStopTicks,math.min(a.Stop,c.MaxStopTicks))
 local stop=math.max(1,math.round(p.Entry/b.Spec.Tick)-p.Direction*ticks)*b.Spec.Tick
 -- Adopt legacy inventory on its next decision; never move an existing stop farther away.
 if not p.Stop or (stop-p.Stop)*p.Direction>0 then p.Stop=stop;account.Revision+=1 end
 return ((b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick-p.Stop)*p.Direction<=0
end
function Liquidity.Limit(population,a)
 local c=population.Config.BotLiquidity
 local e=population.Engine;local account=e.Accounts[a.Id];local b=e.Books[a.Key]
 local equity=e:Summary(account).Equity
 if equity<=a.Budget*(1-c.MaxDrawdown)then return 0 end
 local stop=math.max(c.MinStopTicks,math.min(a.Stop,c.MaxStopTicks))
 return math.max(0,math.min(a.Limit,account.Limit,c.MaxInventory,
  math.floor(equity*account.Risk*c.MarginFraction/b.Spec.Margin),
  math.floor(equity*c.PositionRiskFraction/(stop*b.Spec.Tick*b.Spec.Multiplier))))
end
function Liquidity.Step(population,a)
 population:_publicInformation(a)
 local e=population.Engine;local c=population.Config.BotLiquidity;local b=e.Books[a.Key]
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id];local p=account.Positions[a.Key]
 if account.Locked or account.Liquidating or b.Spec.CloseOnly or p and p.Triggered then return end
 if a.LiquidityPolicy~=c.Version then
  -- Old random entry orders must not survive adoption. Preserve reduce-only exits.
  local ids={};for id in pairs(account.OpenOrders)do
   if not e.Orders[id].ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end
  end
  table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
  a.LiquidityQuotes={};a.LiquidityPolicy=c.Version
 end
 local limit=Liquidity.Limit(population,a);if limit<1 then return end
 -- Reading the same executable depth as players does not require a full-book prune.
 local quote=Signals.Quote(population,a.Key);local bid,ask=quote.Bid,quote.Ask
 if not bid or not ask then
  for _,id in pairs(a.LiquidityQuotes)do if e.Orders[id]then e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end end
  a.LiquidityQuotes={};return
 end
 local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local half=math.max(c.MinHalfSpreadTicks,math.ceil(b.Volatility*c.VolatilitySpread))
 -- Ordinary liquidity traders use the same visible midpoint as players.
 local center=quote.Value-inventory/limit*half
 for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
  local slot=tostring(side)
  local tick=side==1 and math.min(bid,math.floor(center-half))or math.max(ask,math.ceil(center+half))
  tick=math.max(1,tick)
  local reducing=p~=nil and side==-p.Direction
  -- A small uninformed supplier must not pyramid into adverse fills. Work its exit first.
  local size=reducing and math.min(a.Size,p.Quantity)or(p and 0 or math.min(c.EntryContracts,a.Size,limit))
  local held=a.LiquidityQuotes[slot]and e.Orders[a.LiquidityQuotes[slot]]
  if held and (size==0 or held.ReduceOnly~=reducing or held.Remaining>size or math.abs(held.Price-tick)>=c.RepriceTicks)then
   e:Cancel(a.Id,held.Id);held=nil
  end
  if not held and size>0 then
   if not reducing then size=population:_fit(a,side,size)end
   if size>0 then
    local request={Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type='Limit',Price=tick*b.Spec.Tick,
     ReduceOnly=reducing,Expires=e.Time+c.QuoteSeconds}
    if not reducing then request.StopTicks=math.max(c.MinStopTicks,math.min(a.Stop,c.MaxStopTicks))end
    local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,request)
    if ok and result.Remaining>0 then a.LiquidityQuotes[slot]=result.Id else a.LiquidityQuotes[slot]=nil end
   end
  end
 end
end
return Liquidity

-- Public-price Momentum only. All durable state is on agents/Markets; no wall clocks,
-- hidden values, private loops, synthetic fills, funding writes, or shared RNG draws.
local M={}
local function random(state)
 state.RandomState=state.RandomState*48271%2147483647
 return state.RandomState/2147483647
end
local function range(state,limits)return limits[1]+(limits[2]-limits[1])*random(state)end
local function seed(id,world)
 local n=math.floor(math.abs(world or 1))%2147483646+1
 for i=1,#id do n=(n*31+string.byte(id,i))%2147483646 end
 return n+1
end
function M.Enabled(p,a)
 return a.Kind=='Momentum' and p.Config.BotMomentum~=nil and p.Config.BotPopulation~=nil and a.PolicyVersion~=nil
end
function M.Sample(p,key)
 local c=p.Config.BotMomentum;if not c then return end
 local e=p.Engine;local b=e.Books[key];if b.Spec.CloseOnly then return end
 local market=p.Markets[key];local h=market.MomentumHistory or {};market.MomentumHistory=h
 if #h>0 and e.Time-h[#h].Time<c.SampleSeconds then return end

 for i=first+1,#h do local d=h[i].Price-h[i-1].Price;sum2+=d*d;n+=1 end

-- Persistent, funded inventory objectives. This module only submits real orders.
-- State lives on each participant and is included in world checkpoints.
local Pressure={}

function Pressure.Enabled(p,a)
 local c=p.Config.BotOrderFlow
 return c and p.Config.BotPopulation and a.PolicyVersion and c.Kinds[a.Kind]==true
end
local function cancelEntries(e,a)
 local ids={}
 for id in pairs(e.Accounts[a.Id].OpenOrders)do
  local o=e.Orders[id]
  if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end
 end
 table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
end
function Pressure.Step(p,a)
 if Whale.Enabled(p,a)then Whale.Step(p,a);return end
 if Momentum.Enabled(p,a)then Momentum.Step(p,a);return end
 local e,r,c=p.Engine,p.Random,p.Config.BotOrderFlow
 local b,ac=e.Books[a.Key],e.Accounts[a.Id]
 if not Pressure.Enabled(p,a)then return end
 if a.OrderFlowPolicy~=c.Version then
  cancelEntries(e,a)
  a.OrderObjective=nil;a.FlowCooldownUntil=nil
  a.FlowPositionId=ac.Positions[a.Key]and ac.Positions[a.Key].Id
  a.OrderFlowPolicy=c.Version
  a.FlowNextDecision=e.Time+r:Range(c.StartDelay[1],c.StartDelay[2])
  return
 end
 if a.FlowCooldownUntil and e.Time<a.FlowCooldownUntil then
  a.FlowNextDecision=a.FlowCooldownUntil;return
 end
 a.FlowCooldownUntil=nil
 a.FlowNextDecision=e.Time+r:Range(c.SliceSeconds[1],c.SliceSeconds[2])
 if b.Spec.CloseOnly or a.Retiring or ac.Locked or ac.Liquidating then return end
 local position=ac.Positions[a.Key]
 if position and position.Triggered then return end
 -- A stopped/externally closed position ends its mandate; do not keep buying it back.
 if a.FlowPositionId and (not position or position.Id~=a.FlowPositionId)then
  a.OrderObjective=nil;a.FlowPositionId=position and position.Id
  a.FlowNextDecision=e.Time+r:Range(c.StopPauseSeconds[1],c.StopPauseSeconds[2])
  a.FlowCooldownUntil=a.FlowNextDecision
  return
 end
 local inventory=position and position.Quantity*position.Direction or 0
 local equity=e:Summary(ac).Equity
 local capacity=math.max(0,math.min(a.Limit,ac.Limit,
  math.floor(equity*ac.Risk*p.Config.BotPopulation.MarginFraction/b.Spec.Margin)))
 local stressed=equity<=a.Budget*(1-c.MaxDrawdown)
 local objective=a.OrderObjective
 if objective and e.Time>=objective.ExpiresAt then
  a.OrderObjective=nil
  a.FlowNextDecision=e.Time+r:Range(c.PauseSeconds[1],c.PauseSeconds[2])
  a.FlowCooldownUntil=a.FlowNextDecision
  return
 end
 if not objective then
  local side=r:Next()<.5 and 1 or -1
  -- Investors may follow an already observed move; independent mandates have no shared direction.
  local history=p.Markets[a.Key].SignalHistory or {}
  local previous
  for i=#history,1,-1 do
   if history[i].Time<=e.Time-c.LookbackSeconds then previous=history[i].Price;break end
  end
  local move=previous and (b.Last or b.Reference)-previous or 0
  if a.Kind=='Momentum' and math.abs(move)>=c.FollowMoveTicks and r:Next()<c.FollowProbability then side=move>0 and 1 or -1 end
  local fraction=r:Range(c.TargetFraction[1],c.TargetFraction[2])
  objective={Target=stressed and 0 or side*math.floor(capacity*fraction),
   ExpiresAt=e.Time+r:Range(c.DurationSeconds[1],c.DurationSeconds[2]),StartedAt=e.Time,Filled=0}
  objective.PlannedQuantity=math.abs(objective.Target-inventory)
  a.OrderObjective=objective
 end
 local target=stressed and 0 or math.clamp(objective.Target,-capacity,capacity)
 local delta=target-inventory
 if delta==0 then
  -- Hold the completed mandate until its deadline instead of immediately flipping it.
  return
 end
 local side=delta>0 and 1 or -1
 local reducing=position~=nil and side==-position.Direction
 local slice=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*r:Range(c.SliceFraction[1],c.SliceFraction[2])))
 local size=math.min(math.abs(delta),slice)
 if objective.PlannedQuantity and not stressed then
  -- Spread the finite mandate over its lifetime. Only real fills advance this budget.
  local progress=math.clamp((e.Time-objective.StartedAt+c.SliceSeconds[2])/
   math.max(c.SliceSeconds[2],objective.ExpiresAt-objective.StartedAt),0,1)
  local due=math.ceil(objective.PlannedQuantity*progress)
  size=math.min(size,math.max(0,due-objective.Filled))
 end
 -- Finish the existing position before opening its opposite; never reverse a reduce-only exit.
 if reducing then size=math.min(size,position.Quantity)
 else size=p:_fit(a,side,size)end
 if size<1 then return end
 local bid,ask=e:PublicPrices(a.Key)
 local touch=side==1 and ask or bid
 if not touch then return end
 local tick=math.round(touch/b.Spec.Tick)+side*c.MaxSlippageTicks
 local request={Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type='Limit',
  Price=math.max(1,tick)*b.Spec.Tick,ReduceOnly=reducing,Expires=e.Time+c.SliceSeconds[1]}
 if not reducing then request.StopTicks=a.Stop end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,request)
 if ok then
  objective.Filled+=result.Filled
  local held=ac.Positions[a.Key];a.FlowPositionId=held and held.Id
  -- IOC-style child: an unfilled slice cannot outlive its objective or reserve duplicate risk.
  if e.Orders[result.Id]then e:Cancel(a.Id,result.Id)end
 end
end
return Pressure

-- Participation health and zero-sum capital recycling between simulated bots.
-- Recovery never edits price, inventory, trading P&L or player accounts.
local H={}
local Retry=require(script.Parent.BotExitRetry)
local function enabled(e,a,ac)
 return e.Config.BotParticipation and e.Config.BotPopulation and a.Budget and not a.Retiring and not a.Retired
  and not e.Books[a.Key].Spec.CloseOnly and not ac.Player and not ac.House and not ac.Archive
end
local function stagger(id,span)
 local hash=0;for i=1,#id do hash=(hash*31+string.byte(id,i))%65521 end
 return hash%math.max(1,span)
end
function H.Risk(e,a,summary)
 local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local c=e.Config.BotParticipation
 if not enabled(e,a,ac)then return nil end
 local equity=summary.Equity;local margin=e.Books[a.Key].Spec.Margin
 if equity<=0 or math.floor(equity*ac.Risk*e.Config.BotPopulation.MarginFraction/margin)<1 then return 'Underfunded' end
 local drawdown=c.MaxDrawdown
 if a.Kind=='Liquidity'and e.Config.BotLiquidity then drawdown=e.Config.BotLiquidity.MaxDrawdown
 elseif e.Config.BotOrderFlow and e.Config.BotOrderFlow.Kinds[a.Kind]then drawdown=e.Config.BotOrderFlow.MaxDrawdown end
 if equity<=a.Budget*(1-drawdown)then return 'Risk paused' end
 return nil
end
function H.Inspect(e,a,summary)
 local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local c=e.Config.BotParticipation or {}
 local recent=ac.LastBotFillAt~=nil and e.Time-ac.LastBotFillAt<=(c.RecentSeconds or 300)
 local quoting=false
 for id in pairs(ac.OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id]
  if o and not o.ReduceOnly and not o.Queued and o.Type=='Limit'and e:_available(o,true)>0 then quoting=true;break end
 end
 local state
 if a.Retiring or a.Retired or e.Books[a.Key].Spec.CloseOnly then state='Retired'
 else
  state=H.Risk(e,a,summary)
  if not state and a.RecoveryReadyAt then state='Recovering' end
  if not state and (ac.Locked or ac.Liquidating)then state='Risk paused' end
  if not state and ((a.FlowCooldownUntil or 0)>e.Time or (a.ReadyAt or 0)>e.Time or (a.ParticipationResumeAt or 0)>e.Time)then state='Cooldown' end
  if not state then state=recent and 'Trading' or quoting and 'Quoting' or next(ac.Positions)and 'Holding' or 'Waiting' end
 end
 local eligible=state=='Trading'or state=='Quoting'or state=='Holding'or state=='Waiting'
 return state,recent,quoting,eligible
end
function H.Step(p,a)
 local e=p.Engine;local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local c=e.Config.BotParticipation
 if not enabled(e,a,ac)then return false end
 local risk=H.Risk(e,a,e:Summary(ac))
 if risk and not a.RecoveryReadyAt then
  a.RecoveryReadyAt=e.Time+c.CooldownSeconds+stagger(a.Id,c.StaggerSeconds)
  a.OrderObjective=nil;a.FlowPositionId=nil;a.FlowCooldownUntil=nil
 end
 if not a.RecoveryReadyAt then return (a.ParticipationResumeAt or 0)>e.Time end
 -- Withdraw only entries. Stops and working reduce-only exits keep their authority.
 local ids={};for id in pairs(ac.OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id];if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end end
 table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
 for _,key in ipairs(e.Config.ContractOrder)do local pos=ac.Positions[key]
  if pos and not pos.Triggered and not pos.ExitOrder and Retry.Ready(e,ac,key,pos)then
   local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=-pos.Direction,Quantity=math.min(pos.Quantity,c.ExitSliceContracts,a.Size),Type='Market',ReduceOnly=true})
   if not ok or result.Filled==0 then Retry.Attempted(e,ac,key,pos)end
  end
 end
 return true
end
local function adjust(e,ac,amount)
 ac.StartingCapital=ac.StartingCapital or ac.Base
 ac.NetCapitalAdjustments=(ac.NetCapitalAdjustments or 0)+amount
 ac.ParticipationCapitalNet=(ac.ParticipationCapitalNet or 0)+amount
 ac.Base=ac.StartingCapital+ac.NetCapitalAdjustments
 ac.Balance=ac.Base+(ac.PnlBaseline or 0)+ac.Realized
 ac.LossLimit=ac.Base;ac.Revision+=1
 e.EligibilityRevision=(e.EligibilityRevision or 0)+1
end
function H.Rebalance(p)
 local e=p.Engine;local c=e.Config.BotParticipation
 if not c or e.Time<(p.NextParticipationReview or 0)then return end
 p.NextParticipationReview=e.Time+c.ReviewSeconds
 local donors,waiting={},{}
 for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id]
  if enabled(e,a,ac)then
   local s=e:Summary(ac)
   if a.RecoveryReadyAt and e.Time>=a.RecoveryReadyAt and not next(ac.Positions)and not next(ac.OpenOrders)then
    table.insert(waiting,a)
   elseif not a.RecoveryReadyAt and not ac.Locked and not ac.Liquidating then
    -- Only realized cash surplus is distributable; keep unrealized gains and all reserved margin.
    local spare=math.floor(math.max(0,math.min(ac.Balance,s.Equity)-a.Budget*c.DonorFloorFraction)*100)/100
    if spare>0 then
     local lo,hi=0,math.floor(spare*100)
     while lo<hi do local mid=math.ceil((lo+hi)/2)
      if e:Exposure(ac,a.Key,1,0,{Equity=s.Equity-mid/100})then lo=mid else hi=mid-1 end
     end
     if lo>0 then table.insert(donors,{Agent=a,Available=lo/100})end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 table.sort(donors,function(a,b)return a.Agent.Id<b.Agent.Id end)
 table.sort(waiting,function(a,b)if a.RecoveryReadyAt~=b.RecoveryReadyAt then return a.RecoveryReadyAt<b.RecoveryReadyAt end return a.Id<b.Id end)
 for _,a in ipairs(waiting)do
  local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local need=math.max(0,math.ceil((a.Budget*c.RecoveryFraction-ac.Balance)*100)/100)
  local available=0;for _,d in ipairs(donors)do if d.Agent.Key==a.Key then available+=d.Available end end
  -- Atomic full recovery, never repeated tiny top-ups to a permanently paused bot.
  if available+.001>=need then
   local remaining=need
   for _,d in ipairs(donors)do if d.Agent.Key==a.Key and remaining>0 then
    local amount=math.min(d.Available,remaining)
    if amount>0 then adjust(e,e.Accounts[d.Agent.Id],-amount);adjust(e,ac,amount);d.Available-=amount;remaining-=amount end
   end end
   ac.Locked=false;ac.Liquidating=nil
   ac.ParticipationRecoveries=(ac.ParticipationRecoveries or 0)+1
   ac.LastParticipationRecovery=e.Time
   a.RecoveryReadyAt=nil;a.OrderObjective=nil;a.FlowPositionId=nil;a.FlowCooldownUntil=nil
   a.Quotes={};a.ReplenishAt={};a.LiquidityQuotes={};a.Parent=0
   a.ParticipationResumeAt=e.Time+1+stagger(a.Id,c.ResumeStaggerSeconds)
   a.Next=a.ParticipationResumeAt;a.FlowNextDecision=a.Next
   p.ParticipationRecovered=(p.ParticipationRecovered or 0)+1
   p.ParticipationTransferred=(p.ParticipationTransferred or 0)+need
  end
 end
end
return H

-- Versioned bot funding and behavioral policy. No storage or network access.
local Policy={}
local function active(p,a)return not p.Engine.Books[a.Key].Spec.CloseOnly and not a.Retiring end
function Policy.Configure(p,a)
 local c=p.Config.BotPopulation;if not c or p.Engine.Books[a.Key].Spec.CloseOnly then return end
 local r=p.Random;local spec=p.Engine.Books[a.Key].Spec
 a.Budget=assert(c.Capital[a.Kind]);a.PolicyVersion=c.Version
 -- Scale by the generator's tick volatility in dollars; actual margin remains authoritative.
 local scale=math.clamp(c.ReferenceDollarVolatility/(spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*spec.Scale),0.25,1)
 if a.Kind~='Reserve'then a.Size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*scale))end
 a.Limit=math.max(a.Size,math.floor(a.Limit*scale))
 a.Lookback=r:Int(8,60);a.EntryThreshold=r:Range(.5,1.2)
 a.SignalWeight=r:Range(.6,1.5);a.ValueOffset=r:Noise()*3*spec.Scale
 a.BeliefHalfLife=r:Range(c.ValueHalfLife[1],c.ValueHalfLife[2])
 a.ObservationSeconds=r:Range(c.ValueObservationSeconds[1],c.ValueObservationSeconds[2])
 a.ObservationNoise=r:Range(c.ValueNoiseTicks[1],c.ValueNoiseTicks[2])*spec.Scale
 a.ObservedAt=p.Engine.Time;a.NextObservation=p.Engine.Time+r:Range(.25,a.ObservationSeconds)
 a.EntryBuffer=r:Range(2,6);a.MinMove=r:Range(c.ScalperMinMoveTicks[1],c.ScalperMinMoveTicks[2])
 if a.Kind=='Maker'then a.Speed*=c.MakerActivityScale
 elseif a.Kind=='Whale'then a.Speed*=c.WhaleActivityScale
 elseif a.Kind=='Reserve'then a.Limit=p.Config.Reserve.InventoryLimit
 elseif a.Kind=='Scalper'then a.Limit=a.Size;a.Lookback=r:Int(8,35)
 else a.Speed*=c.TraderActivityScale end
 a.Limit=math.min(a.Limit,math.floor(a.Budget*a.Risk*c.MarginFraction/spec.Margin))
 assert(a.Limit>=1 and a.Size>=1,'Bot funding cannot support a contract')
 a.Size=math.min(a.Size,a.Limit)
end
function Policy.Validate(p)
 local c=p.Config.BotPopulation;if not c then return end
 local seen,counts={},{}
 for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do
  assert(not seen[a.Id],'Duplicate participant id');seen[a.Id]=true
  assert(p.Engine.Accounts[a.Id] and not p.Engine.Accounts[a.Id].Player,'Invalid bot account')
  if active(p,a)then
   assert(c.Counts[a.Kind],'Unknown active bot group')
   local ac=p.Engine.Accounts[a.Id]
   assert(ac.StartingCapital and math.abs(ac.Base-ac.StartingCapital-(ac.NetCapitalAdjustments or 0))<.001,'Bot capital ledger differs')
   assert(ac.PolicyCapitalTarget==c.Capital[a.Kind]and a.Budget==c.Capital[a.Kind],'Bot funding policy differs')
   counts[a.Key]=counts[a.Key]or {};counts[a.Key][a.Kind]=(counts[a.Key][a.Kind]or 0)+1
  end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(p.Config.ContractOrder)do if not p.Engine.Books[key].Spec.CloseOnly then
  for _,kind in ipairs(c.Order)do assert((counts[key]and counts[key][kind]or 0)==c.Counts[kind],key..' '..kind..' population differs')end
 end end
end
-- Pure inspection. Existing accounts are retained in sorted id order, including opaque renamed ids.
function Policy.Plan(p)
 local c=assert(p.Config.BotPopulation);local report={Version=c.Version,FromVersion=p.PolicyVersion or 0,
  Needed=(p.PolicyVersion or 0)<c.Version,PreserveExisting=(p.PolicyVersion or 0)>=1,
  Markets={},Accounts={},Add={},Retire={},FundingAdjustment=0}
 if not report.Needed then Policy.Validate(p);return report end
 local seen={}
 for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do assert(not seen[a.Id],'Duplicate participant id');seen[a.Id]=true end
 for _,key in ipairs(p.Config.ContractOrder)do if not p.Engine.Books[key].Spec.CloseOnly then
  local groups={};report.Markets[key]=groups
  for _,kind in ipairs(c.Order)do
   local list={};for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do if a.Key==key and a.Kind==kind and not a.Retiring then table.insert(list,a)end end
   table.sort(list,function(a,b)return a.Id<b.Id end)
   groups[kind]={Before=#list,Target=c.Counts[kind],TargetCapital=c.Counts[kind]*c.Capital[kind]}
   -- Funded worlds expand by appending participants. Never refresh existing profiles,
   -- recapitalize losing bots, cancel their orders or restart paused strategies.
   if report.PreserveExisting then
    assert(#list<=c.Counts[kind],'Population expansion cannot retire existing bots')
    for _,a in ipairs(list)do
     local ac=p.Engine.Accounts[a.Id]
     assert(ac and not ac.Player and ac.PolicyCapitalTarget==c.Capital[kind]and a.Budget==c.Capital[kind],
      'Population expansion cannot change existing funding')
    end
    local missing=c.Counts[kind]-#list
    if missing>0 then table.insert(report.Add,{Key=key,Kind=kind,Count=missing,CapitalEach=c.Capital[kind]})end
    continue
   end
   for i,a in ipairs(list)do
    local ac=p.Engine.Accounts[a.Id];assert(ac and not ac.Player,'Invalid migration account')
    local keep=i<=c.Counts[kind];local s=p.Engine:Summary(ac)
    local delta=keep and math.round((c.Capital[kind]-s.Equity)*100)/100 or 0
    local cancel,exits={},{}
    for id in pairs(ac.OpenOrders)do local o=p.Engine.Orders[id];table.insert(o.ReduceOnly and exits or cancel,id)end
    table.sort(cancel);table.sort(exits)
    local positions={};for symbol,pos in pairs(ac.Positions)do table.insert(positions,{Market=symbol,Quantity=pos.Quantity,Direction=pos.Direction,Entry=pos.Entry})end
    table.sort(positions,function(a,b)return a.Market<b.Market end)
    table.insert(report.Accounts,{Id=a.Id,Key=key,Kind=kind,Keep=keep,EquityBefore=s.Equity,BaseBefore=ac.Base,
     Realized=ac.Realized,Unrealized=s.Unrealized,FundingAdjustment=delta,TargetEquity=keep and c.Capital[kind]or nil,
     CancelEntryOrders=cancel,PreserveExitOrders=exits,Positions=positions})
    report.FundingAdjustment+=delta
    if not keep then table.insert(report.Retire,a.Id)end
   end
   local missing=math.max(0,c.Counts[kind]-#list)
   if missing>0 then table.insert(report.Add,{Key=key,Kind=kind,Count=missing,CapitalEach=c.Capital[kind]})end
  end
 end end
 return report
end
function Policy.Apply(p)
 local c=p.Config.BotPopulation;if not c then return end
 assert((p.PolicyVersion or 0)<=c.Version,'Cannot downgrade bot population policy')
 local report=Policy.Plan(p);if not report.Needed then return report end
 if report.PreserveExisting then
  for _,row in ipairs(report.Add)do p:_ensurePopulation({row.Key},row.Kind,c.Counts[row.Kind])end
  p.PolicyVersion=c.Version;p.MigrationReport=report
  Policy.Validate(p)
  return report
 end
 local byId={};for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do byId[a.Id]=a end
 for index,row in ipairs(report.Accounts)do
  local a,ac=byId[row.Id],p.Engine.Accounts[row.Id]
  for _,id in ipairs(row.CancelEntryOrders)do p.Engine:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
  a.Quotes={};a.ReplenishAt={};a.Parent=0
  if row.Keep then
   -- Refresh the profile from current ranges, preserving identity and live exit state.
   local fresh=p:_profile(a.Key,a.Kind,index)
   for key,value in pairs(fresh)do if key~='Id' and key~='Next' then a[key]=value end end
   a.Next=p.Engine.Time+p.Random:Range(.25,18)
   ac.StartingCapital=ac.StartingCapital or ac.Base
   ac.NetCapitalAdjustments=(ac.NetCapitalAdjustments or 0)+row.FundingAdjustment
   ac.CapitalAdjustments=ac.CapitalAdjustments or {}
   table.insert(ac.CapitalAdjustments,{Version=c.Version,Time=p.Engine.Time,Amount=row.FundingAdjustment,
    EquityBefore=row.EquityBefore,TargetEquity=row.TargetEquity,Reason='Bot population migration'})
   ac.Base=ac.StartingCapital+ac.NetCapitalAdjustments;ac.Balance=ac.Base+(ac.PnlBaseline or 0)+ac.Realized
   ac.PolicyCapitalTarget=c.Capital[a.Kind];ac.Limit=a.Limit;ac.Risk=a.Risk;ac.LossLimit=ac.Base
   ac.Locked=false;ac.Revision+=1
   -- Existing triggered liquidations and positions are preserved; repair happens through matching.
  else
   a.Retiring=true;a.Next=p.Engine.Time+p.Random:Range(.25,18)
  end
 end
 for _,row in ipairs(report.Add)do p:_ensurePopulation({row.Key},row.Kind,c.Counts[row.Kind])end
 -- Exactly half of every active market's scalpers use each style, including renamed old ids.
 for _,key in ipairs(p.Config.ContractOrder)do
  local scalpers={};for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do if a.Key==key and a.Kind=='Scalper' and active(p,a)then table.insert(scalpers,a)end end
  table.sort(scalpers,function(a,b)return a.Id<b.Id end)
  for i,a in ipairs(scalpers)do a.Style=i%2==0 and 'Momentum'or 'Reversion'end
 end
 p.PolicyVersion=c.Version;p.MigrationReport=report
 Policy.Validate(p)
 return report
end
return Policy

-- Accounting-only maintenance. No matching, clock advancement, strategy changes or storage.
local Refresh={}
local function finite(n)return type(n)=="number"and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e15 end
function Refresh.Prepare(engine,population,sequence,actor)
 assert(type(sequence)=="number"and sequence%1==0 and sequence>0,"Invalid refresh sequence")
 local previous=population.BotRefreshReceipt
 if previous and sequence==previous.Sequence then
  assert(actor==previous.Actor,"Refresh receipt actor mismatch")
  return {Receipt=previous,Duplicate=true}
 end
 assert(sequence==(previous and previous.Sequence or 0)+1,"Stale or out-of-order bot refresh")
 local capital=assert(engine.Config.BotPopulation and engine.Config.BotPopulation.Capital,"Bot capital policy required")
 local receipt={Sequence=sequence,Actor=actor,Step=engine.Step,Time=engine.Time,Count=0,Amount=0}
 local plan={Receipt=receipt,Rows={}};local seen={}
 for _,agent in ipairs(population.Agents)do
  local a=assert(engine.Accounts[agent.Id],"Bot account missing")
  assert(not seen[a.Id],"Duplicate bot participant");seen[a.Id]=true
  -- Only current, active strategies receive capital. Legacy archives stay frozen.
  if a.Player or a.House or a.Archive or a.Retired or agent.Retired or agent.Retiring
   or engine.Books[agent.Key].Spec.CloseOnly then continue end
  local target=capital[agent.Kind]
  assert(finite(target)and target>0,"Unknown bot capital allocation: "..tostring(agent.Kind))
  local s=engine:Summary(a);local amount=target-s.Equity
  assert(finite(amount)and finite(a.Realized)and finite(s.Unrealized),"Invalid bot accounting")
  local marks={}
  for key,p in pairs(a.Positions)do
   local b=assert(engine.Books[key],"Missing bot position market")
   local mark=(b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick
   assert(finite(mark)and mark>0 and p.Quantity>0,"Invalid bot mark")
   marks[key]=mark
  end
  local row={Id=a.Id,Marks=marks,Target=target,Amount=amount,Realized=a.Realized,
   Unrealized=s.Unrealized,EquityBefore=s.Equity,BalanceBefore=a.Balance,
   Base=a.Base+amount,Baseline=(a.PnlBaseline or 0)+a.Realized+s.Unrealized}
  table.insert(plan.Rows,row);receipt.Count+=1;receipt.Amount+=amount
 end
 return plan
end
function Refresh.Apply(engine,population,plan)
 if plan.Duplicate then return plan.Receipt end
 local r=plan.Receipt
 for _,row in ipairs(plan.Rows)do
  local a=engine.Accounts[row.Id]
  a.StartingCapital=a.StartingCapital or a.Base
  a.NetCapitalAdjustments=(a.NetCapitalAdjustments or 0)+row.Amount
  a.CapitalAdjustments=a.CapitalAdjustments or {}
  table.insert(a.CapitalAdjustments,{Reason="Owner bot refresh",Sequence=r.Sequence,Actor=r.Actor,Step=r.Step,Time=r.Time,
   Amount=row.Amount,EquityBefore=row.EquityBefore,TargetEquity=row.Target,BalanceBefore=row.BalanceBefore,
   RealizedBefore=row.Realized,UnrealizedSettled=row.Unrealized,CashAdjustment=row.Target-row.BalanceBefore,
   PnlBaseline=row.Baseline})
  -- Base remains contributed capital. Frozen prior P&L reconciles it to spendable cash.
  -- Entry remains the strategy/execution price; only accounting uses PnlEntry.
  a.Base=row.Base;a.PnlBaseline=row.Baseline;a.Realized=0;a.Balance=row.Target
  for key,mark in pairs(row.Marks)do a.Positions[key].PnlEntry=mark end
  a.LossLimit=a.Base;a.Locked=false;a.Revision+=1
 end
 -- Funding can make resting liquidity eligible. Wake exits through their existing
 -- revision check; keep retry deadlines, attempt caps and all order priorities.
 engine.EligibilityRevision=(engine.EligibilityRevision or 0)+1
 population.BotRefreshReceipt=r
 return r
end
-- Copy just the records Apply writes; every other execution/strategy field is read-only.
function Refresh.Preview(engine,population,plan)
 local e=setmetatable(table.clone(engine),getmetatable(engine));e.Accounts=table.clone(engine.Accounts)
 local p=setmetatable(table.clone(population),getmetatable(population));p.Engine=e
 for _,row in ipairs(plan.Rows)do
  local old=engine.Accounts[row.Id];local a=table.clone(old);e.Accounts[row.Id]=a
  a.CapitalAdjustments=table.clone(old.CapitalAdjustments or {});a.Positions={}
  for key,pos in pairs(old.Positions)do a.Positions[key]=table.clone(pos)end
 end
 Refresh.Apply(e,p,plan)
 return e,p
end
return Refresh

-- Server-only, bounded price observations in simulated seconds (not execution count).
-- Histories live in Participants.Markets, so checkpoints retain exact signal timing.
local Signals={}
Signals.InformationVersion=1
-- Best bid/ask are public even without the depth pass. Strategies use ticks internally.
-- A one-sided/empty book falls back to the observed last price, never generator state.
function Signals.Quote(population,key)
 local e=population.Engine;local b=e.Books[key];local bid,ask=e:PublicPrices(key)
 bid=bid and bid/b.Spec.Tick;ask=ask and ask/b.Spec.Tick
 return {Bid=bid,Ask=ask,Value=bid and ask and (bid+ask)/2 or b.Last or b.Reference}
end
function Signals.Sample(population,key)
 local c=population.Config.BotSignals;if not c then return end
 local market=population.Markets[key];local book=population.Engine.Books[key]
 if book.Spec.CloseOnly then return end
 local now=population.Engine.Time
 local history=market.SignalHistory or {};market.SignalHistory=history
 if #history>0 and now-history[#history].Time<c.SampleSeconds then return end
 table.insert(history,{Time=now,Price=book.Last or book.Reference})
 -- Retain one observation before the window boundary for an exact backward lookup.
 while #history>2 and history[2].Time<now-c.RetentionSeconds do table.remove(history,1)end
end
function Signals.Window(population,key,seconds,confirmationSeconds)
 local history=population.Markets[key].SignalHistory
 if not history or #history==0 then return nil end
 local now=population.Engine.Time
 if now-history[#history].Time>population.Config.BotSignals.SampleSeconds*2 then return nil end
 local previous,recent
 for i=#history,1,-1 do
  local point=history[i]
  if not recent and point.Time<=now-confirmationSeconds then recent=point end
  if point.Time<=now-seconds then previous=point;break end
 end
 if not previous or not recent then return nil end
 local book=population.Engine.Books[key];local last=book.Last or book.Reference
 local low,high=last,last
 local total,duration=0,0
 for i=#history,1,-1 do
  local point=history[i];if point.Time<previous.Time then break end
  low=math.min(low,point.Price);high=math.max(high,point.Price)
 end
 -- Time-weighted observed price, excluding the newest observation. No private generator state.
 for i=1,#history-1 do
  local point=history[i];local from=math.max(previous.Time,point.Time)
  local untilTime=math.min(now,history[i+1].Time)
  if untilTime>from then total+=point.Price*(untilTime-from);duration+=untilTime-from end
 end
 return {Move=last-previous.Price,RecentMove=last-recent.Price,Low=low,High=high,Last=last,
  Mean=duration>0 and total/duration or previous.Price}
end
function Signals.Reversal(population,key,window,spread,minDeviation,reversalTicks)
 if not window then return nil end
 local fair=window.Mean
 local required=math.max(minDeviation,spread*.5+reversalTicks)
 -- A rise/fall alone is not a bargain. Require current fair-value distance AND a turn.
 if fair-window.Last>=required and window.RecentMove>=reversalTicks
  and window.Last-window.Low>=reversalTicks then return 1 end
 if window.Last-fair>=required and window.RecentMove<=-reversalTicks
  and window.High-window.Last>=reversalTicks then return -1 end
 return nil
end
return Signals

-- Patient funded mandates. Durable state is checkpointed on the participant.
-- No price writes, shared random draws, wall clocks, cash grants or private loops.
local W={}
local function random(s)s.RandomState=s.RandomState*48271%2147483647;return s.RandomState/2147483647 end
local function range(s,v)return v[1]+(v[2]-v[1])*random(s)end
local function seed(id,world)
 local n=math.floor(math.abs(world or 1))%2147483646+1
 for i=1,#id do n=(n*31+string.byte(id,i))%2147483646 end
 return n+1
end
local function counter(ac,side)return (side==1 and ac.BotBuyContracts or ac.BotSellContracts)or 0 end
local function cancelChild(e,a,s)
 if s.ChildId and e.Orders[s.ChildId]then e:Cancel(a.Id,s.ChildId)end
 s.ChildId=nil;s.ChildAt=nil;s.ChildPrice=nil
end
local function cancelEntries(e,a)
 local ids={};for id in pairs(e.Accounts[a.Id].OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id];if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end end
 table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
end
function W.Enabled(p,a)
 return a.Kind=='Whale'and p.Config.BotWhale~=nil and p.Config.BotPopulation~=nil and a.PolicyVersion~=nil
end
function W.Adopt(p,a)
 local e,c=p.Engine,p.Config.BotWhale;local s=a.Whale
 if s and s.Version==c.Version then return s end
 local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];cancelEntries(e,a)
 s={Version=c.Version,RandomState=seed(a.Id,e.Seed)}
 for _=1,6 do random(s)end
 s.BuildSeconds=range(s,c.BuildSeconds);s.HoldSeconds=range(s,c.HoldSeconds);s.ReduceSeconds=range(s,c.ReduceSeconds)
 s.TargetFraction=range(s,c.TargetFraction);s.Participation=range(s,c.Participation)
 s.QuoteSeconds=range(s,c.QuoteSeconds);s.PriceTolerance=math.max(c.MaxSlippageTicks,math.floor(a.Stop*range(s,c.PriceToleranceStops)))
 s.Recoveries=ac.ParticipationRecoveries or 0
 local pos=ac.Positions[a.Key];s.PositionId=pos and pos.Id;s.Phase=pos and 'Holding'or 'Waiting'
 s.HoldUntil=pos and e.Time+s.HoldSeconds;s.CooldownUntil=e.Time+range(s,c.StartDelay)
 a.Whale=s;a.OrderObjective=nil;a.FlowPositionId=nil;a.FlowCooldownUntil=s.CooldownUntil
 return s
end
local function pause(e,a,s,c,stopped)
 cancelChild(e,a,s);s.Phase='Waiting';s.PositionId=nil;s.Target=nil;s.Side=nil
 s.CooldownUntil=e.Time+range(s,stopped and c.StopCooldownSeconds or c.CooldownSeconds)
 a.FlowCooldownUntil=s.CooldownUntil
end
local function phase(e,a,s,c,name,side,quantity,duration)
 cancelChild(e,a,s)
 local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];s.Phase=name;s.Side=side;s.Quantity=quantity;s.Filled=0
 s.StartedAt=e.Time;s.Duration=duration;s.Deadline=e.Time+duration
 s.StartSideFills=counter(ac,side);s.StartOwnFills=ac.BotFilledContracts or 0;s.StartVolume=e.Books[a.Key].Volume
 s.NextChildAt=e.Time+range(s,c.SliceSeconds)

function W.Budget(p,a,s)
 local e,c=p.Engine,p.Config.BotWhale;local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id]
 -- Cumulative account counters survive order retirement and checkpoint restoration.
 -- Only one child can be live. Protection fills may reduce the position, never create an entry budget.
 s.Filled=math.max(0,counter(ac,s.Side)-s.StartSideFills)
 local elapsed=math.max(0,e.Time-s.StartedAt)
 local external=math.max(0,e.Books[a.Key].Volume-s.StartVolume-((ac.BotFilledContracts or 0)-s.StartOwnFills))
 local allowed=math.floor(external*s.Participation)+1+math.floor(elapsed/c.QuietSeconds)

 return math.max(0,math.min(s.Quantity,due,allowed)-s.Filled),external,allowed
end
function W.Step(p,a)
 if not W.Enabled(p,a)then return end
 local e,c=p.Engine,p.Config.BotWhale;local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local b=e.Books[a.Key]
 local s=W.Adopt(p,a);a.FlowNextDecision=e.Time+range(s,c.SliceSeconds)

  s.Recoveries=ac.ParticipationRecoveries or 0;pause(e,a,s,c,true);return
 end
 if s.PositionId and (not pos or pos.Id~=s.PositionId)then
  pause(e,a,s,c,not(s.Phase=='Reducing'and not pos));return
 end

 if s.Phase=='Building'and not pos and s.Filled>0 then pause(e,a,s,c,true);return end
 if pos and not s.PositionId then s.PositionId=pos.Id end
 local equity=e:Summary(ac).Equity
 local capacity=math.max(0,math.min(a.Limit,ac.Limit,math.floor(equity*ac.Risk*p.Config.BotPopulation.MarginFraction/b.Spec.Margin)))
 local stressed=equity<=a.Budget*(1-p.Config.BotOrderFlow.MaxDrawdown)

  cancelEntries(e,a);phase(e,a,s,c,'Reducing',-pos.Direction,pos.Quantity,s.ReduceSeconds);s.ExitReason='Risk'
 end
 if s.Phase=='Building'and (e.Time>=s.Deadline or s.Filled>=s.Quantity)then
  cancelChild(e,a,s)
  if pos then s.Phase='Holding';s.HoldUntil=e.Time+s.HoldSeconds else pause(e,a,s,c,false)end
 end
 if s.Phase=='Holding'then
  if not pos then pause(e,a,s,c,false);return end
  if e.Time<s.HoldUntil then return end
  phase(e,a,s,c,'Reducing',-pos.Direction,pos.Quantity,s.ReduceSeconds);s.ExitReason='Time'
 end
 if s.Phase=='Waiting'then
  if pos then s.Phase='Holding';s.HoldUntil=e.Time+s.HoldSeconds;return end
  if stressed then return end
  local riskCapacity=math.floor(math.max(0,equity)*c.PositionRiskFraction/(a.Stop*b.Spec.Tick*b.Spec.Multiplier))
  local quantity=math.min(math.floor(capacity*s.TargetFraction),riskCapacity)
  if quantity<1 then return end
  -- Independent portfolio mandates, not a shared trend signal or a scheduled reversal.
  local side=random(s)<.5 and 1 or -1
  phase(e,a,s,c,'Building',side,quantity,s.BuildSeconds)
  s.Target=quantity*side;s.Arrival=b.Last or b.Reference;s.ExitReason=nil
 end
 local reducing=s.Phase=='Reducing'
 if reducing and not pos then pause(e,a,s,c,false);return end
 local bid,ask=e:PublicPrices(a.Key)
 local ownTouch=s.Side==1 and bid or ask;local opposite=s.Side==1 and ask or bid
 if s.ChildId then
  local order=e.Orders[s.ChildId]
  if not order then
   cancelChild(e,a,s);s.NextChildAt=e.Time+range(s,c.RefillSeconds);return
  end
  -- Retain FIFO priority; only stale, meaningfully displaced children are withdrawn.
  if e.Time-s.ChildAt>=c.MinRestSeconds and ownTouch and math.abs(ownTouch/b.Spec.Tick-s.ChildPrice)>=c.RepriceTicks then
   cancelChild(e,a,s);s.NextChildAt=e.Time+range(s,c.RefillSeconds)
  end
  return
 end
 if e.Time<(s.NextChildAt or 0)then return end
 local budget=W.Budget(p,a,s)
 local urgency=math.clamp((e.Time-s.StartedAt)/s.Duration,0,1)
 local aggressive=s.ExitReason=='Risk'or random(s)<c.AggressiveProbability[1]+urgency*(c.AggressiveProbability[2]-c.AggressiveProbability[1])
 local touch=aggressive and opposite or ownTouch
 if not touch then return end
 local tick=math.round(touch/b.Spec.Tick)+(aggressive and s.Side*c.MaxSlippageTicks or 0)
 if not reducing then
  local tolerance=s.Arrival+s.Side*s.PriceTolerance
  tick=s.Side==1 and math.min(tick,tolerance)or math.max(tick,tolerance)
  if aggressive and (tick-opposite/b.Spec.Tick)*s.Side<0 then return end
 end
 -- Participation and gradual schedules cap voluntary execution; risk exits retain authority.
 if s.ExitReason=='Risk'then budget=pos.Quantity end
 local size=math.min(budget,math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*range(s,c.SliceFraction))))
 if reducing then size=math.min(size,pos.Quantity)
 else size=math.min(size,math.max(0,capacity-(pos and pos.Quantity or 0)));size=p:_fit(a,s.Side,size)end
 if size<1 then return end
 local expires=e.Time+(aggressive and c.SliceSeconds[1]or s.QuoteSeconds)
 if not reducing then expires=math.min(expires,s.Deadline)end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=s.Side,Quantity=size,Type='Limit',Price=math.max(1,tick)*b.Spec.Tick,
  ReduceOnly=reducing,StopTicks=not reducing and a.Stop or nil,Expires=expires})
 s.NextChildAt=e.Time+range(s,c.RefillSeconds)
 if ok then
  if aggressive then if e.Orders[result.Id]then e:Cancel(a.Id,result.Id)end
  elseif e.Orders[result.Id]then s.ChildId=result.Id;s.ChildAt=e.Time;s.ChildPrice=tick end
  W.Budget(p,a,s)
  local held=ac.Positions[a.Key];s.PositionId=held and held.Id
  if reducing and not held then pause(e,a,s,c,false)end
 end
end
return W

local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)

local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)

local Tests={}
local uid="closed-pnl-test"
local function fresh()
 local c=table.clone(C);local l=table.clone(L);l.StartingBalance=200000
 local e=E.new(c,8192);local f=F.new(e,l,c);f:Join(uid)
 return e,f,f:Owner(uid)
end
local function fill(e,id,key,side,qty,price,reduce)
 Liquidity.Offer(e,key,-side,qty,price)
 local ok,r=e:Submit(id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=reduce})
 assert(ok and r.Filled==qty,tostring(r));return r
end
local function near(actual,expected)
 assert(math.abs(actual-expected)<0.001,tostring(actual).." differs from "..tostring(expected))
end
local function closed(f,expected,qty)
 local events=f:TakeEvents(uid);assert(events and #events==1,"Expected one completed-position notification")
 local ev=events[1];assert(ev.Kind=="TradeClosed");near(ev.Pnl,expected)
 assert(ev.Quantity==qty and ev.PositionId and ev.TradeId,"Missing closed-position identity/quantity")
 assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"Close was announced twice");return ev
end
local function restore(e)
 local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(8192),Agents={}},P)
 local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop))),e.Config)
 return r,F.new(r,L,r.Config)
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={}
 local function test(name,fn)
  local ok,detail=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (detail or "Passed")or tostring(detail)})
 end
 for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,move in ipairs({4,-4,0})do
  test((side==1 and "Long"or "Short").." 40 + 20 + 30 + 30 contracts: whole-position PNL, move "..move,function()
   local e,f,id=fresh();local cost=0
   for _,entry in ipairs({{40,5825},{20,5826},{30,5827},{30,5828}})do
    fill(e,id,"BX",side,entry[1],entry[2]);cost+=entry[1]*entry[2]
   end
   local position=e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX;local positionId=position.Id
   local average=cost/120;near(position.Entry,average)
   assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"Entries should not announce a close")
   -- Offer 100 first, then the final 20 on a later step to exercise a partial close.
   local proceeds=0
   for _,q in ipairs({10,15,25,50})do
    local price=5826.5+side*move
    Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",side,q,price);proceeds+=q*price
   end
   local before=e.Accounts[id].Realized
   assert(F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"}))
   assert(e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX.Quantity==20)
   assert(not f:TakeEvents(uid),"A partial fill announced the whole trade closed")
   local finalPrice=5826.5+side*move;Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",side,20,finalPrice);proceeds+=20*finalPrice
   e:AdvanceClock(e.Config.StepSeconds);e:ProcessPlayerOrders();assert(not e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX)
   local expected=(proceeds-cost)*side*50;local ev=closed(f,expected,120)
   assert(ev.PositionId==positionId and ev.Reason=="Player close")
   near(e.Accounts[id].Realized-before,expected);near(ev.Balance,e.Accounts[id].Balance);e:Audit()
   return {Pnl=ev.Pnl,LastFillPnl=e.Accounts[id].History[1].Pnl,Quantity=ev.Quantity}
  end)
 end end
 test("Partial exits survive save/rejoin and trimmed history; new additions stay in the same trade",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh();e.Config.MaxAccountHistory=2

 end)
 test("Older open trades recover earlier partial closes from their retained position history",function()
  local e,f,id=fresh()

  local e,f,id=fresh();fill(e,id,"BX",1,3,5825);fill(e,id,"BX",-1,1,5826,true)

 for _,reason in ipairs({"Take profit","Stop loss"})do
  test(reason.." aggregates multiple exit prices and waits for the final fill",function()
   local e,f,id=fresh();fill(e,id,"BX",1,4,5825)
   local p=e.Accounts[id].Positions.BX

   local ev=closed(f,((first-5825)+3*(first-1-5825))*50,4);assert(ev.Reason==reason);e:Audit()
  end)
 end

-- Contract tests: isolated accounts, real two-sided settlement, no live state/services.
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)

local Tests={}
local function copy(v)if type(v)~='table'then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=copy(x)end return r end
local function fresh()
 -- Preserve the captured pre-V22 incident; current public collars have separate execution tests.
 local c=copy(C);c.OrderFlowMarket=nil;c.BotPopulation=nil;c.Contracts.BX.Last=5230.25
 local e=E.new(c,10315)
 for _,id in ipairs({'player','player2','maker','buyer','other'})do
  local a=e:AddAccount(id,1000000000,1000000,.8,id:sub(1,6)=='player');a.LiquidityProvider=true
 end
 return e,c
end
local function order(e,owner,side,quantity,price,extra)
 local request={Contract='BX',Direction=side,Quantity=quantity,Type=price and 'Limit'or 'Market',Price=price}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do request[k]=v end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(owner,request);assert(ok,tostring(result));return result
end
local function position(quantity)
 local e,c=fresh();local policy=c.PlayerExecution;c.PlayerExecution=nil
 order(e,'maker',-1,quantity,5230.25)
 order(e,'player',1,quantity,nil,{TargetTicks=18,StopTicks=20})
 c.PlayerExecution=policy
 return e,c,e.Accounts.player.Positions.BX
end
local function pop(e,c)return setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=c,Random=P.RNG.new(10315),Agents={}},P)end
function Tests.Run(yieldBetween)
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)if yieldBetween then yieldBetween()end;local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and 'Passed'or tostring(r)})end
 test('Captured BX TP: 7946 at 5234.75 cannot be bypassed by bot ask 5235.25 at fair 5181.50',function()
  local e,_,p=position(7946);local target=e.Orders[p.TargetOrder];local priority=target.Priority
  e.Books.BX.FairReference=5181.5/.25;e.Time=2177372.75;e.Step=8709491
  local worse=order(e,'other',-1,2,5235.25);local n=e.NextTrade
  local result=order(e,'buyer',1,91)
  assert(result.Filled==0 and e.NextTrade==n,'Out-of-band bot trade bypassed the TP')
  assert(target.Remaining==7946 and target.Filled==0 and target.BlockedReason=='Waiting · price safeguard')
  assert(target.StatusHistory[#target.StatusHistory].Reason==target.BlockedReason)
  local status=e:Snapshot('player','BX','1m',false).Orders[2]
  assert(status and status.Status:find('price safeguard',1,true),'TP must explain its blocking reason')
  e.Books.BX.FairReference=5234.75/.25
  local filled=order(e,'buyer',1,2)
  assert(filled.Filled==2 and filled.Average==5234.75 and p.Quantity==7944)
  assert(target.Priority==priority and target.Remaining==7944 and e.Orders[worse.Id].Remaining==2)
  e:Audit()
 end)

  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do for _,owner in ipairs({'player','maker'})do
   local e=fresh();local price=5230.25+side*8

  for _,first in ipairs({'player','maker'})do

 test('Amendment no-op retains FIFO; reprice loses priority; cancellation removes exactly one order',function()

 test('Quantity reduction retains FIFO; increase loses FIFO and reserves new capacity',function()
  local e=fresh();local a=order(e,'player',-1,5,5231);local b=order(e,'player2',-1,5,5231)
  local priority=e.Orders[a.Id].Priority
  assert(e:AmendOrder('player',{Contract='BX',OrderId=a.Id,ExpectedPrice=5231,ExpectedQuantity=5,Price=5231,Quantity=3}))

  order(e,'buyer',1,6);assert(not e.Orders[b.Id]and e.Orders[a.Id].Remaining==5);e:Audit()

 test('Bot margin eligibility is rechecked before a resting quote can execute',function()
  local e=fresh();local q=order(e,'maker',-1,10,5231)
  e.Accounts.maker.Balance=1;e.Accounts.maker.Realized=1-e.Accounts.maker.Base
  local r=order(e,'buyer',1,10)

 test('Snapshot filters ineligible liquidity without retiring or reprioritizing an order',function()
  local e=fresh();local r=order(e,'player',-1,10,5231);local o=e.Orders[r.Id];local priority=o.Priority
  e.Accounts.player.Balance=1000;e.Accounts.player.Realized=1000-e.Accounts.player.Base

 for _,quantity in ipairs({8000,13000,50000})do
  test(quantity..'-contract TP uses matched chunks, tracks residual and never reverses',function()
   local e,_,p=position(quantity);local child=e.Orders[p.TargetOrder];local n=e.NextTrade
   order(e,'buyer',1,quantity-1,5234.75)

   order(e,'other',1,2,5234.75)

   assert(e.Accounts.other.Positions.BX.Quantity==1);e:Audit()
  end)
 end
 test('Sparse liquidity preserves an active target and later arrival gets only available quantity',function()
  local e,_,p=position(13000);local id=p.TargetOrder;local priority=e.Orders[id].Priority

 test('Checkpoint preserves blocked TP priority and exact continuation, independent of snapshot reads',function()

   e:Snapshot('player','BX','1m',false)

function Funded.Perform(engine,owner,req)
 local a=engine.Accounts[owner];if not a then return false,"Unknown account." end
 if a.Resetting then return false,"Reset in progress. Wait for positions to finish liquidating."end
 if req.Action=="Place" then return engine:Submit(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="AmendProtection" then return engine:AmendProtection(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="AmendOrder" then return engine:AmendOrder(owner,req)
 elseif req.Action=="Cancel" then
  if type(req.OrderId)~="number" then return false,"Unknown order." end
  if req.Protection then return engine:CancelProtection(owner,req.OrderId,req.Protection) end
  local o=engine.Orders[req.OrderId]
  if o and o.Owner==owner and o.Protection then return false,"Use the position's protection controls to cancel this order."end
  return engine:Cancel(owner,req.OrderId)

  local ok,result=engine:Submit(owner,{Contract=req.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=engine.Config.PlayerExecution and p.Quantity or math.min(p.Quantity,engine.Config.MaxPlayerQuantity),Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
