 local filled,remaining,cancelled=result.Filled or 0,result.Remaining or 0,result.Cancelled or 0
 local requested=filled+remaining+cancelled
 local prefix=result.Amended and string.format("Limit %s moved to %.2f · ",result.Direction==1 and "Buy"or "Sell",result.Price)or ""
 if result.Queued then return prefix..string.format("Executing %d contracts · %d filled, %d remaining. View or cancel in Orders.",requested,filled,remaining)end
 if cancelled>0 then
  local lead=filled>0 and string.format("Partially filled %d of %d @ %.2f",filled,requested,result.Average) or "No fill"
  return prefix..string.format("%s · %d unfilled contracts cancelled (available liquidity or execution limits).",lead,cancelled)
 elseif filled>0 and remaining>0 then
  return prefix..string.format("Partially filled %d of %d @ %.2f · %d still working.",filled,requested,result.Average,remaining)
 end
 if result.Amended and filled==0 and remaining>0 then return prefix..string.format("No new fills · %d still working.",remaining)end
 return prefix..(filled>0 and string.format("Filled %d @ %.2f",filled,result.Average) or result.Status or "Working")
end
return Funded
server/LeaderboardRanking.luau:
-- Pure projection of the authoritative funded ledger. Never accepts client scores.

local Rules=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionRules)
local Ranking={Limit=100}

function Ranking.Row(funded,uid,identity)

 local p=funded:Profile(uid)

 local row={UserId=tonumber(uid),Name=identity and identity.Name or p and p.PlayerName,

  DisplayName=identity and identity.DisplayName or p and p.DisplayName,Cents=0,Eligible=false,Tier="—",TierSize=0}

 if not row.UserId or row.UserId%1~=0 then return nil end

 if not p then return row end

 local profit=funded.Engine.Accounts[p.Account].Balance

 assert(profit==profit and math.abs(profit)<9e13,"Invalid account balance")

 row.Cents=math.round(profit*100)

 local trades=funded:_counts(p)

 row.Eligible=trades>0

 local rank=Rules.Rank(p.RankId)
 row.ProgressionRankId=rank and rank.Id;row.ProgressionVersion=p.ProgressionVersion
 row.Tier=rank and rank.Name or nil;row.TierSize=0

 return row

end

function Ranking.Sort(rows,limit)

 local result,seen={},{}

 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

  if row and row.Eligible and not seen[row.UserId] then seen[row.UserId]=true;table.insert(result,table.clone(row)) end

 end

 table.sort(result,function(a,b) if a.Cents~=b.Cents then return a.Cents>b.Cents end return a.UserId<b.UserId end)

 while limit and #result>limit do table.remove(result) end

 for i,row in ipairs(result) do row.Rank=i end

 return result

end

function Ranking.Capture(funded)

 local rows={}

 for uid in pairs(funded.Engine.Profiles) do

  local row=Ranking.Row(funded,uid)

  -- Studio's synthetic negative user ids are allowed only by its separate store scope.

  if row then table.insert(rows,row) end

 end

 return Ranking.Sort(rows,Ranking.Limit)

end

function Ranking.Standing(own,rows,verified)

 own=table.clone(own);own.Rank=nil

 if not own.Eligible then own.Status="Close a trade to join";return own end

 own.Status="Outside top 100"

 if verified then

  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do

   if row.UserId==own.UserId and row.Cents==own.Cents then own.Rank=row.Rank;own.Status="#"..row.Rank;break end

  end

 end

 return own

end

return Ranking
server/LeaderboardService.luau:
-- This game persists EVERY funded profile in one fenced shared-exchange checkpoint.
-- Publish a complete top-100 projection, atomically, instead of racing per-user ordered writes.
-- A lower score can evict a previous winner correctly; ties at the cutoff are deterministic.
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Service={} Service.__index=Service
Service.RefreshSeconds=45
function Service.Scope(studio) return studio and "Studio" or "Live" end
function Service.new(options)
 options=options or {}
 return setmetatable({Store=options.Store,Studio=options.Studio,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Cache=nil,ReadAt=0,NextRead=0,NextWrite=0,Pending=nil,Reading=false,Writing=false,Failures=0},Service)
end
function Service:_store()
 if not self.Store then self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("GetFunded_BalanceLeaderboard_v1",Service.Scope(self.Studio)) end
 return self.Store
end
function Service:Queue(projection)
 if not projection or self.LastProjection==projection then return end
 self.LastProjection=projection
 if not self.Pending or projection.WorldId~=self.Pending.WorldId or projection.Sequence>self.Pending.Sequence then self.Pending=projection end
end
function Service:UseDurableProjection(projection)
 if not projection then return end
 self:Queue(projection)
 -- Already committed in the exchange. Keep the live read model correct even if its store is retrying.
 self.Cache={Version=1,WorldId=projection.WorldId,Sequence=projection.Sequence,SavedAt=projection.SavedAt,Rows=projection.Rows}
 self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
end
function Service:Flush()
 local pending=self.Pending
 if self.Writing or not pending or self.Now()<self.NextWrite then return false end
 self.Writing=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  return self:_store():UpdateAsync("top100",function(old)
   if old then
    assert(old.Version==1 and old.WorldId==pending.WorldId,"Leaderboard belongs to another exchange")
    if old.Sequence>=pending.Sequence then return nil end -- fences delayed/stale writers, including losses
   end
   return {Version=1,WorldId=pending.WorldId,Sequence=pending.Sequence,SavedAt=pending.SavedAt,Rows=pending.Rows}
  end)
 end)
 self.Writing=false
 if ok then
  self.Failures=0;self.WriteError=nil;self.NextWrite=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
  if self.Pending==pending then self.Pending=nil end
  if result then
   -- An overlapping read may already have seen the next owner's newer snapshot.
   if not self.Cache or (result.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and result.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence)then
    self.Cache=result;self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds;self.ReadError=nil
   end
  else self.NextRead=0 end
 else
  self.Failures+=1;self.WriteError=tostring(result)
  self.NextWrite=self.Now()+math.min(45,5*2^math.min(self.Failures-1,4))
 end
 return ok
end
function Service:Read()
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Reading or now<self.NextRead then return self.Cache end
 self.Reading=true;self.NextRead=now+Service.RefreshSeconds
 local ok,record=pcall(function()return self:_store():GetAsync("top100")end)
 self.Reading=false
 if ok and record and (record.Version~=1 or type(record.Rows)~="table" or type(record.SavedAt)~="number" or type(record.Sequence)~="number") then ok=false;record="Invalid leaderboard snapshot" end
 if ok then
  -- Do not regress a cache if a read overlaps a newer successful publish.
  if not record then if not self.Cache then self.ReadAt=now end
  elseif not self.Cache or (record.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and record.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence) then self.Cache=record;self.ReadAt=now end
  self.ReadError=nil
 else self.ReadError=tostring(record);self.NextRead=now+10 end
 return self.Cache
end
function Service:Names(rows)
 self.NameCache=self.NameCache or {};self.NameRetry=self.NameRetry or 0
 local missing={}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local cached=self.NameCache[row.UserId]
  if cached then row.Name=cached.Name;row.DisplayName=cached.DisplayName
  elseif not row.Name and row.UserId>0 then table.insert(missing,row.UserId) end
 end
 if #missing==0 or self.Now()<self.NameRetry then return end
 self.NameRetry=self.Now()+60
 local ok,infos=pcall(function()return game:GetService("UserService"):GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(missing)end)
 if ok then
  for _,info in ipairs(infos) do self.NameCache[info.Id]={Name=info.Username,DisplayName=info.DisplayName} end
  for _,row in ipairs(rows)do local info=self.NameCache[row.UserId];if info then row.Name=info.Name;row.DisplayName=info.DisplayName end end
 end
end
function Service:Global(own)
 self:Read()
 local record=self.Cache
 local stale=record and (self.Now()-record.SavedAt>120 or self.ReadError~=nil or self.WriteError~=nil)
 local rows={}
 for _,r in ipairs(record and record.Rows or {}) do
  local row=table.clone(r);if stale then row.Rank=nil end;table.insert(rows,row)
 end
 self:Names(rows)
 local state=not record and (self.ReadError and "Error" or "Loading") or stale and "Stale" or #rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready"
 return {Tab="Global",State=state,Rows=rows,Your=Ranking.Standing(own,rows,record~=nil and not stale),
  SavedAt=record and record.SavedAt,RefreshSeconds=Service.RefreshSeconds,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
function Service:Server(funded,players,player)
 local rows={}
 for _,p in ipairs(players) do table.insert(rows,Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(p.UserId),p)) end
 rows=Ranking.Sort(rows)
 local own=Ranking.Standing(Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(player.UserId),player),rows,true)
 return {Tab="Server",State=#rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready",Rows=rows,Your=own,RefreshSeconds=10,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
return Service
server/LegacyRetirement.luau:
-- One-time administrative settlement of closed markets. Never generates a trade,
-- candle, reward, funding adjustment or random draw. Archived records are audit-only.
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Retirement={Version=1}
local function copy(v)
 if type(v)~='table'then return v end
 local out={}for k,x in pairs(v)do out[k]=copy(x)end return out
end
local function finite(n)return type(n)=='number'and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e15 end
function Retirement.Apply(e,p)
 local version=e.Config.MarketRetirementVersion or 0
 assert(version<=Retirement.Version,'Unsupported market retirement policy')
 if version==0 then return nil end
 local closed={};local count=0
 for _,key in ipairs(e.Config.ContractOrder)do
  if e.Books[key].Spec.CloseOnly then closed[key]=true;count+=1 end
 end
 if count==0 then return e.MarketRetirement end
 local existing=e.MarketRetirement
 assert(not existing or existing.Version==version,'Inconsistent market retirement archive')
 local archive=existing and copy(existing)or{Version=version,Step=e.Step,Time=e.Time,Markets={},Accounts={},Agents={},Settlements={},CancelledOrders={}}
 local settlements,retired,net={},{},{}
 for key in pairs(closed)do
  assert(not archive.Markets[key],'Market already archived: '..key);net[key]=0
  local b=e.Books[key];local mark=(b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick
  assert(finite(mark)and mark>0,'Invalid legacy settlement price')
 end
 -- Validate the entire operation before changing any account or order.
 for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do if closed[a.Key]then
  assert(not retired[a.Id],'Duplicate legacy participant')
  local account=assert(e.Accounts[a.Id],'Missing legacy account')
  assert(not account.Player and not account.House and not account.Archive,'Invalid legacy participant')
  for key in pairs(account.Positions)do assert(closed[key],'Legacy bot holds an active-market position')end
  for id in pairs(account.OpenOrders)do assert(closed[e.Orders[id].Contract],'Legacy bot has an active-market order')end
  retired[a.Id]=true
 end end
 for _,id in ipairs(e.AccountOrder)do local a=e.Accounts[id]
  for key,pos in pairs(a.Positions)do if closed[key]then
   local b=e.Books[key];local mark=(b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick
   assert(pos.Quantity>0 and pos.Quantity%1==0 and(pos.Direction==1 or pos.Direction==-1),'Invalid legacy position')
   local pnl=(mark-(pos.PnlEntry or pos.Entry))*pos.Quantity*pos.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier
   assert(finite(pnl),'Invalid legacy settlement P&L');net[key]+=pos.Quantity*pos.Direction
   table.insert(settlements,{Owner=id,Contract=key,Position=copy(pos),Price=mark,Pnl=pnl,
    Notional=mark*pos.Quantity*pos.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier,Step=e.Step,Time=e.Time,Reason='Retired market cash settlement'})
  end end
 end
 for key,quantity in pairs(net)do assert(quantity==0,'Unbalanced legacy inventory: '..key)end
 table.sort(settlements,function(a,b)return a.Owner==b.Owner and a.Contract<b.Contract or a.Owner<b.Owner end)
 local orders={};for id,o in pairs(e.Orders)do if closed[o.Contract]then table.insert(orders,id)end end;table.sort(orders)
 for _,id in ipairs(orders)do local o=e.Orders[id]
  e:Cancel(o.Owner,id);table.insert(archive.CancelledOrders,copy(o))
 end
 for _,row in ipairs(settlements)do local a=e.Accounts[row.Owner]
  row.BalanceBefore=a.Balance
  a.CashFlow+=row.Notional;a.Realized+=row.Pnl;a.Balance=a.Base+(a.PnlBaseline or 0)+a.Realized
  a.Positions[row.Contract]=nil;a.Revision+=1;row.BalanceAfter=a.Balance
  -- Administrative settlement is not a completed trade or a reward event.
  if a.Player then TradeStats.Reconcile(e,a,os.time());e:ContractLimit(a)end
  table.insert(archive.Settlements,row)
 end
 local agents={};for _,a in ipairs(p.Agents)do
  if retired[a.Id]then a.Retiring=nil;a.Retired=true;table.insert(archive.Agents,a)else table.insert(agents,a)end
 end;p.Agents=agents
 local accounts={};for _,id in ipairs(e.AccountOrder)do local a=e.Accounts[id]
  if retired[id]then
   assert(not next(a.Positions)and not next(a.OpenOrders),'Legacy account is not flat')
   a.Retired=true;a.Locked=true;a.Liquidating=nil
   table.insert(archive.Accounts,a);e.Accounts[id]=nil
   if e.ReductionDirty then e.ReductionDirty[id]=nil end
  else table.insert(accounts,id)end
 end;e.AccountOrder=accounts
 local pending={};for _,row in ipairs(e.PendingStops or {})do if not closed[row.Contract]then table.insert(pending,row)end end;e.PendingStops=pending
 local order={};for _,key in ipairs(e.Config.ContractOrder)do
  if closed[key]then
   local b=e.Books[key];assert(not b.Bids[1]and not b.Asks[1],'Legacy order book not empty')
   archive.Markets[key]={Book=b,Signal=p.Markets[key],SettledAt=e.Time,SettledStep=e.Step,Price=(b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick}
   e.Books[key]=nil;p.Markets[key]=nil
  else table.insert(order,key)end
 end;e.Config.ContractOrder=order
 e.MarketRetirement=archive
 -- Rebuild derived order indexes after removing closed-market orders.
 e.Stops=nil;e.StopDirty=nil
 return archive
end
return Retirement

-- Server-only entitlement and packet boundary. Ownership is always verified by Roblox.
-- PassId=0 disables access; there is no Studio or client ownership bypass.
local Access={PassId=2006894567}
Access.__index=Access

function Access.new(passId,marketplace,clock)
 return setmetatable({PassId=passId or Access.PassId,Marketplace=marketplace or game:GetService("MarketplaceService"),Clock=clock or os.clock,Players={}},Access)
end
function Access:Configured()
 local id=self.PassId
 return type(id)=="number"and id>0 and id<math.huge and id%1==0
end
function Access:Refresh(player,force)
 if not self:Configured()then return end
 local state=self.Players[player]
 if not state then state={Allowed=false,State="Checking",NextCheck=0};self.Players[player]=state end
 if state.Busy then if force then state.Recheck=true end;return end
 if not force and self.Clock()<state.NextCheck then return end
 state.Busy=true
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,owned=pcall(self.Marketplace.UserOwnsGamePassAsync,self.Marketplace,player.UserId,self.PassId)
  if self.Players[player]~=state then return end
  state.Busy=false;state.Allowed=ok and owned==true
  state.State=not ok and "Unavailable"or state.Allowed and "Owned"or "Locked"
  state.NextCheck=self.Clock()+(ok and 120 or 15)
  if state.Recheck then state.Recheck=nil;self:Refresh(player,true)end
 end)
end
function Access:Status(player)
 if not self:Configured()then return {Allowed=false,State="Unconfigured"}end
 local state=self.Players[player]
 return {Allowed=state~=nil and state.Allowed==true,State=state and state.State or "Checking",PassId=self.PassId}
end
function Access:Apply(packet,player,contract)
 packet.DepthAccess=self:Status(player)
 for symbol,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes or{})do
  if not packet.DepthAccess.Allowed or symbol~=contract then quote.Depth=nil end
 end
end
function Access:Forget(player)self.Players[player]=nil end
return Access

-- Deterministic, server-only price/time priority exchange. Prices are integer ticks internally.
local Engine = {}
Engine.__index = Engine
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Protection=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.TradeProtection)
local ContractLimits=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ContractLimits)
local PlayerExecution=require(script.Parent.PlayerExecution)
local Protective=require(script.Parent.ProtectiveOrders)
local BotExitRetry=require(script.Parent.BotExitRetry)
local OrderFlow=require(script.Parent.OrderFlowMarket)
local function finite(n) return type(n)=="number" and n==n and math.abs(n)<1e12 end
local function integer(n) return finite(n) and n%1==0 end
local function sortedKeys(t)
 local keys={} for k in pairs(t) do table.insert(keys,k) end table.sort(keys) return keys
end
local function copy(t) local r={} for k,v in pairs(t) do r[k]=v end return r end
function Engine.new(config, seed)
 local self=setmetatable({Config=config,Seed=seed,Time=0,Step=0,Books={},Accounts={},AccountOrder={},Orders={},OrderArchive={},
  NextOrder=0,NextPriority=0,NextTrade=0,Trades={},PendingStops={},TotalVolume=0,TradeHash=0},Engine)
 for _,key in ipairs(config.ContractOrder) do
  local c=config.Contracts[key]
  local candles={} for _,tf in ipairs(config.Timeframes) do candles[tf[1]]={} end
  self.Books[key]={Key=key,Spec=c,Bids={},Asks={},Last=nil,Open=nil,Reference=math.round(c.Last/c.Tick),Volume=0,
   Candles=candles,CandleVolume={},Recent={},Up=0,Down=0,Volatility=1}
 end
 return self
end
function Engine:AddAccount(id,base,limit,risk,isPlayer)
 if self.Accounts[id] then return self.Accounts[id] end
 local a={Id=id,Base=base,Balance=base,Realized=0,CashFlow=0,Positions={},OpenOrders={},History={},Fills={},
  Limit=limit,Risk=risk,Player=isPlayer==true,Revision=0,Locked=false,LossLimit=base}
 -- Player accounts carry lifetime trading statistics from their first execution.
 if a.Player then a.Stats=TradeStats.New("Live");self:ContractLimit(a) end
 self.Accounts[id]=a table.insert(self.AccountOrder,id) return a
end
-- Recalculate from closed balance on every capacity read, including restored accounts.
-- Limit remains a cached field for checkpoint compatibility, never an authority for players.
function Engine:ContractLimit(a)
 if a.Player then a.Limit=ContractLimits.ForBalance(a.Balance) end
 return a.Limit
end
function Engine:Summary(a)
 local unrealized,count,margin=0,0,0
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local b=self.Books[key] local p=a.Positions[key]
  if p then
   unrealized+=((b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick-(p.PnlEntry or p.Entry))*p.Quantity*p.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier
   count+=1 margin+=p.Quantity*b.Spec.Margin
  end
 end
 -- Funded accounts liquidate on equity depletion; margin limits apply to new exposure.
 return {Balance=a.Balance,Equity=a.Balance+unrealized,Unrealized=unrealized,Session=a.Balance+unrealized-a.Base-(a.PnlBaseline or 0),
  Allowance=math.max(0,a.Balance+unrealized),Count=count,Margin=margin}
end
function Engine:Exposure(a,key,side,qty,summary)
 local limit=self:ContractLimit(a)
 local used,total=0,0
 local pending={}
 for id in pairs(a.OpenOrders)do
  local o=self.Orders[id]
  if o and not o.ReduceOnly then
   local held=pending[o.Contract]or {0,0};pending[o.Contract]=held
   local index=o.Direction==1 and 1 or 2;held[index]+=o.Remaining
  end
 end
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol] local net=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
  local held=pending[symbol];local buy,sell=held and held[1]or 0,held and held[2]or 0
  if symbol==key then if side==1 then buy+=qty else sell+=qty end end
  local worst=math.max(math.abs(net+buy),math.abs(net-sell))
  if worst>limit then return false end
  total+=worst
  used+=worst*self.Books[symbol].Spec.Margin
 end
 return (not a.Player or total<=limit) and used<=math.max(0,(summary or self:Summary(a)).Equity)*a.Risk
end
-- Maximum additional order in this direction, reserving worst-case independent entry fills.
-- Reduce-only exits cannot create exposure and do not consume entry capacity.
-- Players receive one contract per full $1,000 of closed balance, with a minimum of five.
-- Positions and working entries share that total across instruments. Open P&L and simulated
-- margin do not change it. Depleted accounts still cannot open new exposure.
function Engine:OrderCapacity(a,key,side,stopTicks,excludeOrder,summary)
 if a.Resetting then return 0,"Account reset is liquidating positions."end
 if (summary or self:Summary(a)).Equity<=0 then return 0,"Account equity reached $0." end -- failure rule: depletes on the next step
 local otherCount,net,same,opposite=0,0,0,0
 for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local p=a.Positions[symbol] local position=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
  local buy,sell=0,0
  for id in pairs(a.OpenOrders) do
   local o=self.Orders[id]
   if id~=excludeOrder and o and not o.ReduceOnly and o.Contract==symbol then
    if o.Direction==1 then buy+=o.Remaining else sell+=o.Remaining end
   end
  end
  if symbol==key then net=position;same=side==1 and buy or sell;opposite=side==1 and sell or buy
  else otherCount+=math.max(math.abs(position+buy),math.abs(position-sell)) end
 end
 local limit=self:ContractLimit(a)
 local allowed=limit-otherCount
 local reason="Account contract limit ("..limit.." total), including working orders."
 if math.abs(net-side*opposite)>allowed then return 0,reason end
 local maximum=math.max(0,math.floor(allowed-side*net-same))
 return maximum,reason
end
function Engine:CapacityMessage(a,key,side,stopTicks)
 local maximum,reason=self:OrderCapacity(a,key,side,stopTicks)
 return reason.." Maximum currently available: "..maximum.." "..key.."."
end

   DayOpen=dayOpen,DayStart=dayStart,
   Volume=b.Volume,TradeCount=b.Up+b.Down,Recent={},Depth=depth}
  for i=math.max(1,#b.Recent-15),#b.Recent do table.insert(quotes[symbol].Recent,b.Recent[i]*tick) end
 end
 local series=self.Books[key].Candles[timeframe] local candles={}
 for i=full and 1 or math.max(1,#series-1),#series do table.insert(candles,copy(series[i])) end
 -- Current maximum new order per instrument and side (the same rule Submit enforces), for the ticket and chart menu.
 local capacity
 if a.Player then
  capacity={}
  for _,symbol in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   if not self.Books[symbol].Spec.CloseOnly then
    local buy=a.Locked and 0 or (self:OrderCapacity(a,symbol,1)) local sell=a.Locked and 0 or (self:OrderCapacity(a,symbol,-1))
    capacity[symbol]={Buy=buy,Sell=sell}
   end
  end
 end
 return {Seed=self.Seed,Time=self.Time,Step=self.Step,Quotes=quotes,Positions=positions,Orders=orders,History=a.History,Fills=a.Fills,
  Base=a.Base,Summary=self:Summary(a),Contract=key,Timeframe=timeframe,Candles=candles,Full=full,Revision=a.Revision,Locked=a.Locked,
  Capacity=capacity,Limit=a.Player and self:ContractLimit(a) or nil,Triggers=a.Triggers}
end
function Engine:Audit()
 local cash,equity,inventory,volume=0,0,{},0
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do inventory[key]=0 end
 local accounts={}for _,id in ipairs(self.AccountOrder)do table.insert(accounts,self.Accounts[id])end
 local archive=self.MarketRetirement
 if archive then
  assert(archive.Version==self.Config.MarketRetirementVersion,'Retirement archive policy mismatch')
  for _,a in ipairs(archive.Accounts)do
   assert(not self.Accounts[a.Id]and a.Retired and not a.Player and not a.House and not a.Archive,'Invalid retired bot archive')
   assert(not next(a.Positions)and not next(a.OpenOrders),'Archived bot has exposure')
   table.insert(accounts,a)
  end
  for key,row in pairs(archive.Markets)do local b=row.Book
   assert(not self.Books[key]and b.Spec.CloseOnly and not b.Bids[1]and not b.Asks[1],'Archived market is active')
   volume+=b.Volume
   for _,tf in ipairs(self.Config.Timeframes)do assert((b.CandleVolume[tf[1]]or 0)==b.Volume,'Archived candle volume mismatch')end
  end
 end
 for _,a in ipairs(accounts)do
  cash+=a.CashFlow equity+=self:Summary(a).Equity-a.Base
  assert(math.abs(a.Balance-a.Base-(a.PnlBaseline or 0)-a.Realized)<0.001,"Balance / realized reconciliation")
  if a.PnlBaseline then
   assert(not a.Player and not a.House and not a.Archive,"Invalid bot accounting baseline")
   assert(math.abs(a.Base-a.StartingCapital-a.NetCapitalAdjustments)<0.001,"Bot capital reconciliation")
   local marked=a.CashFlow
   for key,p in pairs(a.Positions)do local b=self.Books[key]
    marked+=(b.Last or b.Reference)*b.Spec.Tick*p.Quantity*p.Direction*b.Spec.Multiplier
   end
   assert(math.abs(self:Summary(a).Equity-a.Base-marked)<0.01,"Bot cash / marked equity reconciliation")
  end
  local st=a.Stats
  if a.Player and type(st)=="table" then
   assert(math.abs(a.Realized-(st.Gains-st.Loss+st.UntrackedNet))<0.01,"Lifetime stats / realized reconciliation")
   assert(st.Trades==st.Wins+st.Losses+st.Even,"Lifetime stats trade classification")
  end
  for key,p in pairs(a.Positions) do inventory[key]+=p.Quantity*p.Direction end
 end
 assert(math.abs(cash)<0.01,"Notional cash is not conserved") assert(math.abs(equity)<0.01,"Total marked P&L is not zero")
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  assert(inventory[key]==0,"Inventory is not conserved") local b=self.Books[key] volume+=b.Volume
  for _,tf in ipairs(self.Config.Timeframes) do assert((b.CandleVolume[tf[1]] or 0)==b.Volume,"Candle volume mismatch") end
  for _,side in ipairs({b.Bids,b.Asks}) do
   for _,l in ipairs(side) do local total=0 local arrival=0 for _,o in ipairs(l.Orders) do
    assert(o.Remaining>0 and self.Orders[o.Id]==o,"Stale resting order") assert((o.Priority or o.Id)>arrival,"FIFO violated") arrival=o.Priority or o.Id total+=o.Remaining
   end assert(total==l.Quantity,"Level quantity mismatch") end
  end
  assert(not b.Bids[1] or not b.Asks[1] or b.Bids[1].Price<b.Asks[1].Price,"Crossed resting book")
 end
 for _,list in ipairs({self.Orders,self.OrderArchive}) do for _,o in pairs(list) do assert(o.Original==o.Filled+o.Remaining+o.Cancelled,"Order quantity mismatch") end end
 assert(volume==self.TotalVolume,"Total volume mismatch")
 return {CashError=cash,EquityError=equity,Inventory=inventory,Volume=volume,Trades=self.NextTrade,Hash=self.TradeHash}
end
return Engine

-- Market references and announcements derived solely from completed executions.
-- No random generator, target price, news schedule or directional impulse.
local Flow={}
function Flow.Reference(book)return book.Last or book.Reference end
function Flow.Adopt(population)
 local e=population.Engine;local c=e.Config.OrderFlowMarket
 if not c or population.OrderFlowVersion==c.Version then return end
 -- Withdraw old valuation-based entry intent before the first new order is processed.
 for _,a in ipairs(population.Agents)do
  local b=e.Books[a.Key]
  if b and not b.Spec.CloseOnly then
   local ids={};local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id]
   for id in pairs(ac.OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id];if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end end
   table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
   a.Belief=Flow.Reference(b);a.Parent=0;a.ParentSide=1
   a.ObservedAt=e.Time;a.NextObservation=e.Time
  end
 end
 for key,m in pairs(population.Markets)do
  m.Fair=nil;m.Anchor=nil;m.Impulse=nil
  local b=e.Books[key];if b and not b.Spec.CloseOnly then b.FairReference=Flow.Reference(b);b.Flow=nil end
 end
 population.News=nil;population.NewsUntil=0;population.NextNews=nil;population.NextBeliefs=nil;population.Direction=nil
 population.Events={}
 if population.Regime then
  population.Regime=table.clone(population.Regime);population.Regime.Trend=nil
  if population.Regime.Name=='Trending'then population.Regime.Name='Active'end
 end
 population.OrderFlowVersion=c.Version
end
function Flow.Record(e,b)
 local c=e.Config.OrderFlowMarket;if not c then return end
 b.FairReference=Flow.Reference(b) -- Compatibility field; now an observed execution reference.
 local state=b.Flow
 if not state then state={History={},Count=0,NextEventAt=0};b.Flow=state end
 state.Count+=1
 local history=state.History;local now=e.Time;local last=history[#history]
 local bucket=math.floor(now/c.SampleSeconds)
 if last and last.Bucket==bucket then
  last.Time=now;last.Price=b.Last;last.Count=state.Count
 else table.insert(history,{Bucket=bucket,Time=now,Price=b.Last,Count=state.Count})end
 local cutoff=now-c.WindowSeconds
 while #history>2 and history[2].Time<=cutoff do table.remove(history,1)end
 local first=history[1]
 if first.Time>cutoff or state.Count-first.Count<c.MinTrades or now<state.NextEventAt then return end
 local move=b.Last-first.Price
 local threshold=math.max(c.MinMoveTicks*math.max(1,b.Spec.Scale or 1),first.Price*c.MoveFraction)
 if math.abs(move)<threshold then return end
 state.Event={Id=b.Key..':'..tostring(e.NextTrade),Contract=b.Key,Direction=move>0 and 1 or -1,
  ExpiresAt=now+c.DisplaySeconds,Time=now,Step=e.Step,FromPrice=first.Price*b.Spec.Tick,ToPrice=b.Last*b.Spec.Tick}
 state.NextEventAt=now+c.CooldownSeconds
end
function Flow.Event(e,key,epoch)
 local b=e.Books[key];local event=b and b.Flow and b.Flow.Event
 if not event or event.ExpiresAt<=e.Time then return nil end
 local result=table.clone(event);result.Id=tostring(epoch or 0)..':'..result.Id
 return result
end
return Flow

-- Server-only owner policy; enqueue here and consume only at the scheduler boundary.
local Owner=require(script.Parent.OwnerResetCommand)
local Command={} Command.__index=Command
function Command.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string"or #text>80 then return nil end
 local action=text:lower():match("^%s*/bots%s+(%a+)%s*$")
 return (action=="refresh"or action=="stats")and action or nil
end
function Command.new(options)
 return setmetatable({Options=options,Busy=false,LastAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})},Command)
end
function Command:Handle(player,text)
 local o=self.Options;local now=(o.Now or os.clock)()
 if now-(self.LastAt[player]or -math.huge)<2 then return end;self.LastAt[player]=now
 if not Owner.IsOwner(player.UserId,o.CreatorType,o.CreatorId,o.GroupLookup)then
  o.Notify(player,"Only the experience owner can use /bots commands.");return
 end
 local action=Command.Parse(text)
 if not action then o.Notify(player,"Usage: /bots refresh or /bots stats");return end
 if action=="stats"then
  if not o.StatsReady or not o.StatsReady()then o.Notify(player,"Bot stats are unavailable while the exchange is loading or saving. Try again shortly.");return end
  local ok,err=pcall(o.Stats,player)
  if not ok then warn("[Get Funded!] Bot stats: "..tostring(err));o.Notify(player,"Bot stats could not be prepared. Try again shortly.")end
  return
 end
 if self.Busy then o.Notify(player,"A bot refresh is already pending or saving.");return end
 if not o.Ready()then o.Notify(player,"The saved exchange is busy or unavailable. Try /bots refresh shortly.");return end
 self.Busy=true;self.Pending={Player=player,Actor=player.UserId,Sequence=o.NextSequence()}
end
function Command:AtBoundary()
 local item=self.Pending;local o=self.Options
 if not item or not o.Ready()then return false end
 self.Pending=nil

 local spawn=o.Spawn or task.spawn
 spawn(function()
  local ok,saved,result=pcall(o.Refresh,item.Sequence,item.Actor)
  self.Busy=false
  if ok and saved then
   o.Notify(item.Player,string.format("Refreshed %d bots. Total capital adjustment: %s$%.2f. Saved.",
    result.Count,result.Amount<0 and "-"or "+",math.abs(result.Amount)))
  else
   o.Notify(item.Player,"Bot refresh was not confirmed. Check saved exchange status before retrying.")
   warn("[Get Funded!] Bot refresh: "..tostring(ok and result or saved))
  end
 end)

end

-- Server-only chat command. Uses the same creator/group-owner policy as /reset.
local Owner=require(script.Parent.OwnerResetCommand)
local Command={MaxAmount=1000000000000};Command.__index=Command
local powers={k=3,m=6,b=9,t=12}
function Command.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string"or #text>100 then return nil end
 local alias,name,token=text:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+@?([%w_]+)%s+(%S+)%s*$")
 if not alias or alias:lower()~="/give"or #name<3 or #name>20 then return nil end
 local digits,suffix=token:lower():match("^([%d%.]+)([kmbt]?)$")
 if not digits then return nil end
 local whole,fraction=digits:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
 if not whole then whole=digits:match("^(%d+)$");fraction=""end
 if not whole then return nil end
 fraction=fraction:gsub("0+$","")
 local power=powers[suffix]or 0
 -- Scale decimal digits as integers so 1.001k is exactly 1001 dollars.
 if #fraction>power then return nil end
 local amount=tonumber(whole..fraction)*10^(power-#fraction)
 if not amount or amount<1 or amount>Command.MaxAmount or amount%1~=0 then return nil end
 return name,amount
end
function Command.new(options)return setmetatable({Options=options,Busy=false,LastAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})},Command)end
function Command:Handle(player,text)
 local o=self.Options;local now=(o.Now or os.clock)()
 if now-(self.LastAt[player]or -math.huge)<2 then return end;self.LastAt[player]=now
 if not Owner.IsOwner(player.UserId,o.CreatorType,o.CreatorId,o.GroupLookup)then o.Notify(player,"Only the experience owner can use /give.");return end
 local name,amount=Command.Parse(text)

 if self.Busy then o.Notify(player,"A money grant is already being saved. Please wait.");return end
 if not o.Ready()then o.Notify(player,"The saved exchange is busy or unavailable. Try /give again shortly.");return end
 self.Busy=true

  local found,uid,canonical=pcall(o.Resolve,name)
  if not found or type(uid)~="number"or uid<=0 or uid%1~=0 or type(canonical)~="string"or canonical:lower()~=name:lower()then
   o.Notify(player,"Username not found. Use the exact current Roblox username, not a display name.");return
  end
  local saved,message=o.Give(uid,canonical,amount,player.UserId)
  o.Notify(player,message)
 end)
 self.Busy=false
 if not ok then
  warn("[Get Funded!] Owner give failed: "..tostring(err))
  o.Notify(player,"Grant could not be confirmed. Check the saved balance before retrying /give.")
 end
end

server/OwnerResetCommand.luau:
-- Server-only command policy. Dependencies keep security and lookup tests off real profiles.
local Command={} Command.__index=Command
function Command.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string" or #text>80 then return nil end
 local alias,name=text:match("^%s*(%S+)%s+@?([%w_]+)%s*$")
 if not alias or alias:lower()~="/reset" or #name<3 or #name>20 then return nil end
 return name
end
function Command.IsOwner(userId,creatorType,creatorId,groupLookup)
 if type(userId)~="number" or userId<=0 or creatorId<=0 then return false end
 if creatorType==Enum.CreatorType.User then return userId==creatorId end
 if creatorType~=Enum.CreatorType.Group then return false end
 local ok,info=pcall(groupLookup,creatorId)
 return ok and type(info)=="table" and type(info.Owner)=="table" and info.Owner.Id==userId
end
function Command.new(options)
 return setmetatable({Options=options,Busy=false,LastAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})},Command)
end
function Command:Handle(player,text)
 local o=self.Options local now=(o.Now or os.clock)()
 if now-(self.LastAt[player] or -math.huge)<2 then return end
 self.LastAt[player]=now
 if not Command.IsOwner(player.UserId,o.CreatorType,o.CreatorId,o.GroupLookup)then
  o.Notify(player,"Only the experience owner can use /reset.");return
 end
 local name=Command.Parse(text)
 if not name then o.Notify(player,"Usage: /reset <exact Roblox username>");return end
 if self.Busy then o.Notify(player,"A reset is already in progress. Please wait.");return end
 if not o.Ready()then o.Notify(player,"The saved exchange is busy or unavailable. Try /reset again shortly.");return end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local found,uid,canonical=pcall(o.Resolve,name)
  if not found or type(uid)~="number" or uid<=0 or type(canonical)~="string" or canonical:lower()~=name:lower()then
   o.Notify(player,"Username not found. Use the exact current Roblox username, not a display name.");return
  end
  o.Notify(player,"Resetting @"..canonical.."...")
  local saved,message=o.Reset(uid,canonical)
  o.Notify(player,message)
  if saved and o.AfterReset then o.AfterReset(uid)end
 end)
 self.Busy=false
 if not ok then
  warn("[Get Funded!] Owner reset failed: "..tostring(err))
  o.Notify(player,"Reset could not be confirmed. Wait for the saved exchange to recover, then check the player before retrying.")
 end
end
return Command

local Momentum=require(script.Parent.BotMomentum)
Participants.__index=Participants
local RNG={} RNG.__index=RNG
function RNG.new(seed) return setmetatable({State=math.floor(math.abs(seed))%2147483646+1},RNG) end
function RNG:Next() self.State=self.State*48271%2147483647 return self.State/2147483647 end
function RNG:Range(a,b) return a+(b-a)*self:Next() end
function RNG:Int(a,b) return math.floor(self:Range(a,b+1)) end
function RNG:Noise() return (self:Next()+self:Next()+self:Next()-1.5)*2 end
Participants.RNG=RNG
function Participants.new(engine)
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=engine.Config,Random=RNG.new(engine.Seed),Agents={},Markets={},Regime=nil,
  NextRegime=0,NewsUntil=0,Events={},OrderFlowVersion=engine.Config.OrderFlowMarket and engine.Config.OrderFlowMarket.Version},Participants)
 local r=self.Random
 self:_regime()
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local book=engine.Books[key]
  self.Markets[key]={}
  book.FairReference=book.Reference
  if book.Spec.CloseOnly then continue end
  for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
  self:_ordinary(key)
  if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
  if not book.Spec.CloseOnly then for i=1,self.Config.ScalpersPerInstrument or 0 do self:_agent(key,"Scalper",i) end end
  if self.Config.Reserve and not book.Spec.CloseOnly then for i=1,self.Config.Reserve.Count do self:_agent(key,"Reserve",i)end end
 end
 self.PolicyVersion=self.Config.BotPopulation and self.Config.BotPopulation.Version or nil
 BotPopulation.Validate(self)
 -- A genuine opening auction: finite makers post, and a participant crosses a quote.
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end end
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Kind=="Reserve" then self:_reserve(a)end end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Key==key and a.Kind~="Maker" and a.Kind~="Reserve"then
   engine:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break
  end end
 end
 return self
end
function Participants:_ordinary(key)
 local kinds={"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}
 if self.Config.BotPopulation and not self.Engine.Books[key].Spec.CloseOnly then
  for _,kind in ipairs(kinds)do for i=1,self.Config.BotPopulation.Counts[kind]do self:_agent(key,kind,i)end end
 else
  for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
   local total=0;for _,kind in ipairs(kinds)do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind]or 0 end
   local draw=self.Random:Range(0,total);local chosen="Liquidity"
   for _,kind in ipairs(kinds)do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind]or 0;if draw<=0 then chosen=kind;break end end
   self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
  end
 end
end
function Participants:_profile(key,kind,index)
 local r=self.Random local maker=kind=="Maker" local whale=kind=="Whale"
 local id="bot:"..key..":"..kind..":"..index
 local budget=r:Int(maker and 350000 or whale and 600000 or 50000,maker and 650000 or whale and 1100000 or 160000)
 local a={Id=id,Key=key,Kind=kind,Budget=budget,Risk=r:Range(0.45,0.85),Limit=r:Int(maker and 140 or whale and 180 or 16,maker and 250 or whale and 350 or 60),
  Speed=r:Range(maker and 1.5 or whale and 28 or 2.5,maker and 4.5 or whale and 100 or 13),Size=r:Int(maker and 3 or whale and 18 or 1,maker and 9 or whale and 60 or 5),
  Bias=r:Range(-0.55,0.55),Belief=Signals.Quote(self,key).Value+r:Noise()*9,Patience=r:Range(4,35),Aggression=r:Range(0.2,0.8),
  Next=r:Range(0.2,18),Stop=r:Int(16,85),Target=r:Int(20,140),Parent=0,ParentSide=1}
 if whale then a.Bias=index%2==0 and -0.3 or 0.3 end
 if kind=="Scalper" then
  local s=assert(self.Config.Scalper,"Scalper settings required")
  a.Size=r:Int(s.Size[1],s.Size[2]);a.Limit=a.Size
  a.Speed=r:Range(s.DecisionSeconds[1],s.DecisionSeconds[2])
  a.Stop=r:Int(s.StopTicks[1],s.StopTicks[2]);a.Target=r:Int(s.TargetTicks[1],s.TargetTicks[2])
  a.MaxHold=r:Range(s.HoldSeconds[1],s.HoldSeconds[2])
  a.Patience=r:Range(s.OrderLifetimeSeconds[1],s.OrderLifetimeSeconds[2])
  a.Cooldown=r:Range(s.CooldownSeconds[1],s.CooldownSeconds[2])
  a.Style=index%2==0 and "Momentum" or "Reversion"
  a.Lookback=r:Int(3,12);a.ReadyAt=0
 end
 if kind=="Reserve"then
  local c=self.Config.Reserve;budget=c.Capital;a.Budget=budget;a.Risk=.8;a.Limit=c.InventoryLimit
  a.Size=c.QuoteSizes and c.QuoteSizes[key]or c.QuoteSize;a.Speed=c.DecisionSeconds
  a.ReservePolicy=self.Config.ReservePopulationVersion
 end
 a.InformationVersion=Signals.InformationVersion
 BotPopulation.Configure(self,a)
 return a
end
function Participants:_agent(key,kind,index)
 local a=self:_profile(key,kind,index)
 assert(not self.Engine.Accounts[a.Id],"Duplicate bot account")
 local account=self.Engine:AddAccount(a.Id,a.Budget,a.Limit,a.Risk,false)
 account.StartingCapital=a.Budget;account.NetCapitalAdjustments=0
 account.PolicyCapitalTarget=a.Budget
 if kind=="Reserve"then account.LiquidityProvider=true end
 table.insert(self.Agents,a)
 return a
end
-- Append missing makers to active markets. Saved agent ids may still use a retired symbol;
-- count by Key/Kind and never reuse an existing account. Quotes begin on normal future steps,
-- so restoring a world cannot execute trades or rewrite its tape just by adding liquidity.
function Participants:EnsureMakers(keys,target)
 return self:_ensurePopulation(keys,"Maker",target)
end
function Participants:EnsureScalpers(keys,target)
 return self:_ensurePopulation(keys,"Scalper",target)
end
function Participants:EnsureReserves(keys)
 return self:_ensurePopulation(keys,"Reserve",self.Config.Reserve and self.Config.Reserve.Count or 0)
end
-- Withdraw obsolete bot quotes on upgrade without executing trades or resetting ledgers.
-- Replacement sizes come from the current policy even for already-saved agents.
function Participants:RefreshReservePolicy()
 local c=self.Config.Reserve;if not c then return end
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents)do if a.Kind=="Reserve"and a.ReservePolicy~=self.Config.ReservePopulationVersion then
  self.Engine:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);a.Quotes={}
  a.Size=c.QuoteSizes and c.QuoteSizes[a.Key]or c.QuoteSize;a.Speed=c.DecisionSeconds
  a.ReservePolicy=self.Config.ReservePopulationVersion
  a.Next=self.Engine.Time+c.DecisionSeconds
 end end
end
function Participants:_ensurePopulation(keys,kind,target)
 local e=self.Engine local added=0
 for _,key in ipairs(keys) do
  if e.Books[key] and not e.Books[key].Spec.CloseOnly then
   local count=0
   for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Key==key and a.Kind==kind and not a.Retiring then count+=1 end end
   local index=count+1
   while count<target do
    while e.Accounts["bot:"..key..":"..kind..":"..index] do index+=1 end
    local a=self:_agent(key,kind,index)
    a.Next+=e.Time
    count+=1 index+=1 added+=1
   end
  end
 end
 return added
end
-- Add a new market on migration without reseeding or advancing the saved exchange.
-- Retired (close-only) books keep their original participants and economics until positions close.
function Participants:AddMarket(key)
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random local first=#self.Agents+1
 local book=e.Books[key]
 self.Markets[key]={}
 book.FairReference=book.Reference
 if book.Spec.CloseOnly then return end
 for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
 self:_ordinary(key)
 if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 if not book.Spec.CloseOnly then for i=1,self.Config.ScalpersPerInstrument or 0 do self:_agent(key,"Scalper",i) end end
 if self.Config.Reserve and not book.Spec.CloseOnly then for i=1,self.Config.Reserve.Count do self:_agent(key,"Reserve",i)end end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i] a.Next+=e.Time
  if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end
  if a.Kind=="Reserve"then self:_reserve(a)end
 end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i]
  if a.Kind~="Maker" and a.Kind~="Reserve"then e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break end
 end
end
function Participants:_regime()
 local r=self.Random local total=0 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do total+=regime.Weight end
 local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen=self.Config.Regimes[1]
 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do draw-=regime.Weight if draw<=0 then chosen=regime break end end
 self.Regime=chosen
 self.NextRegime=self.Engine.Time+r:Range(self.Config.RegimeSeconds[1],self.Config.RegimeSeconds[2])
 table.insert(self.Events,{Step=self.Engine.Step,Kind="Regime",Name=chosen.Name})
 if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
end
function Participants:_fit(a,side,quantity)
 local e=self.Engine;local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id];local lo,hi=0,math.max(0,math.floor(quantity))
 if e:Exposure(ac,a.Key,side,hi)then return hi end
 while lo<hi do local mid=math.ceil((lo+hi)/2);if e:Exposure(ac,a.Key,side,mid)then lo=mid else hi=mid-1 end end
 return lo
end
-- Migration never fabricates a closing fill. Excess/retiring positions work down through finite quotes.
function Participants:_repairRisk(a)
 local e=self.Engine;local ac=e.Accounts[a.Id]
 local retiring=a.Retiring;local needs=retiring
 local liquidityLimit=a.Kind=='Liquidity'and self.Config.BotLiquidity and BotLiquidity.Limit(self,a)
 if liquidityLimit and BotLiquidity.Protect(self,a)then liquidityLimit=0 end
 if liquidityLimit==0 then
  local entries={};for id in pairs(ac.OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id];if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(entries,id)end end
  table.sort(entries);for _,id in ipairs(entries)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
  needs=true
 end
 for key,pos in pairs(ac.Positions)do
  -- ProcessStops owns triggered exits, including their retry schedule.
  if pos.Triggered then needs=true;continue end
  local maximum=retiring and 0 or math.min(ac.Limit,math.max(0,math.floor(e:Summary(ac).Equity*ac.Risk/e.Books[key].Spec.Margin)))
  if liquidityLimit then maximum=math.min(maximum,liquidityLimit)end
  if pos.Quantity>maximum then
   needs=true;e:CancelAll(a.Id,key)
   if BotExitRetry.Ready(e,ac,key,pos)then
    local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=-pos.Direction,Quantity=math.min(64,pos.Quantity-maximum),Type='Market',ReduceOnly=true})
    if not ok or result.Filled==0 then BotExitRetry.Attempted(e,ac,key,pos)end
   end
  end
 end
 if retiring and not next(ac.Positions)then e:CancelAll(a.Id);a.Retired=true end
 return needs
end
-- Retire private estimates and pending entries once when adopting an older saved bot.
-- This never changes funding, positions, stops, targets or reduce-only exit orders.
function Participants:_publicInformation(a)
 if a.Kind=='Maker'or a.Kind=='Reserve'or a.InformationVersion==Signals.InformationVersion then return end
 local e=self.Engine;local account=e.Accounts[a.Id];local ids={}
 for id in pairs(account.OpenOrders)do
  local o=e.Orders[id];if o and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end
 end
 table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
 a.Belief=Signals.Quote(self,a.Key).Value
 a.Parent=0;a.ParentSide=1;a.ObservedAt=e.Time;a.NextObservation=e.Time
 a.InformationVersion=Signals.InformationVersion
end
function Participants:_observe(a)
 self:_publicInformation(a)
 if not a.PolicyVersion or a.Kind~='Value' or self.Engine.Time<a.NextObservation then return end
 local now=self.Engine.Time;local elapsed=math.max(0,now-a.ObservedAt)
 local observation=Signals.Quote(self,a.Key).Value+a.ValueOffset+self.Random:Noise()*a.ObservationNoise
 a.Belief+=(observation-a.Belief)*(1-math.exp(-math.log(2)*elapsed/a.BeliefHalfLife))
 a.ObservedAt=now;a.NextObservation=now+a.ObservationSeconds*self.Random:Range(.7,1.3)
end
-- Funded reserve liquidity follows completed trades, with finite inventory and quotes.
-- Quotes are passive and finite. Each replacement reserves real inventory and margin.
function Participants:_reserve(a)
 local e=self.Engine;local b=e.Books[a.Key];local c=self.Config.Reserve;local account=e.Accounts[a.Id]
 if account.Locked or account.Liquidating or b.Spec.CloseOnly then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);return end
 a.Quotes=a.Quotes or {};a.ReserveReplenishAt=a.ReserveReplenishAt or {}
 local position=account.Positions[a.Key];local inventory=position and position.Quantity*position.Direction or 0
 local fair=OrderFlow.Reference(b)
 local scale=c.SpacingTicks or math.max(1,b.Spec.Scale or 1)
 local stress=math.max(c.MinLiquidity or .25,math.min(1,self.Regime.Liquidity))
 local skew=math.clamp(math.round(inventory/a.Limit*4),-4,4)
 for depth,offset in ipairs(c.OffsetsByMarket and c.OffsetsByMarket[a.Key]or c.Offsets)do for _,side in ipairs({1,-1})do
  local slot=side..":"..depth;local held=a.Quotes[slot]and e.Orders[a.Quotes[slot]]
  if a.Quotes[slot] and not held then
   a.Quotes[slot]=nil;a.ReserveReplenishAt[slot]=e.Time+(c.ReplenishSeconds or 0)
  end
  local tick=math.max(1,fair-skew-side*math.ceil(offset*scale))
  if held and e.Time-held.Time>=c.RestSeconds and math.abs(held.Price-tick)>=c.RepriceTicks then
   e:Cancel(a.Id,held.Id);held=nil
  end
  if not held and e.Time>=(a.ReserveReplenishAt[slot]or 0)then
   a.Quotes[slot]=nil
   local opposing=side==1 and b.Asks[1]or b.Bids[1]
   if not opposing or (tick-opposing.Price)*side<0 then
    local variation=c.SizeVariation and self.Random:Range(c.SizeVariation[1],c.SizeVariation[2])or 1
    local size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*variation*stress*(1+(depth-1)*(c.DepthGrowth or .5))*(1-inventory/a.Limit*side*.8)))
    local lo,hi=0,math.max(0,size)
    if not e:Exposure(account,a.Key,side,hi)then
     while lo<hi do local mid=math.ceil((lo+hi)/2);if e:Exposure(account,a.Key,side,mid)then lo=mid else hi=mid-1 end end
     size=lo
    end
    if size>0 then
     local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",Price=tick*b.Spec.Tick,Expires=e.Time+c.RestSeconds*30})
     if ok and result.Remaining>0 then a.Quotes[slot]=result.Id end
    end
   end
  end
 end end
end
function Participants:_maker(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked or account.Liquidating or b.Spec.CloseOnly then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);return end
 local policy=self.Config.MakerQuotePolicyVersion or 2
 if a.QuotePolicy~=policy then
  -- Strategy adoption withdraws entry quotes only. Preserve manual/position-linked exits.
  local ids={};for id in pairs(account.OpenOrders)do local o=e.Orders[id];if o and o.Contract==a.Key and not o.ReduceOnly then table.insert(ids,id)end end
  table.sort(ids);for _,id in ipairs(ids)do e:Cancel(a.Id,id)end
  a.Quotes={};a.ReplenishAt={};a.QuotePolicy=policy
 end
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local stress=self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility+math.min(6,b.Volatility)*0.2
 -- Quotes follow actual executions; inventory skews each maker's own reservation price.
 local reference=OrderFlow.Reference(b)
 local center=reference-inventory/a.Limit*(5+stress*5)
 -- Spread independently funded makers across depth instead of stacking every bot at the touch.
 local lanes=self.Config.MakerLanes
 local lane=lanes and ((tonumber(a.Id:match(":(%d+)$"))or 1)-1)%lanes.Count or 0
 local offset=lanes and lane*(lanes.SpacingTicks[a.Key]or 1)or 0
 local spread=math.max(1,math.floor(stress*0.8+b.Volatility*0.2))
 local liquidity=self.Regime.Liquidity*self.Config.Liquidity
 local minRest=self.Config.MakerMinRestSeconds or 18
 local reprice=self.Config.MakerRepriceTicks or 3
 local replenish=self.Config.MakerReplenishSeconds or math.max(4,minRest/3)
 if self.Config.MakerRepricePause then
  -- Identity-derived latency is independent of scheduling and consumes no shared RNG.
  if not a.QuoteRefillFactor then
   local n=math.floor(math.abs(e.Seed))%2147483646+1
   for i=1,#a.Id do n=(n*31+string.byte(a.Id,i))%2147483646 end
   for _=1,6 do n=(n+1)*48271%2147483647 end
   a.QuoteRefillFactor=.6+.8*n/2147483647
  end
  replenish*=a.QuoteRefillFactor
 end
 local sizeMultiplier=self.Config.MakerQuoteSizeMultiplier or 1
 local activeDepth=liquidity<.35 and 1 or liquidity<.7 and 2 or 3
 for depth=1,3 do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1}) do
   local slot=tostring(side)..":"..depth
   local held=a.Quotes[slot]and e.Orders[a.Quotes[slot]]
   if a.Quotes[slot]and not held then a.Quotes[slot]=nil;a.ReplenishAt[slot]=e.Time+replenish end
   local tick=math.max(1,math.round(center-side*(spread+offset+(depth-1)*math.max(1,math.floor(stress)))))
   local opposing=side==1 and b.Asks[1]or b.Bids[1]
   if opposing then tick=side==1 and math.max(1,math.min(tick,opposing.Price-1))or math.max(tick,opposing.Price+1)end
   local age=held and e.Time-held.Time or math.huge
   local eligible=depth<=activeDepth
   -- Keep normal FIFO/resting behavior, but withdraw materially mispriced risk on a value move.
   local stale=held and math.abs(held.Price-tick)>=reprice and (held.Price-reference)*side>=math.max(2,spread)
   if held and (stale or age>=minRest and (not eligible or math.abs(held.Price-tick)>=reprice))then
    e:Cancel(a.Id,held.Id);held=nil;a.Quotes[slot]=nil
    if self.Config.MakerRepricePause then a.ReplenishAt[slot]=e.Time+replenish end
   end
   if eligible and not held and e.Time>=(a.ReplenishAt[slot]or 0)then
    local size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*sizeMultiplier*liquidity*(1+(depth-1)*.15)*(1-inventory/a.Limit*side*.8)))
    -- Fit the quote to remaining buying power instead of rejecting the whole larger quote.
    -- This includes all working orders; no new capital or inventory allowance is created.
    if not e:Exposure(account,a.Key,side,size) then
     local lo,hi=0,size
     while lo<hi do
      local mid=math.ceil((lo+hi)/2)
      if e:Exposure(account,a.Key,side,mid) then lo=mid else hi=mid-1 end
     end
     size=lo
    end
    if size>0 then
     local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",Price=tick*c.Tick,Expires=e.Time+minRest*6})
     if ok and result.Remaining>0 then a.Quotes[slot]=result.Id end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
-- One small position at a time. Every fill goes through the shared finite book.
-- Profit-taking rests as real liquidity; stops and timed exits cannot reverse the position.
function Participants:_scalper(a)
 self:_publicInformation(a)
 local e,r=self.Engine,self.Random local b=e.Books[a.Key] local s=self.Config.Scalper
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] local p=account.Positions[a.Key]
 if p then
  if a.PositionId~=p.Id then
   a.PositionId=p.Id;a.OpenedAt=e.Time
   e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key) -- Cancel any unfilled entry remainder before managing the exit.
  end
  if p.Triggered or account.Liquidating then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);return end
  if e.Time-a.OpenedAt>=a.MaxHold or b.Spec.CloseOnly or account.Locked then
   e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key)
   if BotExitRetry.Ready(e,account,a.Key,p)then
    local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=p.Quantity,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
    if not ok or result.Filled==0 then BotExitRetry.Attempted(e,account,a.Key,p)end
   end
   return
  end
  -- Keep the target's queue priority until filled, stopped, or the holding time expires.
  if not next(account.OpenOrders) then
   local target=math.max(1,math.round(p.Entry/b.Spec.Tick)+p.Direction*a.Target)*b.Spec.Tick
   e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=p.Quantity,Type="Limit",Price=target,ReduceOnly=true})
  end
  return
 end
 if a.PositionId then
  e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);a.PositionId=nil;a.OpenedAt=nil
  a.ReadyAt=e.Time+a.Cooldown*r:Range(0.75,1.25)
 end
 if account.Locked or account.Liquidating or b.Spec.CloseOnly then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key);return end
 if e.Time<a.ReadyAt or next(account.OpenOrders) then return end
 -- PublicDepth filters ineligible orders without rewriting the whole book.
 local quote=Signals.Quote(self,a.Key);local bid,ask=quote.Bid,quote.Ask
 if not bid or not ask then return end
 local spread=ask-bid
 if spread<1 or spread>s.MaxSpreadTicks or spread>=a.Target then return end
 local signals=self.Config.BotSignals
 local last=b.Last or b.Reference local previous=b.Recent[math.max(1,#b.Recent-a.Lookback)] or last
 local move=(last-previous)/math.max(1,b.Volatility*2)
 local policy=a.PolicyVersion and self.Config.BotPopulation
 local signal=a.Bias*(policy and .2 or 1)+r:Noise()*(policy and policy.ScalperNoise or 1)+(a.Style=="Momentum" and move or -move)
 if signals then
  -- Costs constrain the achievable target; they are not added to the required price move.
  if a.Target<spread+s.MaxSlippageTicks+signals.ScalperProfitBufferTicks then return end
  local seconds=math.clamp(a.Lookback,signals.ScalperSeconds[1],signals.ScalperSeconds[2])
  local window=Signals.Window(self,a.Key,seconds,signals.ConfirmationSeconds)
  if not window then return end
  if a.Style=="Reversion"then
   local side=Signals.Reversal(self,a.Key,window,spread,signals.ScalperDeviationTicks,signals.ReversalTicks)
   if not side then return end
   signal=side*math.max(1,a.EntryThreshold or .2)
  else
   local required=math.max(signals.ScalperMinMoveTicks,spread*.5,b.Volatility*signals.ScalperVolatilityMultiplier)
   if math.abs(window.Move)<required or window.Move*window.RecentMove<0 then return end
   signal=window.Move/math.max(1,b.Volatility*2)
  end
 elseif policy and math.abs(last-previous)<math.max(a.MinMove,spread+s.MaxSlippageTicks+a.EntryBuffer)then return end
 if math.abs(signal)<(a.EntryThreshold or .2) then return end
 local side=signal>0 and 1 or -1
 local aggressive=r:Next()<s.AggressiveChance
 -- A marketable limit caps entry slippage; passive entries join the best quote.
 local tick=aggressive and (side==1 and ask+s.MaxSlippageTicks or bid-s.MaxSlippageTicks)
  or (side==1 and bid or ask)
 local size=self:_fit(a,side,a.Size);if size<1 then return end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",
  Price=math.max(1,tick)*b.Spec.Tick,StopTicks=a.Stop,Expires=e.Time+a.Patience})

-- Persistent aggregate execution budgets. Cancelling, splitting requests, changing
-- instruments, or switching accounts of the same profile does not reset the allowance.
local Policy={}
local Protective=require(script.Parent.ProtectiveOrders)
function Policy.Owner(a)return tostring(a.ProfileId or a.Group or a.Id)end
function Policy.Liquidity(e,b,side)
 local depth=0
 for _,level in ipairs(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)do
  if Policy.Allows(e,b,level.Price,side)then for _,o in ipairs(level.Orders)do
   if not e.Accounts[o.Owner].Player then depth+=e:_available(o,true)end
  end end
 end
 return depth
end
function Policy.State(e)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution
 if not c then return nil end
 local window=math.floor(e.Time/c.WindowSeconds)
 if not e.Execution or e.Execution.Window~=window then
  e.Execution={Window=window,Owners={},Markets={},Cursor=e.Execution and e.Execution.Cursor or ""}
 end
 return e.Execution
end
function Policy.Budget(e,a,b,o)
 local c=e.Config.PlayerExecution
 if not c or not a.Player then return math.huge end
 if Protective.Valid(e,a,o)then return math.huge end
 local state=Policy.State(e);local owner=Policy.Owner(a)..":"..o.Direction
 local market=b.Key..":"..o.Direction
 local budget=state.Markets[market]
 if not budget then
  local limit=c.MarketContracts
  if b.FairReference then
   local depth=Policy.Liquidity(e,b,o.Direction)
   limit=math.min(limit,math.floor(depth*c.BookFraction))
  end
  budget={Used=0,Limit=limit};state.Markets[market]=budget
 end
 -- New clicks join the queue behind other players already waiting on this side.
 if not e.ProcessingPlayerQueue then
  for _,other in pairs(e.Orders)do
   if other~=o and other.Queued and other.Contract==b.Key and other.Direction==o.Direction
    and Policy.Owner(e.Accounts[other.Owner])~=Policy.Owner(a)then return 0 end
  end
 end
 local available=math.max(0,math.min(c.OwnerContracts-(state.Owners[owner]or 0),budget.Limit-budget.Used))
 -- Recheck current real bot depth: withdrawals and player-owned spoof quotes
 -- cannot turn an earlier allowance into permission to consume the whole side.
 if available>0 and b.FairReference then available=math.min(available,math.floor(Policy.Liquidity(e,b,o.Direction)*c.BookFraction))end
 -- Share a thin market's allowance among the owners awaiting a turn. A fixed 5,000
 -- slice must not hand the entire small-book allowance to one owner per window.
 if e.ProcessingPlayerQueue and e.PlayerQueuePeers then
  available=math.min(available,math.max(1,math.floor(budget.Limit/math.min(c.OwnersPerStep,e.PlayerQueuePeers[market]or 1))))
 end

end
function Policy.Record(e,a,b,side,quantity,o)
 if not e.Config.PlayerExecution or not a.Player then return end
 -- The server stamps this field; a completed exit may already have removed its position.
 if o and o.ProtectivePosition then return end

end
-- Standard limits must either finish matching the crossed liquidity or rest without
-- crossing the book. Reject a blocked submission/amendment before any fill or cancel.
function Policy.StandardLimitAllowed(e,a,b,o,price,quantity)
 if not e.Config.PlayerExecution then return true end
 local side=o.Direction
 if not Policy.Allows(e,b,price,side)then return false end
 if not a.Player then return true end
 local allowance=Policy.Budget(e,a,b,o)
 local needed=0
 for _,level in ipairs(side==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids)do
  if (level.Price-price)*side>0 then break end
  for _,resting in ipairs(level.Orders)do
   local ra=e.Accounts[resting.Owner]
   local same=resting.Owner==a.Id or a.Group and ra.Group==a.Group or a.ProfileId and ra.ProfileId==a.ProfileId
   local available=not same and e:_available(resting,true)or 0
   if available>0 then
    if not Policy.Allows(e,b,level.Price,side)then return false end
    needed+=math.min(available,quantity-needed)

   end
  end
 end

end
function Policy.Allows(e,b,price,side)
 -- Execution-price collar for EVERY aggressor and counterparty. `side` is the
 -- incoming direction: buys cannot pay above reference + guard; sells cannot accept
 -- below reference - guard. V22 references the last execution, never hidden value.
 -- Better prices remain eligible. Passive outliers retain
 -- priority while blocked; no worse level can bypass the same collar.

  if not old or o.ReduceOnly and not old.ReduceOnly or o.ReduceOnly==old.ReduceOnly and (o.Priority or o.Id)<(old.Priority or old.Id)then pending[owner]=o end

   if o.Filled>filled then state.Cursor=owner end
  end
 end
 e.ProcessingPlayerQueue=nil;e.PlayerQueuePeers=nil
end
return Policy

-- Server-owned exits are tied to one position. Client ReduceOnly requests do not
-- acquire this authority. A working TP uses ordinary book price/time priority.
local Protection={}
function Protection.Valid(e,a,o)
 local p=a.Positions[o.Contract]
 if not o.ReduceOnly or not p or o.ProtectivePosition~=p.Id or o.Direction~=-p.Direction then return false end
 if o.Protection=="Take profit"then
  return p.Target~=nil and o.Type=="Limit"and o.Price==math.round(p.Target/e.Books[o.Contract].Spec.Tick)
   and (not p.Triggered or p.Triggered=="Take profit") and not a.Liquidating
 end
 return o.Protection==p.Triggered and (o.Protection=="Stop loss"or o.Protection=="Account depleted"or o.Protection=="Margin liquidation"or o.Protection=="Account reset"and a.Resetting==true)
end
function Protection.Mark(e,a,key)
 if not a.Player then return end

end
local function ensure(e,a,key,deferred)
 local p=a.Positions[key]
 local exit=p and p.ExitOrder and e.Orders[p.ExitOrder]
 if exit and exit.ReduceOnly and exit.Type=="Market"and exit.Direction==-p.Direction
  and(p.Triggered=="Stop loss"or p.Triggered=="Account depleted"or p.Triggered=="Margin liquidation"or p.Triggered=="Account reset"and a.Resetting)then
  exit.Protection=p.Triggered;exit.ProtectivePosition=p.Id
 end
 local wanted=p and p.Target and (not p.Triggered or p.Triggered=="Take profit")and not a.Locked and not a.Liquidating
 -- Adopt old triggered TP exits without replacing their identity or priority.
 local target=p and (p.TargetOrder or p.Triggered=="Take profit"and p.ExitOrder)
 local o=target and e.Orders[target]
 if wanted and o and o.ReduceOnly and o.Type=="Limit"and o.Direction==-p.Direction and o.Price==math.round(p.Target/e.Books[key].Spec.Tick)then
  o.Protection="Take profit";o.ProtectivePosition=p.Id;p.TargetOrder=o.Id
 end
 local ids={};for id in pairs(a.OpenOrders)do table.insert(ids,id)end;table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do
  local child=e.Orders[id]
  if child and child.Contract==key and child.Protection=="Take profit"then
   if not wanted or child~=o or not Protection.Valid(e,a,child)or child.Remaining<p.Quantity then
    e:Cancel(a.Id,id);if child==o then o=nil end
   elseif child.Remaining>p.Quantity then
    child.Cancelled+=child.Remaining-p.Quantity;child.Remaining=p.Quantity;e:_cleanBook(e.Books[key])
   end
  end
 end

 if not o or not e.Orders[o.Id]then
  p.TargetOrder=nil

   {Protection="Take profit",PositionId=p.Id,DeferProtection=deferred})

 if e.SyncingProtection then return end

 while e.ProtectionDirty and next(e.ProtectionDirty)and passes<200 do
  local dirty=e.ProtectionDirty;e.ProtectionDirty=nil;passes+=1
  local owners={};for owner in pairs(dirty)do table.insert(owners,owner)end;table.sort(owners)
  for _,owner in ipairs(owners)do
   local a=e.Accounts[owner]

  end

local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function order(e,id,side,qty,price,extra)
 local r={Contract="BX",Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type=price and "Limit"or "Market",Price=price}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do r[k]=v end
 local ok,result=e:Submit(id,r);assert(ok,tostring(result));return result
end
local function fresh(side,qty,entry,targetTicks)
 local c=clone(C);local e=E.new(c,731)
 for _,id in ipairs({"maker","other"})do e:AddAccount(id,1e9,10000,.9,false)end
 local a=e:AddAccount("user",1e9,1000000,.9,true)
 order(e,"maker",-side,qty,entry)

 return e,a,a.Positions.BX,c
end
local function capture(e)
 return CP.Capture(e,setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(731),Agents={}},P))
end
local function same(a,b)
 assert(type(a)==type(b),"Different types")
 if type(a)~="table"then assert(a==b,"Different values: "..tostring(a).." / "..tostring(b));return end
 for k,v in pairs(a)do same(v,b[k])end;for k in pairs(b)do assert(a[k]~=nil,"Extra key: "..tostring(k))end
end
function Tests.Run()
 local results={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,r=pcall(fn);table.insert(results,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and(r or "Passed")or tostring(r)})end
 test("Reset with a working or partially filled target permits subsequent market updates and protection",function()
  for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do for _,partial in ipairs({false,true})do
   local e=E.new(C,731);local f=F.new(e,L,C);f:Join("101")
   for _,id in ipairs({"maker","other"})do e:AddAccount(id,1e9,10000,.9,false)end
   local a=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
   order(e,"maker",-side,3,5825)
   order(e,a.Id,side,3,nil,{StopTicks=8,TargetTicks=4})
   local p=a.Positions.BX;local target=p.TargetOrder
   if partial then order(e,"maker",side,1,p.Target)end
   local remaining=p.Quantity;local volume=e.TotalVolume
   local used=Policy.State(e).Owners["101:"..side]
   order(e,"maker",side,remaining,5825)
   assert(f:ResetAccount("101",a.Id))
   assert(not e.Accounts[a.Id]and not e.Orders[target])
   assert(e.TotalVolume==volume+remaining,"Reset did not trade its remaining exposure")
   assert(not e.Accounts["house:reset-exposure"],"Reset parked exposure off-market")
   assert(Policy.State(e).Owners["101:"..side]==used,"Reset replenished the entry allowance")
   e:ProcessStops();e:AdvanceClock(.25);e:ProcessPlayerOrders();e:Audit()
   local nextA=e.Accounts[f:Owner("101")]
   order(e,"maker",-side,1,5825)
   order(e,nextA.Id,side,1,nil,{StopTicks=8,TargetTicks=4})
   local nextP=nextA.Positions.BX;assert(nextP and e.Orders[nextP.TargetOrder],"Protection stopped syncing after reset")
   order(e,"other",side,1,nextP.Target)
   assert(not nextA.Positions.BX);e:Audit()
  end end
 end)
 for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do
  test(side..": 307-contract target fills in thin liquidity with exhausted entry allowance",function()
   local e,a,p,c=fresh(side,307,5939.75,107);local target=p.Target;local stop=p.Stop
   local child=e.Orders[p.TargetOrder];assert(child and child.Remaining==307 and not child.Queued and not p.Triggered)
   local state=Policy.State(e);state.Markets["BX:"..(-side)]={Used=0,Limit=0};state.Owners["user:"..(-side)]=c.PlayerExecution.OwnerContracts
   e.Books.BX.FairReference=target/.25

   assert(e.TotalVolume==before+9 and e.Books.BX.Last*.25==target)
   order(e,"other",side,298,target+side*.25)
   assert(not a.Positions.BX and not e.Orders[child.Id],"Target was skipped or exposure reversed")
   assert(a.History[1].Reason=="Take profit"and a.History[1].Exit==target)
   assert(state.Markets["BX:"..(-side)].Used==0,"Protection consumed entry allowance")
   e:Audit();return {Contracts=307,Target=target,FirstFill=9,FinalPosition=0}
  end)
  test(side..": partial TP keeps stop and stop closes only the residual",function()
   local e,a,p=fresh(side,3,5825);local stop,target=p.Stop,p.Target;local tp=p.TargetOrder
   order(e,"maker",side,1,target);e:ProcessStops()
   assert(p.Quantity==2 and p.Stop==stop and e.Orders[tp].Remaining==2)
   local snap=e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",true);assert(#snap.Orders==2)
   local found=false;for _,o in ipairs(snap.Orders)do if o.Protection=="Target"then
    assert(o.Filled==1 and o.Quantity==2 and o.Closing and o.Status:find("1 filled",1,true));found=true
   end end;assert(found)
   order(e,"maker",side,3,stop);order(e,"other",-side,1);e:ProcessStops();e:ProcessPlayerOrders()
   assert(not a.Positions.BX and not e.Orders[tp]and not next(a.OpenOrders))
   assert(a.History[1].Reason=="Stop loss"and a.History[1].Quantity==2)
   e:Audit()
  end)
  test(side..": saved working/partial targets retain FIFO and residual stop",function()
   local e,a,p,c=fresh(side,5,5825);order(e,"maker",side,2,p.Target);e:ProcessStops()
   local before=capture(e);local restored=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(CP.Encode(before)),c)
   same(before.Engine, capture(restored).Engine)
   local saved=restored.Accounts.user.Positions.BX
   assert(saved.Stop==p.Stop and saved.TargetFilled==2 and restored.Orders[saved.TargetOrder].Priority==e.Orders[p.TargetOrder].Priority)
   order(restored,"maker",side,3,saved.Target);assert(not restored.Accounts.user.Positions.BX);restored:Audit()
  end)
 end
 test("Resting TP observes FIFO and a later ordinary order cannot trade through it",function()
  local e,a,p=fresh(-1,3,5825);local target=p.Target
  local later=order(e,"other",1,2,target)
  order(e,"maker",-1,4,target-.25)
  assert(not a.Positions.BX and e.Orders[later.Id].Remaining==1)
  assert(e.Trades[#e.Trades-1].Buyer==a.Id and e.Trades[#e.Trades].Buyer=="other");e:Audit()
 end)
 test("Target resizing preserves prices, reduces quantity, and removes orphan orders on reversal",function()
  local e,a,p=fresh(1,3,5825);local target,stop=p.Target,p.Stop;local old=e.Orders[p.TargetOrder]
  order(e,"maker",-1,2,5825);order(e,a.Id,1,2)
  assert(p.Quantity==5 and p.Target==target and p.Stop==stop and e.Orders[p.TargetOrder].Remaining==5)
  assert(not e.Orders[old.Id],"Adding size retained old FIFO priority")
  local resized=e.Orders[p.TargetOrder];local priority=resized.Priority

  assert(p.Quantity==4 and e.Orders[p.TargetOrder]==resized and resized.Remaining==4 and resized.Priority==priority)
  order(e,"maker",1,5,5825);order(e,a.Id,-1,5,nil,{StopTicks=8,TargetTicks=12})

  assert(not e.Orders[resized.Id]and e.Orders[reversed.TargetOrder].ProtectivePosition==reversed.Id);e:Audit()

 test("Moving/cancelling a TP updates the book without printing a trade",function()
  local e,a,p=fresh(1,3,5825);local old=p.TargetOrder;local price=p.Target;local volume=e.TotalVolume
  assert(e:AmendProtection(a.Id,{Contract="BX",OrderId=p.Id,Protection="Target",Price=price+.25,ExpectedPrice=price}))

 test("Legacy queued TP migrates without fills then ignores exhausted entry budget",function()
  local e,a,p,c=fresh(-1,307,5939.75,107);local target=p.Target

-- Disposable engines, real executions and in-memory checkpoint/store roundtrips only.
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)

local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)

local P=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)

local Tests={}
local function clone(v)if type(v)~="table"then return v end local r={}for k,x in pairs(v)do r[k]=clone(x)end return r end
local function same(a,b)
 assert(type(a)==type(b),"Type differs")
 if type(a)~="table"then assert(a==b,tostring(a).." != "..tostring(b));return end
 for k,v in pairs(a)do same(v,b[k])end;for k in pairs(b)do assert(a[k]~=nil,"Missing "..k)end
end
local function fresh(uid)
 local c=clone(C);c.WarmupSeconds=0;local e=E.new(c,731);local f=F.new(e,L,c)
 if uid then f:Join(uid)end;return e,f
end
local function result(e,id,amount)
 local b=e.Books.BX;b.Last=math.max(24000,math.ceil(math.abs(amount)/(b.Spec.Multiplier*b.Spec.Tick))+100);b.Reference=b.Last;b.Bids={};b.Asks={}
 assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}))
 b.Last+=amount/(b.Spec.Multiplier*b.Spec.Tick)
 assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true}))
 e:AdvanceClock(C.StepSeconds)
end
local function restore(e)
 local pop=setmetatable({Engine=e,Config=e.Config,Random=P.RNG.new(731),Agents={}},P)
 local snapshot=CP.Encode(CP.Capture(e,pop));local r=CP.Restore(CP.Decode(snapshot),e.Config)
 return r,F.new(r,L,r.Config)
end
function Tests.Run()
 local rows={};local function test(name,fn)local ok,detail=pcall(fn);table.insert(rows,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and "Passed"or tostring(detail)})end
 test("16 distinct titles and 8 monotonic rank gates share valid atlas cells",function()
  assert(#L.Milestones==16 and #L.Ranks==8);local seen={}
  for _,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do assert(not seen[m.Title]and m.Badge>=1 and m.Badge<=16);seen[m.Title]=true end
  for i,r in ipairs(L.Ranks)do if i>1 then local p=L.Ranks[i-1];assert(r.Trades>p.Trades and r.Wins>=p.Wins and r.Profit>=p.Profit)end end
 end)
 test("Fresh account has rookie rank; starting cash, open profit and preferences award nothing",function()
  local e,f=fresh("101");local p=f:Profile("101");local v=f:View("101")
  assert(v.RankId=="Rookie"and v.Next.Key=="FirstTrade"and #v.Titles==0)
  assert(f:SetProtectionPreferences("101",{StopOn=true,TargetOn=false,StopDollars=500,TargetDollars=1500}))
  e.Books.BX.Last=24000;assert(Liquidity.Submit(e,p.Account,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}));e.Books.BX.Last+=80
  f:Evaluate("101");assert(not next(p.Awards)and p.RankId=="Rookie")
 end)
 test("Every title boundary and every combined rank gate is exact",function()
  for _,m in ipairs(L.Milestones)do
   local net,trades,wins=0,0,0
   if m.Kind=="Profit"then net=m.Goal-.01 elseif m.Kind=="Trades"then trades=m.Goal-1 else wins=m.Goal-1 end
   assert(Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins)<m.Goal)
   if m.Kind=="Profit"then net=m.Goal elseif m.Kind=="Trades"then trades=m.Goal else wins=m.Goal end
   assert(Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins)==m.Goal)

   assert(Rules.Qualifies(r,r.Profit,r.Trades,r.Wins))
   if r.Trades>0 then assert(not Rules.Qualifies(r,r.Profit,r.Trades-1,r.Wins))end
   if r.Wins>0 then assert(not Rules.Qualifies(r,r.Profit,r.Trades,r.Wins-1))end
   if r.Profit>0 then assert(not Rules.Qualifies(r,r.Profit-.01,r.Trades,r.Wins))end

  for _=1,4 do f:Evaluate("101")end;same(awards,p.Awards)
  local seen={};for _,t in ipairs(p.Titles)do assert(not seen[t]);seen[t]=true end;e:Audit()
 end)
 test("All ranks and titles earned through 5000 executions survive depletion, restart and rejoin",function()
  local e,f=fresh("101");local p=f:Profile("101")
  for i=1,5000 do result(e,p.Account,i<=2500 and 2000 or 0)end

  result(e,p.Account,-5010000);assert(f:Restart("101",p.Account))
  assert(f:View("101").RankId=="Sovereign");e,f=restore(e);f:Join("101");p=f:Profile("101")
  same(awards,p.Awards);same(ranks,p.RankAwards);assert(#p.Titles==16 and p.RankId=="Sovereign")
  assert(e.Accounts[p.Account].Balance==260000 and f:Earned(p)==-10000);e:Audit()

 test("Legacy tier names normalize once; old awards, balances, history and protection remain intact",function()
  local e,f=fresh("101");local p=f:Profile("101");result(e,p.Account,5000)
  p.ProgressionVersion=nil;p.LegacyProgression=nil;p.RankId=nil;p.RankAwards=nil;p.Rank="Skilled Trader"
  p.Titles={"Legacy 5K Trader","10K Trader","Skilled Trader","Legacy Top Tier Complete","First Win"}

  local account=clone(e.Accounts[p.Account]);local protection=clone(p.ProtectionPreferences)
  f=F.new(e,L,C);p=f:Profile("101");same(account,e.Accounts[p.Account]);same(protection,p.ProtectionPreferences)
  assert(p.Awards.Balance10K.At==123 and table.find(p.Titles,"Founding Trader")and table.find(p.Titles,"Momentum Maker"))
  for _,m in ipairs(f:View("101").Milestones)do if m.Key=="Balance10K"then assert(m.Earned and m.EarlierGoal and m.Goal==250000)end end
  for _,title in ipairs(p.Titles)do assert(not Rules.Obsolete(title))end
  assert(p.LegacyProgression.Titles[1]=="Legacy 5K Trader")
  local before=clone(p);f=F.new(e,L,C);same(before,f:Profile("101"));e,f=restore(e);same(before,f:Profile("101"))
 end)
 test("Server and Global projection preserve cents, ties, eligibility and permanent rank",function()
  local e,f=fresh("101");f:Join("102");f:Join("103")
  for _,uid in ipairs({"101","102"})do result(e,f:Owner(uid),500)end
  local rows=Ranking.Capture(f);assert(#rows==2 and rows[1].UserId==101 and rows[2].UserId==102)
  assert(rows[1].Rank==1 and rows[2].Rank==2 and rows[1].Cents==1050000 and rows[1].ProgressionRankId=="Rookie")
  local stored;local store={UpdateAsync=function(_,_,fn)stored=fn(stored);return stored end,GetAsync=function()return stored end}
  local service=Service.new({Store=store,Studio=true,Now=function()return 1000 end})
  service:Queue({WorldId="isolated",Sequence=1,SavedAt=1000,Rows=rows});assert(service:Flush())
  local global=service:Global(Ranking.Row(f,"101"));same(global.Rows,rows);assert(global.Your.Rank==1)
  local server=service:Server(f,{{UserId=101},{UserId=102},{UserId=103}},{UserId=101})
  assert(server.Rows[1].ProgressionRankId==global.Rows[1].ProgressionRankId and server.Your.Rank==1)

 test("Old and stale leaderboard snapshots retain scores without inventing progression ranks",function()
  local old={Version=1,WorldId="qa",Sequence=1,SavedAt=100,Rows={{UserId=101,Cents=90000,Eligible=true,Rank=1,Tier="10K Trader"}}}
  local service=Service.new({Store={GetAsync=function()return old end},Now=function()return 1000 end})
  local result=service:Global({UserId=101,Cents=90000,Eligible=true})
