server/ReplyBuffer.luau:
-- Bounded per-connection acknowledgement queue (server only).
-- Replies wait for the player's next market packet. A client that never subscribes, or stops reading,
-- keeps at most MaxReplies acknowledgements, each for at most MaxAgeSeconds. Every reply path (accepted,
-- rejected, queue-full and paused) goes through Push, so none of them can grow server memory without bound.
-- When anything is dropped the connection is marked Full: its next packet is a complete authoritative
-- snapshot (positions, orders, history, portfolio and stats) and carries RepliesDropped, so the client
-- never depends on an expired acknowledgement to learn the current state.
local ReplyBuffer={MaxReplies=64,MaxAgeSeconds=30}
ReplyBuffer.__index=ReplyBuffer
function ReplyBuffer.new(maxReplies,maxAgeSeconds)
 return setmetatable({MaxReplies=math.max(1,maxReplies or ReplyBuffer.MaxReplies),MaxAgeSeconds=maxAgeSeconds or ReplyBuffer.MaxAgeSeconds},ReplyBuffer)
end
local function drop(state,count)
 if count<=0 then return end
 local replies,times=state.Replies,state.ReplyTimes
 table.move(replies,count+1,#replies+count,1)
 table.move(times,count+1,#times+count,1)
 state.DroppedReplies=(state.DroppedReplies or 0)+count
 state.Full=true
end
function ReplyBuffer:Prune(state,now)
 state.Replies=state.Replies or {} state.ReplyTimes=state.ReplyTimes or {}
 local times,expired=state.ReplyTimes,0
 while times[expired+1] and now-times[expired+1]>self.MaxAgeSeconds do expired+=1 end
 drop(state,expired)
 return expired
end
function ReplyBuffer:Push(state,reply,now)
 self:Prune(state,now)
 drop(state,#state.Replies-self.MaxReplies+1)

end
-- Hands the queued replies to one outgoing packet and clears the queue.
function ReplyBuffer:Take(state)
 local replies,dropped=state.Replies or {},state.DroppedReplies

server/RequestJournal.luau:
-- Persisted per-player request session/high-water mark. Evicting old replies never
-- makes an old id executable again. Reconnect retires the previous session.
local Journal={MaxReplies=128}
function Journal.Open(e,uid)
 e.RequestJournal=e.RequestJournal or {}
 local old=e.RequestJournal[uid]
 local state={Session=(old and old.Session or 0)+1,High=0,Replies={},Order={}}
 e.RequestJournal[uid]=state
 return state.Session
end
function Journal.Begin(e,uid,session,id)
 local state=e.RequestJournal and e.RequestJournal[uid]
 if not state or session~=state.Session then return false,nil,'Connection changed. Refresh the account before submitting a new request.'end
 local cached=state.Replies[tostring(id)]
 if cached then return false,cached end
 if id<=state.High then return false,nil,'Request already processed. Check the authoritative account snapshot.'end
 state.High=id -- consumed before any mutation; a retry cannot repeat a partial failure
 return true
end
function Journal.Finish(e,uid,session,id,result)
 local state=e.RequestJournal and e.RequestJournal[uid]
 if not state or state.Session~=session then return end
 local key=tostring(id)
 if not state.Replies[key]then table.insert(state.Order,key)end
 state.Replies[key]=result
 if #state.Order>Journal.MaxReplies then state.Replies[table.remove(state.Order,1)]=nil end
end
function Journal.Cached(e,uid,session,id)
 local state=e and e.RequestJournal and e.RequestJournal[uid]
 return state and state.Session==session and state.Replies[tostring(id)]or nil
end
return Journal

-- Fixed-sized FIFO batches. A wall-clock-dependent cut would change which
-- simulation step receives an accepted order, so batching is count-based.
local Queue={BatchSize=16,Capacity=256}
function Queue.Take(queue)
 local count=math.min(#queue,Queue.BatchSize);local batch=table.create(count)
 for i=1,count do batch[i]=queue[i]end
 local remaining=table.create(#queue-count)
 for i=count+1,#queue do remaining[i-count]=queue[i]end
 return batch,remaining
end
return Queue

 local function test(name,fn)local ok,value=pcall(fn);table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (value or "Passed") or tostring(value)})end
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ F3 replies
 test("F3: reply queues stay bounded by count and age for clients that never subscribe",function()
  local buffer=ReplyBuffer.new(Settings.MaxQueuedReplies,Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds)
  local state={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}};local now=0
  for i=1,10000 do
   now+=1/6 -- the remote limiter's sustained rate
   local kind=i%3==0 and {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Exchange busy. Please retry."} or i%3==1 and {RequestId=i,Ok=true,Message="Saved.",Kind="Start"} or {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Rejected"}
   buffer:Push(state,kind,now)
   assert(#state.Replies<=Settings.MaxQueuedReplies and #state.ReplyTimes==#state.Replies,"reply queue exceeded its bound")
  end
  equal(#state.Replies,Settings.MaxQueuedReplies);assert(state.Full and state.DroppedReplies==10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies)
  equal(state.Replies[#state.Replies].RequestId,10000,"newest reply kept");equal(state.Replies[1].RequestId,10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies+1)

  equal(#state.Replies,0);equal(state.DroppedReplies,nil)

  state.Full=false

  buffer:Prune(state,now+Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds+0.01);equal(#state.Replies,0);assert(state.Full,"expiry forces a full resync")
  local _,expired=buffer:Take(state);equal(expired,5)
  -- A normally subscribed client (flushed every broadcast) never loses a reply.
  local live={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}}
  for i=1,200 do buffer:Push(live,{RequestId=i},i*0.1);if i%1==0 then local got,lost=buffer:Take(live);equal(#got,1);equal(lost,nil) end end
 end)

-- A simulation step is atomic. Preserve every remaining step for a later frame,
-- but do not run a long catch-up batch before the client can receive an update.
local Scheduler={}
function Scheduler.Advance(backlog,config,advance,clock,started)
 clock=clock or os.clock;started=started or clock()
 local steps=0;local limited=false
 local budget=(config.SimulationFrameBudgetMs or 8)/1000
 while backlog>=config.StepSeconds and steps<config.MaxCatchupSteps do
  if steps>0 and clock()-started>=budget then limited=true;break end
  if advance()==false then break end
  backlog-=config.StepSeconds;steps+=1
 end
 return backlog,steps,limited
end
return Scheduler

-- Test fixtures only. Production modules never require this file.
-- Legacy account/profile tests now post actual counterpart orders instead of relying on house fills.
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local T={}
function T.Offer(e,key,side,qty,price)
 local id="fixture:liquidity:"..key..":"..side
 e:AddAccount(id,1e12-1,1000000,.99,false)
 local ok,result=e:Submit(id,{Contract=key,Direction=side,Quantity=qty,Type="Limit",Price=price})
 assert(ok,tostring(result));return result
end
function T.Ensure(e,id,r)
 local a=e.Accounts[id];local b=e.Books[r.Contract]
 if not a or not a.Player or not b or r.Type~="Market"or type(r.Quantity)~="number"or r.Quantity<1 or r.Quantity%1~=0 then return end
 if not r.ReduceOnly and (a.Locked or e:OrderCapacity(a,r.Contract,r.Direction)<r.Quantity)then return end
 local levels=r.Direction==1 and b.Asks or b.Bids;local qty=0;local ticks=b.Last or b.Reference
 for _,l in ipairs(levels)do for _,o in ipairs(l.Orders)do
  local other=e.Accounts[o.Owner]
  local same=o.Owner==id or a.Group and a.Group==other.Group or a.ProfileId and a.ProfileId==other.ProfileId
  local available=not same and e:_available(o,true)or 0
  if available>0 then qty+=available;ticks=l.Price end
 end end
 if qty<r.Quantity then T.Offer(e,r.Contract,-r.Direction,r.Quantity-qty,ticks*b.Spec.Tick)end
end
function T.Submit(e,id,r,...)
 T.Ensure(e,id,r);return e:Submit(id,r,...)
end
function T.Perform(e,id,r)
 local p=e.Accounts[id]and e.Accounts[id].Positions[r.Contract]
 if r.Action=="Close"and p then T.Ensure(e,id,{Contract=r.Contract,Direction=-p.Direction,Quantity=p.Quantity,Type="Market",ReduceOnly=true})
 elseif r.Action=="Place"then T.Ensure(e,id,r)end
 return F.Perform(e,id,r)
end
return T

     check(math.abs(p.Dollars-amount)<=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*qty/2+.001 or p.Ticks==1,"nearest valid total")

    end
   end

 end

 local e=E.new(Config,41)

 local ok,r=Liquidity.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=3,Type="Limit",Price=price,StopDollars=100,TargetDollars=200})
 check(ok,"place dollar-protected limit")
 local id=r.Id local o=e.Orders[id]
 check(o.StopTicks==3 and o.TargetTicks==5,"server converts totals using quantity")
 local function req(p,expected,qty)return {Action="AmendOrder",Contract="BX",OrderId=id,Price=p,ExpectedPrice=expected or price,ExpectedQuantity=qty or 3}end
 local function reject(owner,r)
  local old=o.Price local accepted=F.Perform(e,owner,r)
  check(not accepted and o.Price==old and e.Orders[id]==o,"rejection is atomic")
 end
 reject("other",req(price+1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+.1))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,price+2))
 reject(a.Id,req(price+1,nil,2))
 reject(a.Id,req(spec.Last*2))
 a.Locked=true;reject(a.Id,req(price+1));a.Locked=false
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(price+1)),"accepted amendment")
 check(o.Price*spec.Tick==price+1 and o.Id==id and o.Remaining==3 and o.StopTicks==3,"preserves identity, quantity, protection")
 price+=1
 Liquidity.Offer(e,"BX",-1,3,spec.Last)
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(spec.Last+10)),"marketable amendment accepted")
 check(not e.Orders[id] and a.Positions.BX.Quantity==3,"marketable amendment fills normally")

 check(math.abs((p.Target-p.Entry)*spec.Multiplier*3-187.5)<.001,"chart target reflects effective total")
 check(not F.Perform(e,a.Id,req(price)),"filled order cannot be amended")
 local accepted,v=e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=spec.Last+30})
 check(accepted and e:Cancel(a.Id,v.Id) and not e.Orders[v.Id],"cancel exact pending order")
 check(a.Positions.BX.Quantity==3,"cancel leaves position intact")
 check(not e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market",StopDollars=100,StopTicks=10}),"reject ambiguous units")
 -- A hand-moved SL/TP keeps its exact price when the position grows; it still protects the whole position.
 local held,book=a.Positions.BX,e.Books.BX
 book.Last=book.Reference+8 -- the add fills 2 points higher, so the average entry moves
 local movedStop,movedTarget=held.Stop-1.25,held.Target+2.5
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="AmendProtection",Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection="Stop",Price=movedStop,ExpectedPrice=held.Stop}),"move SL")
 check(F.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="AmendProtection",Contract="BX",OrderId=held.Id,Protection="Target",Price=movedTarget,ExpectedPrice=held.Target}),"move TP")
 local entry=held.Entry
 check(Liquidity.Perform(e,a.Id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=2,Type="Market",StopDollars=100,TargetDollars=200}),"add to the position")
 check(a.Positions.BX==held and held.Quantity==5 and held.Entry>entry,"add fills into the same position at a new average")

 local covered=0
 for _,o in ipairs(e:Snapshot(a.Id,"BX","1m",false).Orders)do if o.Protection and o.Id==held.Id and o.Quantity==5 then covered+=1 end end

 check(e:CancelProtection(a.Id,held.Id,"Stop") and not held.Stop and not held.ManualStop,"cancelling a moved SL clears its manual flag")

   local events=f:TakeEvents("preferences-test");assert(#events==1 and events[1].Reason=="Player close"and events[1].TradeId)
  end
  assert(f:Profile("preferences-test").Awards.FirstTrade,"Titles still earned without expanding the toast")
 end)
 return rows
end
return Tests
server/TradeStats.luau:
-- Authoritative lifetime trading statistics, stored on each player account inside the exchange checkpoint.
-- A "completed trade" is one closing execution: exactly one row of the account's Trade History. A partial
-- close records the contracts it closed; the rest count when they close. A reversal counts its closing part.
-- Counters are updated by MarketEngine on the same execution that changes Balance/Realized, so they save and
-- restore atomically with the ledger. Display history is bounded (MaxAccountHistory); these counters are not.
local Stats={Version=1,EvenCents=0}
local EPS=0.005 -- half a cent: reconciliation tolerance for floating-point P&L

-- Calendar days are [00:00:00, 24:00:00) UTC, from the server's close timestamp.
-- Simulation HH:MM:SS is deliberately never treated as a historical calendar date.
local function dayRow()
 return {Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0}
end
function Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local stamp=row.ClosedAt
 if type(stamp)=="number" and stamp==stamp and stamp>0 and stamp<1e12 then
  local key=tostring(math.floor(stamp/86400))
  local d=s.Days[key] or dayRow() s.Days[key]=d
  local pnl=row.Pnl or 0 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
  d.Trades+=1 d.Net+=pnl
  if cents>0 then d.Wins+=1 elseif cents<0 then d.Losses+=1 else d.Even+=1 end
  if pnl>0 then d.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then d.Loss-=pnl end
  d.Best=math.max(d.Best or pnl,pnl) d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or pnl,pnl)
  s.FirstClosedAt=math.min(s.FirstClosedAt or stamp,stamp)
 end
 s.DayLastTradeId=math.max(s.DayLastTradeId or 0,row.TradeId or 0)
end
function Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 if s.DayV~=1 then s.DayV=1 s.Days={} s.DayLastTradeId=0 end
 -- Also repairs dates retained after an older server updated lifetime counters but not days.
 local last=s.DayLastTradeId or 0
 for i=#(rows or {}),1,-1 do local row=rows[i]
  if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>last and row.TradeId<=(s.LastTradeId or 0) then Stats.TrackDay(s,row) end
 end
end

function Stats.New(origin,now)
 return {V=Stats.Version,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Best=nil,Worst=nil,LastTradeId=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Origin=origin or "Live",Since=now,DayV=1,Days={},DayLastTradeId=0}
end
-- Classify by the cent: a result that rounds to $0.00 is break-even. Sums use the exact values so that
-- Gains - Loss equals the ledger's realized total.
function Stats.Add(s,row)
 Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local pnl=row.Pnl or 0
 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
 s.Trades+=1
 if cents>Stats.EvenCents then s.Wins+=1 elseif cents<-Stats.EvenCents then s.Losses+=1 else s.Even+=1 end
 if pnl>0 then s.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then s.Loss-=pnl end
 if s.Best==nil or pnl>s.Best then s.Best=pnl end
 if s.Worst==nil or pnl<s.Worst then s.Worst=pnl end
 if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>s.LastTradeId then s.LastTradeId=row.TradeId end
end
function Stats.Tracked(s) return s.Gains-s.Loss end

-- Depletion is recorded per attempt, once. New executions set Depleted when the engine latches Locked at
-- $0 equity. Saved attempts from before this marker existed are classified from their final state.
function Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 -- An archive record aggregates many finished attempts; each was classified before it was folded.
 if a.Archive or a.MigrationArchived or a.Depleted or a.Breached or not a.Locked or not a.Player then return end
 local equity=engine:Summary(a).Equity
 -- Checkpoint v3 reopened every positive-equity account that older loss rules had locked, so a current
 -- (not retired) locked account is depleted. A retired attempt still holding most of its capital was
 -- restarted under the earlier loss-limit rules and is reported separately, not as blown.
 if equity<=0 or not a.Retired or a.Balance<=a.Base*0.5 then a.Depleted=true
 else a.Breached="Earlier loss limit" end
end

-- Idempotent migration + drift repair. Safe to call on every restore.
--  * Accounts without Stats are rebuilt from their saved Trade History. When the rows reconcile with the
--    ledger (realized total, and the completed-trade counter when present) and the history was never trimmed,
--    the rebuild is complete ("Recovered"). Otherwise the unmatched part is kept as an untracked remainder
--    ("Partial") so Net realized still equals the ledger, and the UI labels the breakdown period.
--  * Accounts with Stats pick up any retained rows newer than LastTradeId (e.g. written by an older server
--    build), and any remaining mismatch is moved into the untracked remainder. Nothing is ever counted twice.
function Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,now)
 if not a.Player then return nil end
 local max=engine.Config.MaxAccountHistory or 60
 local rows=a.History or {}
 local s=a.Stats local fresh=type(s)~="table" or s.V~=Stats.Version
 if fresh then s=Stats.New("Recovered",now) a.Stats=s end
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 -- History is newest first. Skip the scan when the newest row is already counted.
 local newest=rows[1]
 if fresh or (newest and type(newest.TradeId)=="number" and newest.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then
  for i=#rows,1,-1 do
   local h=rows[i]
   if fresh or (type(h.TradeId)=="number" and h.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then Stats.Add(s,h) end
  end
 end
 local gap=a.Realized-(Stats.Tracked(s)+s.UntrackedNet)
 local ledger=a.CompletedTrades
 if fresh then
  local trimmed=#rows>=max
  local countKnown=(ledger==nil and not trimmed) or ledger==s.Trades
  if math.abs(gap)<EPS and countKnown then
   s.Origin=#rows>0 and "Recovered" or "Live"
   -- The completed-trade counter predates some saves; a complete rebuild makes it exact.
   if ledger==nil and s.Trades>0 then a.CompletedTrades=s.Trades end
  else
   s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=now
   s.UntrackedNet=gap
   s.UntrackedTrades=math.max(0,(ledger or #rows)-s.Trades)
   -- A counter that started from an already-trimmed history can itself undercount. Say so.
   s.CountUnknown=trimmed and ledger~=s.Trades
  end
 else
  if math.abs(gap)>=EPS then s.UntrackedNet+=gap s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
  local counted=s.Trades+s.UntrackedTrades
  if ledger and ledger>counted then s.UntrackedTrades+=ledger-counted s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
 end
 Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 return s
end

-- Folds one finished attempt's lifetime counters into an archive record. Every field is additive or an
-- extreme (best/worst, first/last), so the archive reports exactly what the separate attempts reported.
function Stats.Merge(into,s)
 Stats.EnsureDays(into) Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do into[k]+=s[k] or 0 end
 if s.Best~=nil and (into.Best==nil or s.Best>into.Best) then into.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (into.Worst==nil or s.Worst<into.Worst) then into.Worst=s.Worst end
 into.LastTradeId=math.max(into.LastTradeId or 0,s.LastTradeId or 0)
 into.DayLastTradeId=math.max(into.DayLastTradeId or 0,s.DayLastTradeId or 0)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=into.Days[key] or dayRow() into.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then into.FirstClosedAt=math.min(into.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if s.Since then into.Since=math.min(into.Since or s.Since,s.Since) end
 into.CountUnknown=into.CountUnknown==true or s.CountUnknown==true
 into.RecoveredAny=into.RecoveredAny or s.RecoveredAny or s.Origin=="Recovered" or nil
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  into.Origin="Partial"
  if s.PartialSince then into.PartialSince=math.min(into.PartialSince or s.PartialSince,s.PartialSince) end
 elseif into.Origin~="Partial" and into.RecoveredAny then into.Origin="Recovered" end
 return into
end
-- Aggregation used by every Stats scope. Open P&L comes from the live engine summary of open positions.
function Stats.Empty()
 return {Attempts=0,Blown=0,Breached=0,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0,Open=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Partial=false,Recovered=false,Since=nil,Days={}}
end
function Stats.Include(agg,engine,a)
 local s=a.Stats or Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,os.time())
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,a.History)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=agg.Days[key] or dayRow() agg.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then agg.FirstClosedAt=math.min(agg.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if a.Archive then
  -- Folded finished attempts keep their own attempt/blown/breached classification.
  agg.Attempts+=a.Archive.Attempts agg.Blown+=a.Archive.Blown agg.Breached+=a.Archive.Breached
 else
  agg.Attempts+=1
  if a.Depleted then agg.Blown+=1 elseif a.Breached then agg.Breached+=1 end
 end
 if s.RecoveredAny then agg.Recovered=true end
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do agg[k]+=s[k] end
 agg.Net+=a.Realized
 if not a.Retired then agg.Open+=engine:Summary(a).Unrealized end
 if s.Best~=nil and (agg.Best==nil or s.Best>agg.Best) then agg.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (agg.Worst==nil or s.Worst<agg.Worst) then agg.Worst=s.Worst end
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  agg.Partial=true agg.CountUnknown=agg.CountUnknown or s.CountUnknown
  if s.PartialSince and (agg.Since==nil or s.PartialSince<agg.Since) then agg.Since=s.PartialSince end
 elseif s.Origin=="Recovered" then agg.Recovered=true end
 return agg
end
-- Derived values, computed once on the server so every client shows the same numbers.
function Stats.Finish(agg,datedOnly)
 if math.abs(agg.UntrackedNet)<EPS then agg.UntrackedNet=0 end
 agg.Total=agg.Net+agg.Open
 agg.WinRate=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Wins/agg.Trades or nil
 agg.AllTrades=agg.Trades+agg.UntrackedTrades
 if not agg.CountUnknown and agg.AllTrades>0 then agg.Average=agg.Net/agg.AllTrades agg.AverageScope="All"
 elseif agg.Trades>0 then agg.Average=(agg.Gains-agg.Loss)/agg.Trades agg.AverageScope="Tracked" end
 agg.AvgWin=agg.Wins>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Wins or nil
 agg.AvgLoss=agg.Losses>0 and agg.Loss/agg.Losses or nil
 agg.WinLossRatio=agg.AvgLoss and agg.AvgLoss>0 and (agg.AvgWin or 0)/agg.AvgLoss or nil
 agg.ProfitFactor=agg.Loss>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Loss or nil
 agg.NoLosses=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Gains>0 and agg.Loss==0
 local dated=Stats.Empty() local days,wins,lossDays,dayTrades,best=0,0,0,0,nil
 for _,day in pairs(agg.Days or {}) do
  days+=1 dayTrades+=day.Trades
  if math.round(day.Net*100)>0 then wins+=1 end
  if math.round(day.Net*100)<0 then lossDays+=1 end
  best=math.max(best or day.Net,day.Net)
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do dated[k]+=day[k] end
 end
 agg.UndatedTrades=math.max(0,agg.AllTrades-dayTrades)
 agg.DayCount=days agg.WinningDays=wins agg.LosingDays=lossDays agg.BestDay=best
 agg.DailyComplete=agg.UndatedTrades==0 and not agg.CountUnknown and not agg.Partial
 agg.DayWinRate=agg.DailyComplete and days>0 and wins/days or nil
 agg.BestDayShare=agg.DailyComplete and best and best>0 and agg.Net>=EPS and best/agg.Net or nil
 if not datedOnly then
  dated.Days=agg.Days dated.FirstClosedAt=agg.FirstClosedAt
  dated.Attempts=agg.Attempts dated.Blown=agg.Blown dated.Breached=agg.Breached
  agg.Dated=Stats.Finish(dated,true)
 end
 -- Day buckets remain on the saved account; only compact derived results cross the network.
 agg.Days=nil
 return agg
end
return Stats
server/WorldCheckpoint.luau:
-- Lossless execution state, including FIFO identity and the participants' next random draw.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Encoding=game:GetService("EncodingService")
-- Version 3 introduces E-minis, retained close-only micro books and equity-only failure.
-- Version 4 adds armed stop entry orders, which wait off the order book. An older build would
-- rest them as limits, so it must fail closed on V4. V1-V3 are read unchanged.
-- Version 5 executes player orders off the order book against a saved house counterparty account. An older
-- build would rest player limits in the book again and liquidate the house as a bot, so it fails closed on V5.
-- V5 originally moved V1-V4 player limits off-book; V9 now cancels pre-V9 player limits on migration.
-- V6 permanently separates tier access, account instances and Shop receipts. Older writers must
-- refuse it, otherwise they could reset permanent entitlements or spend the wallet twice.
-- V7 renames ES/NQ to BX/BT, keeps RTY/YM only as retired close-only books and adds BG. Older builds
-- cannot map those markets, so they must refuse V7. V1-V6 saves migrate on restore (see plan and rename).
-- V8 adds the single-account profile. Older writers must fail closed.
-- V9 makes player limits executable book liquidity and persists amendment priority.
-- Pre-V9 pending player limits are cancelled during migration rather than retroactively matched.
-- V10 adds permanent reward grants, player resets and disconnect accounting. Older writers
-- must fail closed so they cannot discard an acknowledged summary or reset a granted bonus.
-- V11 adds scalpers with their own entry/exit state. Older writers must not resume them as generic traders.
-- V12 persists queued market/limit execution and aggregate budgets. Older matching engines must fail closed.
-- V13 adds position-linked working targets and keeps stops on partially closed positions.
-- Older engines must not resume these orders with the old OCO and entry-budget rules.
-- V14 persists pending resets that must liquidate before granting a new account.
-- Older builds must not discard this exposure or allow trading during liquidation.
-- V15 records bot capital adjustments, exact populations and retiring obligations. Older writers fail closed.
-- V16 applies one execution collar to all participants and persists request deduplication.
-- Older writers must not restore a market and resume asymmetric executions.
-- V17 persists bot P&L baselines and refresh receipts. Older engines must not settle
-- refreshed positions against their strategy entries or discard the frozen P&L ledger.
-- V18 persists the strategy-only policy and time-based signal histories. Older engines must
-- not resume these checkpoints with different entry rules. This migration never funds bots.
-- V19 archives settled legacy books and accounts outside the active simulation.
-- Their cash/equity/volume remain in the audit ledger; older writers must fail closed.
-- V20 removes private reversal signals and adds passive liquidity risk controls.
-- Restore changes policy only; balances, live orders and positions are preserved until the next decision.
-- V21 limits trading strategies to public data and retires saved private entry intent.
-- V22 removes generated valuation and persists execution-derived price announcements.
-- V23 expands funded populations without rewriting existing bots or recapitalizing losses.
-- V24 persists participant inventory objectives and delayed reserve replenishment.
-- V25 preserves participation recovery clocks, fill counters and zero-sum funding transfers.
-- V26 persists Momentum profiles, sampled history, independent RNG and lifecycle state.
-- V27 persists patient Whale mandates, child reservations, fill baselines and private RNG.
-- V28 versions shorter Momentum horizons and staggered Maker replacement clocks.
-- Migration changes policy only; positions, orders, protections and ledgers remain intact.
local Checkpoint={Version=28,Readable={[28]=true,[1]=true,[2]=true,[3]=true,[4]=true,[5]=true,[6]=true,[7]=true,[8]=true,[9]=true,[10]=true,[11]=true,[12]=true,[13]=true,[14]=true,[15]=true,[16]=true,[17]=true,[18]=true,[19]=true,[20]=true,[21]=true,[22]=true,[23]=true,[24]=true,[25]=true,[26]=true,[27]=true}}
local function digest(raw)
 local bytes=Encoding:ComputeStringHash(raw,Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256)
 return (bytes:gsub(".",function(c)return string.format("%02x",string.byte(c))end))
end
local function clone(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={} for key,v in pairs(value)do result[key]=clone(v)end return result
end
-- Maps each saved market to its current symbol (config.Renamed) and checks its economics: every saved market
-- must still exist as a current or retired (close-only) contract with the same tick and multiplier. The
-- restored order is every current market, then the retired markets the save held. A current market the
-- save lacks opens as a new book after restore (`added`).
local function plan(saved,current)
 assert(saved.StepSeconds==current.StepSeconds,"Saved market step size differs from configuration")
 local renamed,held,map=current.Renamed or {},{},{}
 for _,key in ipairs(saved.ContractOrder)do
  local name=renamed[key] or key
  local a,b=saved.Contracts[key],current.Contracts[name] or current.LegacyContracts[name]
  assert(a and b and not held[name] and a.Tick==b.Tick and a.Multiplier==b.Multiplier,"Saved contract specification changed: "..key)
  held[name]=true map[key]=name
 end
 local order,added={},{}
 for _,key in ipairs(current.ContractOrder)do table.insert(order,key) if not held[key] then added[key]=true end end
 for _,key in ipairs(current.LegacyOrder)do if held[key] and not current.Contracts[key] then table.insert(order,key) end end
 assert(#saved.Timeframes==#current.Timeframes,"Saved timeframes differ")
 for i,tf in ipairs(current.Timeframes)do assert(saved.Timeframes[i][1]==tf[1]and saved.Timeframes[i][2]==tf[2],"Saved timeframe changed")end
 return map,order,added
end
-- Moves renamed markets in saved state: table keys and the fields that name a market (Contract, Key) take the
-- current symbol. Saved ids stay opaque and unchanged (for example participant accounts "bot:ES:Maker:1").
local function rename(value,map,field)
 if type(value)=="string"then return (field=="Contract"or field=="Key")and map[value]or value end
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={}
 for key,v in pairs(value)do result[type(key)=="string"and map[key]or key]=rename(v,map,key)end
 return result
end
local function capture(engine,population,borrow)
 local function take(value)return borrow and value or clone(value)end
 local e={Accounts={},Books={},Orders={},Profiles=take(engine.Profiles or {}),MarketRetirement=take(engine.MarketRetirement)}
 for _,key in ipairs({"Seed","Time","Step","NextOrder","NextPriority","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops","Execution","EligibilityRevision","RequestJournal","ExecutionDiagnostics","CloseNotificationErrors","LastCloseNotificationError"})do e[key]=take(engine[key])end
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder)do
  local a=borrow and table.clone(engine.Accounts[id])or clone(engine.Accounts[id]);a.OpenOrders=nil
  -- Bot histories are display-only; balances, cash ledger and inventory are retained exactly.
  if not a.Player then a.History={} a.Fills={}end
  table.insert(e.Accounts,a)
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(engine.Config.ContractOrder)do
  local book={}
  for field,value in pairs(engine.Books[key])do if field~="Bids"and field~="Asks"and field~="Spec"then book[field]=take(value)end end
  e.Books[key]=book
 end
 local ids={}for id in pairs(engine.Orders)do table.insert(ids,id)end table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do table.insert(e.Orders,take(engine.Orders[id]))end
 local p={RandomState=population.Random.State}
 for key,value in pairs(population)do if key~="Engine"and key~="Config"and key~="Random"then p[key]=take(value)end end
 return {Version=Checkpoint.Version,Config=take(engine.Config),Engine=e,Population=p}
end
function Checkpoint.Capture(engine,population)
 return capture(engine,population,false) -- Independently mutable fixture/checkpoint copy.
end
function Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,currentConfig)
 assert(type(snapshot)=="table"and Checkpoint.Readable[snapshot.Version],"Unsupported saved market format")
 local map,order,added=plan(snapshot.Config,currentConfig)
 for old,name in pairs(map)do if old~=name then snapshot=rename(snapshot,map) break end end
 -- Preserve saved behavior except explicit, versioned migrations; presentation cadence may change.
 local config=clone(snapshot.Config)
 assert((config.MakerQuotePolicyVersion or 0)<=(currentConfig.MakerQuotePolicyVersion or 0),'Cannot downgrade Maker quote policy')
 local whale=currentConfig.BotWhale and currentConfig.BotWhale.Version or 0
 local savedWhale=config.BotWhale and config.BotWhale.Version or 0
 assert(savedWhale<=whale,'Cannot downgrade Whale policy')
 if savedWhale<whale then config.BotWhale=clone(currentConfig.BotWhale)end
 local momentum=currentConfig.BotMomentum and currentConfig.BotMomentum.Version or 0
 local savedMomentum=config.BotMomentum and config.BotMomentum.Version or 0
 assert(savedMomentum<=momentum,'Cannot downgrade Momentum policy')
 if savedMomentum<momentum then config.BotMomentum=clone(currentConfig.BotMomentum)end
 local flow=currentConfig.OrderFlowMarket and currentConfig.OrderFlowMarket.Version or 0
 assert((config.OrderFlowMarket and config.OrderFlowMarket.Version or 0)<=flow,'Cannot downgrade order-driven market policy')
 if (config.OrderFlowMarket and config.OrderFlowMarket.Version or 0)<flow then
  config.OrderFlowMarket=clone(currentConfig.OrderFlowMarket);config.Regimes=clone(currentConfig.Regimes);config.NewsFrequency=0
 end
 local pressure=currentConfig.BotOrderFlow and currentConfig.BotOrderFlow.Version or 0
 local savedPressure=config.BotOrderFlow and config.BotOrderFlow.Version or 0
 assert(savedPressure<=pressure,'Cannot downgrade participant order-flow policy')
 if savedPressure<pressure then config.BotOrderFlow=clone(currentConfig.BotOrderFlow)end
 local participation=currentConfig.BotParticipation and currentConfig.BotParticipation.Version or 0
 local savedParticipation=config.BotParticipation and config.BotParticipation.Version or 0
 assert(savedParticipation<=participation,'Cannot downgrade bot participation policy')
 if savedParticipation<participation then config.BotParticipation=clone(currentConfig.BotParticipation)end
 local information=currentConfig.BotInformationVersion or 0
 assert((config.BotInformationVersion or 0)<=information,'Cannot downgrade bot information policy')
 config.BotInformationVersion=information>0 and information or nil
 local retirement=currentConfig.MarketRetirementVersion or 0
 assert((config.MarketRetirementVersion or 0)<=retirement,'Cannot downgrade market retirement policy')
 config.MarketRetirementVersion=retirement>0 and retirement or nil
 local savedSignals=config.BotSignals and config.BotSignals.Version or 0
 local currentSignals=currentConfig.BotSignals and currentConfig.BotSignals.Version or 0
 assert(savedSignals<=currentSignals,"Cannot downgrade bot signal policy")
 if savedSignals<currentSignals then config.BotSignals=clone(currentConfig.BotSignals)end
 local savedLiquidity=config.BotLiquidity and config.BotLiquidity.Version or 0
 local currentLiquidity=currentConfig.BotLiquidity and currentConfig.BotLiquidity.Version or 0
 assert(savedLiquidity<=currentLiquidity,'Cannot downgrade bot liquidity policy')
 if savedLiquidity<currentLiquidity then config.BotLiquidity=clone(currentConfig.BotLiquidity)end
 local savedPolicy=snapshot.Population.PolicyVersion or 0
 if savedPolicy>0 then
  assert(config.BotPopulation and config.BotPopulation.Version==savedPolicy,"Inconsistent saved bot policy")
  if currentConfig.BotPopulation and savedPolicy==currentConfig.BotPopulation.Version then
   for _,kind in ipairs(currentConfig.BotPopulation.Order)do
    assert(config.BotPopulation.Counts[kind]==currentConfig.BotPopulation.Counts[kind]
     and config.BotPopulation.Capital[kind]==currentConfig.BotPopulation.Capital[kind],"Bot allocation changes require a policy version bump")
   end
  end
 end
 local upgradeBots=(snapshot.Population.PolicyVersion or 0)<(currentConfig.BotPopulation and currentConfig.BotPopulation.Version or 0)
 assert((snapshot.Population.PolicyVersion or 0)<=(currentConfig.BotPopulation and currentConfig.BotPopulation.Version or 0),"Cannot downgrade bot population policy")
 if upgradeBots then
  if savedPolicy>=1 then
   for _,kind in ipairs(currentConfig.BotPopulation.Order)do
    assert(config.BotPopulation.Counts[kind]<=currentConfig.BotPopulation.Counts[kind]
     and config.BotPopulation.Capital[kind]==currentConfig.BotPopulation.Capital[kind],"Population expansion must preserve existing allocation and funding")
   end
  end
  for _,key in ipairs({"BotPopulation","MakersPerInstrument","ParticipantsPerInstrument","WhalesPerInstrument","ScalpersPerInstrument","Scalper","Reserve"})do config[key]=clone(currentConfig[key])end
 end
 local upgradeReserves=(config.ReservePopulationVersion or 0)<(currentConfig.ReservePopulationVersion or 0)
 if upgradeReserves then config.Reserve=clone(currentConfig.Reserve);config.ReservePopulationVersion=currentConfig.ReservePopulationVersion end

 -- larger differences still fail Audit. New settlement derives Balance from that ledger.

 require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts).new(engine,require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig),currentConfig)

-- The reader's decompressed-size bound. It is unchanged, so every checkpoint that opened before still opens.
-- Encode refuses anything larger before compressing, so the writer and the reader enforce one bound: every
-- checkpoint the writer accepts decodes, and every save that decodes today can be written again.
Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes=32000000
-- The reader's header rules, shared by Encode (before a commit) and Decode (on restore).
function Checkpoint.Check(record,maxDecodedBytes)
 assert(type(record)=="table" and Checkpoint.Readable[record.Version] and record.Codec=="zstd-base64" and type(record.Payload)=="string","Invalid checkpoint encoding")
 local compressed=Encoding:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(record.Payload))
 local bytes=Encoding:GetDecompressedBufferSize(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
 assert(bytes and bytes==record.RawBytes and bytes<=math.min(maxDecodedBytes or Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes,Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes),"Invalid checkpoint length")
 return compressed,bytes
end
function Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot,maxRawBytes)
 local raw=Http:JSONEncode(snapshot)
 local limit=math.min(maxRawBytes or Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes,Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes)
 if #raw>limit then error(string.format("Exchange checkpoint is too large (%d raw bytes, limit %d); trading paused to protect saved state",#raw,limit),2) end
 local compressed=Encoding:CompressBuffer(buffer.fromstring(raw),Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd,3)
 local record={Version=Checkpoint.Version,Codec="zstd-base64",RawBytes=#raw,
  Digest=digest(raw),
  Payload=buffer.tostring(Encoding:Base64Encode(compressed))}
 Checkpoint.Check(record,limit)
 return record
end
function Checkpoint.Decode(record,maxDecodedBytes)
 local compressed=Checkpoint.Check(record,maxDecodedBytes)
 local raw=buffer.tostring(Encoding:DecompressBuffer(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd))
 assert(digest(raw)==record.Digest,"Checkpoint checksum failed")
 return Http:JSONDecode(raw)
end
function Checkpoint.EncodeWorld(engine,population,maxRawBytes)
 -- No borrowed table escapes this non-yielding call. EncodingService and JSON
 -- encoding are synchronous; the engine cannot advance between capture and
 -- serialization. Public Capture remains a deep copy for asynchronous consumers.
 return Checkpoint.Encode(capture(engine,population,true),maxRawBytes)
end
return Checkpoint
server/WorldConfig.luau:
-- Server-only storage and ownership settings. Never copy a live checkpoint into ReplicatedStorage.
return {
 Enabled=true,
 StoreName="MarketReign_Continuous_v1",
 WorldKey="primary-exchange",
 LeaseSeconds=90,
 SafetySeconds=15,
 SaveSeconds=15,
 RetrySeconds=5,
 -- Checkpoint size limits, checked before every commit (a refused save pauses trading; the last save stays).
 -- Raw JSON: the writer refuses exactly what the reader refuses (WorldCheckpoint.MaxDecodedBytes, 32,000,000),
 -- so every checkpoint that can be saved can be restored, and every save that restores today can be saved again.
 -- MaxEncodedBytes bounds the WHOLE stored DataStore value (lease fields + compressed checkpoint) plus
 -- RecordHeadroomBytes, below Roblox's 4,194,304-character value limit (the JSON-encoded length). It is above the previous 3,500,000 check
 -- on the checkpoint alone, so no save the previous build accepted can become unsavable after this update.
 MaxEncodedBytes=3600000,
 RecordHeadroomBytes=4096,
 -- Growth headroom. New profiles and free restarts pause once the last saved checkpoint used
 -- CapacityFraction of either limit; a first Start can use the band up to
 -- NewAccountCapacityFraction. Existing accounts keep trading throughout; nothing is deleted.
 CapacityFraction=0.8,
 NewAccountCapacityFraction=0.9,
 -- Per-connection acknowledgement queue. Replies wait for the player's next market packet; a client that
 -- never subscribes keeps at most MaxQueuedReplies, each for at most ReplyMaxAgeSeconds. Dropped replies
 -- force a full state resync on the next packet.
 MaxQueuedReplies=64,
 ReplyMaxAgeSeconds=30,
 -- Unpublished Studio files cannot use Roblox persistence. Keep an explicitly labelled local sandbox.
 AllowUnsavedStudio=true,
 StudioReplaySeed=0, -- A positive value replays a NEW Studio world only; live servers always seed privately.
}
server/WorldLease.luau:
-- One durable record owns both the checkpoint and its writer lease. UpdateAsync fences stale servers.
local Lease={} Lease.__index=Lease
function Lease.new(store,settings,identity,clock)
 return setmetatable({Store=store,Settings=settings,Identity=identity,Now=clock or os.time,Record=nil,Owned=false},Lease)
end
function Lease:Claim()
 local observed
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  if old then assert(old.Version==1,"Unsupported exchange ownership record")end
  observed=old
  local now=self.Now()
  if old and old.LeaseUntil>now and old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then return nil end
  local nextRecord=old and table.clone(old)or{Version=1,WorldId=self.Identity.WorldId,Generation=0,SaveSequence=0,SavedStep=0}
  if nextRecord.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then nextRecord.Generation+=1 end
  nextRecord.Owner=self.Identity.Token nextRecord.JobId=self.Identity.JobId nextRecord.PlaceId=self.Identity.PlaceId
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  return nextRecord
 end)
 self.Record=result or observed
 self.Owned=result~=nil and result.Owner==self.Identity.Token
 return self.Owned,self.Record
end
function Lease:Valid()
 return self.Owned and self.Record~=nil and self.Now()<self.Record.LeaseUntil-self.Settings.SafetySeconds
end
function Lease:Commit(checkpoint,step,release)
 assert(self.Owned and self.Record,"This server does not own the exchange")
 assert(type(checkpoint)=="table"and type(step)=="number","A complete checkpoint is required")
 local generation=self.Record.Generation
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  local now=self.Now()
  if not old or old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token or old.Generation~=generation or old.LeaseUntil<=now or step<old.SavedStep then return nil end
  local nextRecord=table.clone(old)
  nextRecord.Checkpoint=checkpoint nextRecord.SavedStep=step nextRecord.SavedAt=now nextRecord.SaveSequence+=1
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=release and 0 or now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  if release then nextRecord.Owner="" nextRecord.JobId=""end
  return nextRecord
 end)
 if not result then self.Owned=false;error("Exchange ownership changed; stale checkpoint rejected")end
 self.Record=result self.Owned=not release
 return result
end
return Lease

-- A single shared exchange. Follower servers route players to its owner instead of creating another tape.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Checkpoint=require(script.Parent.WorldCheckpoint)
local Lease=require(script.Parent.WorldLease)
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local BotRefresh=require(script.Parent.BotRefresh)
local Settings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local World={} World.__index=World
function World.new(config,options)

 local studio=options.Studio if studio==nil then studio=RunService:IsStudio()end
 local self=setmetatable({Config=config,Settings=options.Settings or Settings,Studio=studio,
  PlaceId=options.PlaceId or game.PlaceId,JobId=options.JobId or game.JobId,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Mode="Connecting",Status="Connecting to the shared exchange",Busy=false,Closing=false,
  Healthy=false,NextSave=0,NextAttempt=0,Epoch=0,Store=options.Store},World)
 self.Identity={Token=Http:GenerateGUID(false),WorldId=Http:GenerateGUID(false),JobId=self.JobId,PlaceId=self.PlaceId}
 -- Private servers cannot be public teleport destinations. They only act as entry lobbies.
 self.CanOwn=options.CanOwn if self.CanOwn==nil then self.CanOwn=studio or game.PrivateServerId==""end
 return self
end
function World:_fresh()
 local seed=self.Studio and self.Settings.StudioReplaySeed or 0
 seed=seed or 0
 if seed==0 then seed=tonumber(Http:GenerateGUID(false):sub(1,8),16)%2147483646+1 end
 local engine=Engine.new(self.Config,seed) local population=Participants.new(engine)
 for i=1,math.floor(self.Config.WarmupSeconds/self.Config.StepSeconds)do
  population:Step() if i%200==0 then task.wait()end
 end
 return engine,population
end
function World:_encode(engine,population)
 engine=engine or self.Engine;population=population or self.Population
 local projection
 if self.CaptureProjection then
  -- Optional read model failures must never prevent an exchange save or trading.
  local ok,result=pcall(self.CaptureProjection,engine)
  if ok then projection=result else warn("[Get Funded!] Leaderboard projection unavailable: "..tostring(result)) end
 end
 -- Raw size is refused by Encode (before compression) with exactly the bound the reader enforces.
 local record=Checkpoint.EncodeWorld(engine,population,Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes)
 -- Measure the complete value UpdateAsync will store: lease fields plus this checkpoint, with headroom.
 local stored=self:_storedBytes(record,engine.Step)
 assert(stored+(self.Settings.RecordHeadroomBytes or 0)<=self.Settings.MaxEncodedBytes,"Exchange checkpoint is too large; trading paused to protect saved state")
 self.LastRawBytes=record.RawBytes self.LastStoredBytes=stored
 return record,engine.Step,projection
end
function World:_storedBytes(record,step)
 local lease=self.Lease and self.Lease.Record
 local shell=lease and table.clone(lease) or {Version=1,WorldId=self.Identity.WorldId,Generation=1,SaveSequence=0}
 local now=self.Now()
 shell.Owner=self.Identity.Token shell.JobId=self.Identity.JobId shell.PlaceId=self.Identity.PlaceId
 shell.Checkpoint=record shell.SavedStep=step or self.Engine.Step shell.SavedAt=now
 shell.SaveSequence=(shell.SaveSequence or 0)+1 shell.LeaseUntil=now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
 return #Http:JSONEncode(shell)
end
-- False once the last saved checkpoint used the configured fraction of either size limit. Only new accounts
-- wait; trading and saving continue, and the unused room absorbs growth of the accounts that already exist.
-- kind "Start"/"Activate" (a first account or an earned tier) may use the band up to NewAccountCapacityFraction.
function World:HasCapacity(kind)
 local fraction=self.Settings.CapacityFraction or 0.8
 if kind=="Start" then fraction=math.max(fraction,self.Settings.NewAccountCapacityFraction or fraction) end
 if (self.LastRawBytes or 0)>=Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes*fraction then return false end
 if (self.LastStoredBytes or 0)>=self.Settings.MaxEncodedBytes*fraction then return false end

end
function World:_committed(rows)
 if not rows then return end
 local r=self.Lease.Record
 self.DurableProjection={Rows=rows,WorldId=r.WorldId,Sequence=r.SaveSequence,SavedAt=r.SavedAt}
end
function World:_sandbox(reason)

function World:Open()
 if self.Closing or self.Busy then return end
 self.Busy=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  if not self.Settings.Enabled or self.PlaceId==0 then
   assert(self.Studio and self.Settings.AllowUnsavedStudio,"Persistent storage is required for the live exchange")
   self:_sandbox(self.PlaceId==0 and "This place is unpublished." or "Persistence is disabled.") return
  end
  if not self.Store then
   self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore(self.Settings.StoreName,self.Studio and "Studio" or "Live")
  end
  self.Lease=self.Lease or Lease.new(self.Store,self.Settings,self.Identity,self.Now)
  local owned,record
  if self.CanOwn then owned,record=self.Lease:Claim()
  else owned=false record=self.Store:GetAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey)end
  if not owned then
   self.Owner=record self.Mode="Following" self.Healthy=false
   self.Status=self.Studio and "Shared Studio exchange is active in another test; stop it before restarting here" or "Joining the shared exchange"
   return
  end
  self.Mode="Loading" self.Status="Restoring the saved exchange"
  -- Everything restored from the store is durable; no in-memory receipt or transaction from a previous engine survives.
  if record.Checkpoint then
   self.Engine,self.Population=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Decode(record.Checkpoint),self.Config)
   assert(self.Engine.Step==record.SavedStep,"Checkpoint step does not match ownership record")
  else
   assert(record.SavedStep==0,"Saved exchange checkpoint is missing")
   self.Engine,self.Population=self:_fresh()
  end

  local encoded,step,projection=self:_encode()
  self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,false)
  self:_committed(projection)
  self.Mode="Shared" self.Status="SHARED · SAVED" self.Healthy=true self.Epoch+=1
  self.NextSave=self.Now()+self.Settings.SaveSeconds
 end)
 self.Busy=false self.NextAttempt=self.Now()+self.Settings.RetrySeconds
 if not ok then
  -- Transient storage failures or corrupt checkpoints must never silently reset an existing market.
  self.Healthy=false self.Mode="Unavailable" self.Status="Saved exchange unavailable · retrying safely"
  self.LastError=tostring(err) warn("[Get Funded!] "..self.LastError)

end
function World:CanRun()
 if self.Closing or self.Transaction or not self.Healthy or not self.Engine then return false end
 return self.Mode=="Local" or (self.Mode=="Shared" and self.Lease:Valid())
end
function World:Label()
 if self.Mode=="Shared" and not self:CanRun()then return "PAUSED · WAITING FOR SAVED EXCHANGE"end
 return self.Status
end
function World:Save(release)
 if self.Busy or not self.Engine or self.Mode~="Shared" then return false end
 self.Busy=true

  local encoded,step,projection=self:_encode()
  self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,release)
  self:_committed(projection)
 end)
 self.Busy=false self.NextSave=self.Now()+(ok and self.Settings.SaveSeconds or self.Settings.RetrySeconds)
 self.Healthy=ok and not release
 if not ok then self.LastError=tostring(err) warn("[Get Funded!] Save failed; exchange paused: "..self.LastError)end

end
-- Freeze execution, transform a detached copy, then swap only after the fenced save confirms it.
-- A timed-out write may have committed: reload durable storage instead of overwriting it with old data.
function World:TransformSaved(transform)
 if self.Busy or self.Mode~="Shared" or not self:CanRun()then return false,"Exchange is not ready."end
 self.Busy=true;self.Transaction=true
 local rawBytes,storedBytes=self.LastRawBytes,self.LastStoredBytes
 local attemptedCommit=false local result
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local engine,population=Checkpoint.Restore(Checkpoint.Capture(self.Engine,self.Population),self.Config)
  result=transform(engine,population);engine:Audit()
  local encoded,step,projection=self:_encode(engine,population)
  assert(not self.CaptureProjection or projection,"Cannot transform saved data without its leaderboard projection")
  attemptedCommit=true;self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,false)
  self.Engine=engine;self.Population=population;self.Epoch+=1
  self:_committed(projection)
 end)
 self.Busy=false;self.Transaction=false

  self.LastRawBytes=rawBytes;self.LastStoredBytes=storedBytes
  self.LastError=tostring(err)
  if attemptedCommit then
   self.Healthy=false;self.Mode="Unavailable";self.Status="Verifying the saved exchange"
   self.Engine=nil;self.Population=nil;self.Epoch+=1
   self.NextAttempt=self.Now()+self.Settings.RetrySeconds
  end
  warn("[Get Funded!] Saved transformation failed: "..self.LastError)
 end

end
-- Called only at the server scheduler boundary. Preview/encode do not yield or write
-- live accounts; the lease commit freezes simulation until its outcome is known.
function World:RefreshBots(sequence,actor)

 local attempted=false;local result
 local rawBytes,storedBytes=self.LastRawBytes,self.LastStoredBytes
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local plan=BotRefresh.Prepare(self.Engine,self.Population,sequence,actor)
  result=plan.Receipt
  if plan.Duplicate then return end

  engine:Audit()

  assert(not self.CaptureProjection or projection,"Cannot refresh without leaderboard projection")
  attempted=true;self.Lease:Commit(encoded,step,false)

  self:_committed(projection)
 end)
 self.Busy=false;self.Transaction=false;self.BotRefreshSaving=false;self.NextSave=self.Now()+self.Settings.SaveSeconds
 if not ok then
  self.LastRawBytes=rawBytes;self.LastStoredBytes=storedBytes;self.LastError=tostring(err)
  if attempted then
   self.Healthy=false;self.Mode="Unavailable";self.Status="Verifying the saved exchange"
   self.Engine=nil;self.Population=nil;self.Epoch+=1;self.NextAttempt=self.Now()+self.Settings.RetrySeconds
  end
  warn("[Get Funded!] Bot refresh failed: "..tostring(err))
 end
 return ok,ok and result or tostring(err)
end
function World:Maintain()
 if self.Closing or self.Busy or self.Mode=="Local"then return end
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Mode=="Shared"then
  if not self.Lease.Owned or now>=self.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil then
   -- Discard unsaved state after loss of authority. Reacquire and restore the durable record.
   self.Healthy=false self.Mode="Unavailable" self.Status="Reconnecting to the saved exchange"
   self.Engine=nil self.Population=nil self.Epoch+=1 self.NextAttempt=now
  elseif now>=self.NextSave then self:Save(false) return end
 end
 if self.Mode~="Shared" and now>=self.NextAttempt then self:Open()end
end
function World:Close()
 self.Closing=true
 -- A save already in flight finishes before the final frozen checkpoint and lease release.
 local deadline=os.clock()+24
 while self.Busy and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05)end
 if not self.Busy and self.Mode=="Shared" and self.Lease.Owned then
  repeat
   if self:Save(true)then return true end
   if not self.Lease.Owned or self.Now()>=self.Lease.Record.LeaseUntil then break end
   task.wait(1)
  until os.clock()>=deadline
 end
 return self.Mode=="Local"
end
return World

-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
-- `thickness` (default 1 px) is centred on y. Segments are sized to stay inside the row, so the row does
-- not clip: clipping a 1 px-tall row could round to an empty rectangle and hide the whole line.
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z,thickness)
 thickness=thickness or 1
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y-(thickness-1)//2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,thickness),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z or entry.T~=thickness then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.T=thickness entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),thickness)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

 local ok,result=pcall(function()

  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)

  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position

  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")
  -- Keyed objects: a candle keeps its own object whatever order candles are drawn in.
  local keyed=Pool.new(root)

  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})

  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")
  local c=draw({60}) assert(c[60]==a[60] and c[60].Visible,"Returning candles reuse their object")

 end)

shared/ChartTools.luau:
-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- A rectangle's extension handle: the midpoint of its right edge, in the caller's pixel space.
function Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
 return math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),(toY(d.P1)+toY(d.P2))/2
end
-- Strong magnet: nearest candle open/high/low/close anywhere in screen space.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y)
 local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if (cx-x)^2<=bestD then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=(cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Pixel-space soft price magnet for the selected candle, stable at every zoom level.
function Tools.SoftSnap(candle,toY,y,previous,threshold)
 if not candle then return nil end
 local limit=threshold or 7;local best,distance
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","Close","High","Low"})do
  local d=math.abs(toY(candle[field])-y)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=field;distance=d end
 end
 if previous and previous.Time==candle.Time then
  local held=math.abs(toY(candle[previous.Field])-y)
  if held<=limit+3 and (distance>limit or held<=distance+1)then best=previous.Field;distance=held;limit+=3 end
 end
 if distance<=limit then return {Time=candle.Time,Price=candle[best],Field=best}end
end
function Tools.NearestCandle(candles,toX,x)
 local best,distance
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do local d=math.abs(toX(c.Time)-x)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=c;distance=d end
 end
 return best
end
function Tools.ProtectionField(direction,entry,price)
 local delta=(price-entry)*direction
 return delta<0 and "Stop" or delta>0 and "Target" or nil
end
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- The selected rectangle has an "Extend" dot at the midpoint of its right edge (checked first, slightly tighter
-- than corner handles so a small rectangle's corners stay reachable). Other handles belong to the
-- selected drawing only. A rectangle's body is "Slide" (horizontal move).
-- Interiors of unselected rectangles are flagged Interior: the view decides whether a drag there
-- moves the rectangle (mouse) or pans the chart (touch, where rectangles cover a small plot).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 local extendRadius=math.max(4,handleRadius-2)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Rect" and d.Id==selectedId then
   local ex,ey=Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
   if math.abs(ex-x)<=extendRadius and math.abs(ey-y)<=extendRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part="Extend"} end
  end
 end
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end
 local interior
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Line" then
   if math.abs(toY(d.P1)-y)<=tolerance and x>=0 and x<=(width or math.huge) then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then
   if segmentDistance(x,y,toX(d.T1),toY(d.P1),toX(d.T2),toY(d.P2))<=tolerance then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Rect" then
   local x1,x2=math.min(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2))
   local y1,y2=math.min(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2)),math.max(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2))
   local inside=x>=x1-tolerance and x<=x2+tolerance and y>=y1-tolerance and y<=y2+tolerance
   if inside then
    local edge=math.abs(x-x1)<=tolerance or math.abs(x-x2)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y1)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y2)<=tolerance
    if edge or d.Id==selectedId then return {Drawing=d,Part="Slide"} end
    interior=interior or {Drawing=d,Part="Slide",Interior=true}
   end
  end
 end
 return interior
end
-- Applies an edit to `target` from its unmodified `original`.
function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)
 for k,v in pairs(original)do target[k]=v end
 if part=="Move" then
  target.T1=original.T1 and original.T1+delta.Time target.P1=original.P1+delta.Price
  if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time target.P2=original.P2+delta.Price end
 elseif part=="Extend" then
  -- Right edge only: the left edge and both price levels stay fixed; the edge never crosses the left
  -- edge (it keeps at least delta.MinWidth seconds, one candle, of width).
  local right=(original.T2 or original.T1)>=original.T1 and "T2" or "T1" local left=right=="T2" and "T1" or "T2"
  target[right]=math.max(point.Time,original[left]+(delta and delta.MinWidth or 0))
 elseif part=="Slide" then
  -- Horizontal only: width (T2-T1), height and both price levels stay exactly as they were.
  target.T1=original.T1+delta.Time if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time end
 elseif part=="P1" or part=="P2" then
  local n=part:sub(2) target["T"..n]=point.Time target["P"..n]=point.Price
 else
  local index=tonumber(part:match("Corner(%d)"))
  if index then
   local f=cornerFields[index] target[f[1]]=point.Time target[f[2]]=point.Price
  end
 end
end
-- Liang-Barsky clip to [0,w]x[0,h]. Rotated GUI objects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants.
function Tools.ClipSegment(x1,y1,x2,y2,w,h)
 local t0,t1=0,1 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
 for _,edge in ipairs({{-dx,x1},{dx,w-x1},{-dy,y1},{dy,h-y1}})do
  local p,q=edge[1],edge[2]
  if p==0 then if q<0 then return nil end
  else
   local r=q/p
   if p<0 then if r>t1 then return nil elseif r>t0 then t0=r end
   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end
  end
 end
 return x1+t0*dx,y1+t0*dy,x1+t1*dx,y1+t1*dy
end
-- Undo/redo of the whole drawing list (small, so snapshots are simple and exact).
local History={} History.__index=History
function Tools.History(limit) return setmetatable({Past={},Future={},Limit=limit or 100},History) end
function History:Record(list)
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
local function restore(list,snapshot) table.clear(list) for i,d in ipairs(snapshot)do list[i]=copy(d) end end
-- Records a snapshot taken before an edit that has already been applied (e.g. a finished drag).
function History:Push(snapshot)
 table.insert(self.Past,snapshot) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
function History:Undo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Past) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Future,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:Redo(list)

local T=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)

return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 -- A simple linear transform stands in for the chart: 10 px per minute, 4 px per point.

 local function view(left,high) return function(t)return math.floor((t-left)/6+0.5)end,function(p)return math.floor((high-p)*4+0.5)end end

 local X,Y=view(0,120)

 local candles={{Time=600,Open=100,High=110,Low=95,Close=105},{Time=660,Open=105,High=108,Low=101,Close=101}}

 local snap=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(600)+3,Y(110)+4)

 check(snap and snap.Field=="High" and snap.Price==110 and snap.Time==600,"Snaps to the nearest OHLC point")

 local far=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,900,-300)
 check(far and far.Time==660,"Strong snap has no distance limit, including future space")
 check(T.Snap({},X,Y,900,-300)==nil,"No candles leaves snapping empty")
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
  local hit=T.Snap({candles[1]},X,Y,X(600),Y(candles[1][field]))
  check(hit and hit.Price==candles[1][field],"Every OHLC target: "..field)
 end
 local pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=100,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==0,"Screen-space distance beats price-only distance")
 pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=10,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==10,"Screen-space distance beats nearest candle in time")

 local close=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(660),Y(101)+2) check(close.Price==101,"Snaps to close/low")

 -- Rectangles: stored in time/price, hit-tested in pixels at any zoom.

 local r=T.New("Rect",{Time=600,Price=110},{Time=720,Price=100},"BX","1m")

 check(r.Id and r.Border=="Blue" and r.Opacity==0.15,"Defaults")

 local list={r}

 local inside=T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000)

 check(inside.Interior and inside.Part=="Slide","Interior of an unselected rectangle is flagged (the view chooses grab or pan)")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Slide","Interior of the selected rectangle slides it")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(600),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Edge selects/slides")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(720)+3,Y(100)-2,6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner handle")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(900),Y(50),6,8,r.Id,1000)==nil,"Empty space pans")

 local X2,Y2=view(300,140) -- panned and rescaled chart: same drawing, new pixels

 check(T.HitTest(list,X2,Y2,X2(720),Y2(100),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Anchors follow the chart after panning")

 local original=T.Copy(r)

 T.Edit(r,original,"Move",nil,{Time=60,Price=2})

 check(r.T1==660 and r.T2==780 and r.P1==112 and r.P2==102,"Move shifts both anchors")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=-90,Price=7})

 check(r.T1==510 and r.T2==630 and r.P1==110 and r.P2==100,"Slide moves horizontally only: width, height and prices kept")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=240,Price=0})

 check(r.T2-r.T1==original.T2-original.T1 and r.P1==original.P1 and r.P2==original.P2 and r.T1==840,"Slide right keeps size")

 -- Right-edge extension handle: midpoint of the right edge, extends width only.

 local ext=T.Copy(original) local elist={ext}

 local ex,ey=T.ExtendPoint(ext,X,Y) check(ex==X(720) and ey==(Y(110)+Y(100))/2,"Extension handle sits at the right-edge midpoint")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Unselected rectangle has no extension hit area")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex,Y(100)+2,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner still reachable next to the extension handle")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Extend","Selected rectangle extension is hittable")

 local copyR=T.Copy(original)

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=900,Price=90},{Time=180,Price=-20,MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==900 and copyR.P1==110 and copyR.P2==100,"Extend moves only the right edge: left edge and prices fixed")

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=300,Price=90},{MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==660,"Extend never crosses the left edge (one-candle minimum)")

 local flipped=T.Copy(original) flipped.T1,flipped.T2=original.T2,original.T1 local flippedOriginal=T.Copy(flipped)

 T.Edit(flipped,flippedOriginal,"Extend",{Time=840,Price=0},{MinWidth=60})

 check(flipped.T1==840 and flipped.T2==600 and flipped.P1==110,"Extend works whichever corner the rectangle was drawn from")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Corner1",{Time=540,Price=115})

 check(r.T1==540 and r.P1==115 and r.T2==720 and r.P2==100,"Corner resize keeps the opposite corner")

 local trend=T.New("Trend",{Time=0,Price=100},{Time=600,Price=110},"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({trend},X,Y,X(300),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==trend,"Trend hit")

 local line=T.New("Line",{Time=0,Price=104},nil,"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({line},X,Y,50,Y(104)+2,6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==line,"Horizontal line hit")

 -- Clipping keeps rotated trend lines inside the plot.

 local ax,ay,bx,by=T.ClipSegment(-50,50,150,50,100,100) check(ax==0 and bx==100 and ay==50,"Clip horizontal")

 check(T.ClipSegment(-10,-10,-5,-5,100,100)==nil,"Clip outside")

 -- Undo/redo restores exact drawing lists.

 local h=T.History(3) local drawings={}

 h:Record(drawings) table.insert(drawings,T.Copy(r))

 local before=T.CopyList(drawings) drawings[1].P1=200 h:Push(before)

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==115,"Undo edit")

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and #drawings==0,"Undo create")

 check(not h:Undo(drawings),"Nothing more to undo")

 check(h:Redo(drawings) and #drawings==1 and h:Redo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==200,"Redo")

 h:Record(drawings) check(not h:CanRedo(),"A new edit clears redo")

 for _=1,10 do h:Record(drawings) end check(#h.Past==3,"History is bounded")

 -- Direction uses exact tick counts, so float noise can never flip a candle's colour.

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.4,Close=2218.4000000001},0.1)==0,"Doji")

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.3,Close=2218.4},0.1)==1 and T.Direction({Open=5824.75,Close=5824.5},0.25)==-1,"Up/down")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Magnet snapping, rectangle/trend/line hit tests, anchoring after pan, move/slide/extend/resize, clipping, undo/redo, direction"}

end

 local hit=self:Hit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
