 -- a drag on a rectangle never pans the chart. On touch an unselected interior still pans; tap to select.
 if hit and(not hit.Interior or(kind~=TOUCH and hit.Part=="Slide"))then
  local d=hit.Drawing
  start("Edit",{Part=hit.Part,Target=d,Original=Tools.Copy(d),Before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings),StartPoint=self:PointAt(x,y,false),SelectChanged=self.Selected~=d.Id})
  if hit.Part=="Move" or hit.Part=="Slide" then
   local anchors=Tools.Points(d)
   if d.Kind=="Line" then anchors={{Time=self.Drag.StartPoint.Time,Price=d.P1}} end
   local nearest=math.huge
   for _,pt in ipairs(anchors)do
    local dist=(g.X(pt.Time)-x)^2+(g.Y(pt.Price)-y)^2
    if dist<nearest then nearest=dist;self.Drag.Anchor=pt end
   end
  end
  self.Selected=d.Id;return
 end
 start("Pan",{Click=hit and hit.Drawing.Id or false})
end
function View:StartPinch()
 local g=self.Geometry if not g then return end
 local a,b local list={} for input,pos in pairs(self.Touches)do table.insert(list,{input,pos})end
 a,b=list[1],list[2]
 if self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Pan"then self.Drag=nil end
 local mid=(a[2]+b[2])/2
 local x=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 self.Drag={Kind="Pinch",A=a[1],B=b[1],StartDistance=math.max(20,(a[2]-b[2]).Magnitude),StartFraction=x,StartMid=mid,View=g.View,State=g.State,
  Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true,Type=TOUCH}
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
end
function View:UpdatePinch()
 local d=self.Drag local pa,pb=self.Touches[d.A],self.Touches[d.B]
 if not pa or not pb then return end
 local g=self.Geometry
 local mid=(pa+pb)/2 local dist=math.max(20,(pa-pb).Magnitude)
 local fraction=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/d.Width
 Viewport.Pinch(d.State,d.View,d.StartFraction,fraction,d.StartDistance/dist,mid.Y-d.StartMid.Y,d.Height)
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Changed(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH and self.Touches[ev]then self.Touches[ev]=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)end
 if kind==MOVE then self.LastTouch=false end
 local d=self.Drag
 if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then if kind==TOUCH then self:UpdatePinch()end return end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=MOVE then return end
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 local delta=pos-d.Start
 if not d.Moved and delta.Magnitude<(d.Type==TOUCH and 8 or 4)then return end
 d.Moved=true
 self.Hover=pos
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then Viewport.Pan(d.State,d.View,delta.X,delta.Y,d.Width,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Scale"then Viewport.ScalePrice(d.State,d.View,delta.Y,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order"then
  local Market=self.Ctx.Market local tick=Market.Contracts[d.Contract].Tick
  d.Price=math.max(tick,Market.Snap(d.Original-delta.Y/d.Height*(d.View.High-d.View.Low),d.Contract))
  if d.FromEntry then
   local field=Tools.ProtectionField(d.Direction,d.Entry,d.Price)
   d.Field=field;d.ExpectedPrice=field and d[field]or nil;d.Creating=d.ExpectedPrice==nil
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",d.Field or "Unavailable")
  end
 elseif self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(pos)
  if d.Kind=="Edit"then
   local pt=self:DrawingPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
   local origin=d.Anchor or d.StartPoint
   local Market=self.Ctx.Market
   Tools.Edit(d.Target,d.Original,d.Part,pt,{Time=pt.Time-origin.Time,Price=pt.Snap and pt.Price-origin.Price or Market.Snap(pt.Price-origin.Price,self.S.Contract),
    MinWidth=self.Geometry.View.Interval})
  elseif d.Kind=="Place"then self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
  elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then d.Point=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Ended(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH then self.Touches[ev]=nil end
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then
  if kind~=TOUCH then return end
  local remaining,pos=next(self.Touches)
  if remaining and self.Geometry then
   -- Lifting one finger continues as a one-finger pan from where it is.
   local g=self.Geometry
   self.Drag={Kind="Pan",Input=remaining,Type=TOUCH,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true}
  else self:Finish(true)end
  return
 end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=d.Type then return end
 self:Finish(ev.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Cancel)
end
function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil
 local s=self.S local chrome=false
 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then
  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil
   if chosen~=self.Selected then self.Selected=chosen;chrome=true end
  end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then
  if not commit then for k in pairs(d.Target)do d.Target[k]=nil end for k,v in pairs(d.Original)do d.Target[k]=v end
  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end
  if d.SelectChanged then chrome=true end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Place"then
  if not commit or not self.Placement then self.Placement=nil
  elseif d.Moved then self:CommitPlacement();chrome=true
  else self.Placement.Waiting=true end
 elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then
  if commit then
   local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
   local line=Tools.New("Line",d.Point,nil,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
   table.insert(s.Drawings,line);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=line.Id;s.Tool="Pan";chrome=true
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="CancelOrder"then
  if commit and not d.Moved and d.Base==self.Ctx.Session.AccountKey then
   local ok,message=self.Ctx.Session:Cancel(d.Id)
   if not ok then self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Order"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendOrder(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Price,d.Original,d.Quantity)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.OrderPending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.OrderPending==d then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Limit change not confirmed. Showing its last confirmed price.","error")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original and d.Field then
   local ok,message,_,requestId
   if d.Creating then ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:CreateProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.Quantity)
   else ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.FromEntry and d.ExpectedPrice or d.Original,d.FromEntry and d.Quantity or nil)end
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.Pending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.Pending==d then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Change not confirmed. Showing the last confirmed price.")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message)end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Inspect"then self.Hover=nil
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 self.Ctx.onIdle(chrome)
end
function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 self.RectangleLockTime=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))
 if(p.Kind=="Rect"and(w<3 or h<3))or(p.Kind=="Trend"and w+h<4)then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
 table.insert(s.Drawings,d);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=d.Id;s.Tool="Pan"
end
function View:Wheel(ev)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if not g or self.Drag or self.Pending or self.OrderPending or self:Blocked()then return end
 local x=(ev.Position.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 Viewport.Zoom(g.State,g.View,ev.Position.Z>0 and 0.85 or 1/0.85,x);self.Dirty=true
end
-- Returns true when the key was used by the chart.
function View:KeyBegan(ev)
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged();return false end
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=true
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged();return false
 end
 if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
 local ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
 local shift=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
  if self.Menu then self:CloseOrderMenu();return true end
  if self.Drag or self.Placement then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if self.Selected then self.Selected=nil;self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  return false
 elseif(key==Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)and self:SelectedDrawing()and not self.Drag then
  self:DeleteSelected();return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Z and not self.Drag then if shift then self:Redo()else self:Undo()end return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true
 end
 return false
end
function View:KeyEnded(ev)
 if ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged() end
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=nil
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged()
 end
end
-- Re-evaluate an active drag when the modifier changes, even without mouse motion.
function View:ModifierChanged()
 self:UpdateRectangleLock()
 self.Dirty=true
 local d=self.Drag
 if d and d.Moved and d.Type~=TOUCH and self.Hover then
  self:Changed({UserInputType=MOVE,Position=self.Hover})
 elseif self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting and self.Hover then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover)
  self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,self.LastTouch)
 end
end
-- Cancels the current gesture: an edit restores the drawing, a placement is discarded.
function View:Cancel()
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
 if DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self.S.Tool="Pan" end
end
-- Window focus lost (or the Roblox menu opened): cancel any gesture and clear modifier state.
function View:FocusLost()
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 self.Ctrl=false self.Shift=false table.clear(self.ModifierKeys) table.clear(self.Touches)
 self:Cancel()
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true self:SetCursor("")
end
function View:Step(dt)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if g and Viewport.Ease(g.State,dt,self.Drag and(self.Drag.Kind=="Protection"or self.Drag.Kind=="Order"))then self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:OnMarketUpdate()
 self:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag
 local message
 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered
   or d.FromEntry and (held.Quantity~=d.Quantity or held.Entry~=d.Entry or held.Stop~=d.Stop or held.Target~=d.Target)
   or not d.FromEntry and held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if d and d.Kind=="Order"then
  local o=self:WorkingOrder(d.Id)
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not o or o.Price~=d.Original or o.Quantity~=d.Quantity then
   self:Finish(false);message="Limit order changed or filled. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if self.OrderPending then
  local p=self.OrderPending
  if p.Base~=session.AccountKey or not self:WorkingOrder(p.Id)then self.OrderPending=nil end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=pending.Base or not held or held.Id~=pending.Id or held.Triggered or not pending.Creating and not held[pending.Field]then self.Pending=nil end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 return message
end
function View:OnReply(reply)
 if self.OrderPending and reply.RequestId==self.OrderPending.RequestId then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
 if self.Pending and reply.RequestId==self.Pending.RequestId then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
end

-- Right-click order menu. The clicked price becomes the order price; the choices depend on where it
-- sits relative to the last traded price: above -> Limit Sell / Stop Buy, below -> Limit Buy / Stop Sell.
-- It shows only those two actions with their price. The quantity is the one selected in Place a Trade
-- (one shared state), and submission uses the terminal's shared order path (same client checks, SL/TP
-- settings, pending state and toasts); the server validates exactly as for the ticket.
local MENU_W,MENU_ROW,MENU_PAD=236,42,8
function View:MenuOptions(price,last)
 if price>last then
  return "Above",{{Dir=-1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Sell",Gloss="Red"},{Dir=1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Buy",Gloss="Green"}}
 elseif price<last then
  return "Below",{{Dir=1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Buy",Gloss="Green"},{Dir=-1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Sell",Gloss="Red"}}
 end
 return "At",{}
end
function View:OpenOrderMenu(pos)
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 local ctx=self.Ctx
 if self:Blocked() or not ctx.submitOrder then return false end
 local g=self.Geometry local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if x<0 or x>g.Width or y<0 or y>g.Height then return false end
 local s=self.S local Market=ctx.Market
 local price=Market.Snap(g.View.High-y/g.Ppp,s.Contract)
 local last=ctx.Session.Prices[s.Contract]
 -- Exactly at the last price there is no limit/stop choice; BUY and SELL place market orders.
 if price<=0 or not last or price==last then return false end
 self.Menu={Contract=s.Contract,Price=price,Pos=pos}
 self:BuildOrderMenu()
 return true
end
function View:CloseOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 self.Menu=nil
 for _,o in ipairs({m.Frame,m.Backdrop})do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy()end end
 local root=self.Ctx.Root
 if root then root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOpen",false);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuPrice",nil);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOptions",nil)end
end
function View:BuildOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 local ctx=self.Ctx local C,Market,s,root=ctx.C,ctx.Market,self.S,ctx.Root
 local frame,button,stroke,round=ctx.frame,ctx.button,ctx.stroke,ctx.round
 for _,o in ipairs({m.Frame,m.Backdrop})do if o and o.Parent then o:Destroy()end end
 local key=m.Contract local last=ctx.Session.Prices[key] or m.Price
 local side,options=self:MenuOptions(m.Price,last)
 if #options==0 then self:CloseOrderMenu() return end
 m.Side=side m.Market=last m.Options=options
 local pxs=Market.Number(m.Price)
 -- Full-screen catcher: a left click anywhere closes; a right click moves the menu to that point.
 local backdrop=Instance.new("TextButton")
 backdrop.Name="OrderMenuBackdrop" backdrop.Text="" backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1 backdrop.BorderSizePixel=0 backdrop.AutoButtonColor=false
 backdrop.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) backdrop.ZIndex=94 backdrop.Parent=root
 -- Clicks on the menu's own background must not reach the catcher underneath.
 local function overMenu(p)
  local f=m.Frame if not f or not f.Parent then return false end
  local a,z=f.AbsolutePosition,f.AbsoluteSize
  return p.X>=a.X and p.X<=a.X+z.X and p.Y>=a.Y and p.Y<=a.Y+z.Y
 end
 backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(ev)
  local p=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
  if overMenu(p) then return end
  if ev.UserInputType==MB2 then
   if not self:OpenOrderMenu(p) then self:CloseOrderMenu() end
  elseif ev.UserInputType==MB1 or ev.UserInputType==TOUCH then self:CloseOrderMenu() end
 end)
 m.Backdrop=backdrop
 local h=MENU_PAD*2+#options*MENU_ROW+(#options-1)*6
 local origin=root.AbsolutePosition
 local px=math.clamp(m.Pos.X-origin.X+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.X-MENU_W-8))
 local py=math.clamp(m.Pos.Y-origin.Y+6,8,math.max(8,root.AbsoluteSize.Y-h-8))
 local menu=frame(root,"ChartOrderMenu",px,py,MENU_W,h,C.Panel,95);menu.Active=true
 round(menu,12);local edge=stroke(menu,C.Cyan);edge.Thickness=2
 m.Frame=menu
 m.Labels={} m.Buttons={}
 local y=MENU_PAD
 for i,o in ipairs(options)do
  local b=ctx.gloss(button(menu,"Order"..o.Type..(o.Dir>0 and"Buy"or"Sell"),"",MENU_PAD,y,MENU_W-MENU_PAD*2,MENU_ROW,function()
   local n=s.Qty
   local what=string.lower(o.Title).." "..n.." "..key.." @ "..pxs
   if ctx.submitOrder(o.Dir,o.Type,m.Price,n,what)then self:CloseOrderMenu();ctx.refresh()end
  end,C.Raised,C.Text,15,96),o.Gloss)
  b:SetAttribute("Sound","None");b:SetAttribute("Debounce",.4)
  m.Buttons[i]={Button=b,Option=o}
  table.insert(m.Labels,o.Title)
  y+=MENU_ROW+6
 end
 self:RefreshOrderMenu()
 root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOpen",true);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuPrice",m.Price);root:SetAttribute("OrderMenuOptions",table.concat(m.Labels,","))
end
-- Button labels ("Limit Sell at 5,850.00") and the over-limit flag for the shared quantity.
function View:RefreshOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m or not m.Frame or not m.Frame.Parent or not m.Buttons then return end
 local ctx=self.Ctx local qty=self.S.Qty local pxs=ctx.Market.Number(m.Price)
 for _,item in ipairs(m.Buttons)do
  local o,b=item.Option,item.Button
  local label=b:FindFirstChild("ControlLabel") local value=o.Title.." at "..pxs
  if label then label.Text=value end b.Text=value
  local max=ctx.maxOrder and ctx.maxOrder(m.Contract,o.Dir)
  b:SetAttribute("OverLimit",max~=nil and qty>max)
 end
end
-- Keeps the menu honest while prices move: the choices are rebuilt if the market crosses the clicked
-- price (and it closes if the market sits exactly on it). Changing instrument or opening a popup closes it.
function View:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local m=self.Menu if not m then return end
 if m.Contract~=self.S.Contract or self:Blocked() then self:CloseOrderMenu() return end
 self:RefreshOrderMenu()
 local last=self.Ctx.Session.Prices[m.Contract]
 if not last or last==m.Market then return end
 local side=self:MenuOptions(m.Price,last)
 if side~=m.Side then self:BuildOrderMenu() return end
 m.Market=last
end

-- Commands (toolbar, mobile tools sheet, keyboard)
function View:Command(name)
 if name=="Magnet"then self:ToggleMagnet()
 elseif name=="Undo"then self:Undo()
 elseif name=="Redo"then self:Redo()
 elseif name=="Clear"then self:Clear()
 else self:SetTool(name)end
end
function View:SetTool(name)
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.S.Tool=name self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.Hover=nil
 if DRAW[name]then self.Selected=nil end
 self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ToggleMagnet() self.S.Magnet=not self.S.Magnet self.Ctx.refresh() end
function View:CancelPlacement() self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.SoftSnap=nil self.Dirty=true end
function View:Undo()
 if self.History:Undo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:Redo()
 if self.History:Redo(self.S.Drawings)then if self.Selected and not self:Find(self.Selected)then self.Selected=nil end self.Ctx.refresh()end
end
function View:DeleteSelected()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(self.S.Drawings)
 for i,x in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do if x==d then table.remove(self.S.Drawings,i)break end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:Clear()
 local s=self.S local current=self:Current()
 if #current==0 then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 for i=#s.Drawings,1,-1 do local d=s.Drawings[i] if d.Contract==s.Contract then table.remove(s.Drawings,i)end end
 self.History:Push(before) self.Selected=nil self.Placement=nil self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:SetStyle(field,value)
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d or d[field]==value then return end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d[field]=value self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleFill()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Colors local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if v==d.Fill then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Fill=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleOpacity()
 local d=self:SelectedDrawing() if not d then return end
 local list=Tools.Opacities local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if math.abs(v-(d.Opacity or 0.15))<0.001 then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Opacity=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:ActiveState() local g=self.Geometry return g and g.State,g end
function View:ResetView() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.Reset(state);self.Base=nil;self.Dirty=true end end
function View:AutoFit() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.AutoFit(state);self.Dirty=true end end
function View:GoLive()
 local state=self:ActiveState()
 if state and not self.Drag then Viewport.GoLive(state,self.Ctx.Session.Prices[self.S.Contract]);self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:Destroy() self:CloseOrderMenu() self:SetCursor("") end
return View

-- Presentation-only chart navigation. Never modifies prices, candles or account state.
-- Time is horizontal (seconds), price is vertical. All inputs are screen deltas in pixels.
local Viewport={}
Viewport.Seconds={["1m"]=60,["5m"]=300,["15m"]=900,["1h"]=3600,["1D"]=86400}
Viewport.MinBars=10          -- deepest zoom-in
Viewport.MaxBars=240        -- absolute zoom-out ceiling (render budget)
Viewport.PixelsPerBar=7      -- readable 3+ px bodies, distinct wicks and space between candles
Viewport.RightMargin=3       -- empty bars to the right of the live candle
Viewport.EaseSeconds=0.07    -- auto-fit price-scale smoothing
Viewport.DefaultBars={Desktop=72,Mobile=36}

-- Practical zoom range: limited by the available history and by how many candles the plot can draw.
function Viewport.Limits(count,width)
 local render=math.clamp(math.floor((width or 800)/Viewport.PixelsPerBar),Viewport.MinBars+10,Viewport.MaxBars)
 local data=math.max(40,math.ceil(count*1.15)+Viewport.RightMargin+2)
 return Viewport.MinBars,math.max(Viewport.MinBars+2,math.min(render,data))
end
-- First index whose candle time is >= time (binary search; candles are time ordered).
local function lowerBound(candles,time)
 local lo,hi=1,#candles+1
 while lo<hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if candles[mid].Time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end end
 return lo
end
Viewport.LowerBound=lowerBound

function Viewport.Resolve(state,candles,timeframe,tick,mobile,levels,width)
 if #candles==0 then return nil end
 local interval=Viewport.Seconds[timeframe]
 local minBars,maxBars=Viewport.Limits(#candles,width)
 state.Bars=math.clamp(state.Bars or (mobile and Viewport.DefaultBars.Mobile or Viewport.DefaultBars.Desktop),minBars,maxBars)
 state.Interval=interval
 local latest,earliest=candles[#candles].Time,candles[1].Time
 if state.Right==nil then state.Right=latest+Viewport.RightMargin*interval state.Follow=true end
 -- Following: new candles scroll the view by exactly the time they add. Detached: the view never moves.
 if state.Follow and state.Latest and latest~=state.Latest then state.Right+=latest-state.Latest end
 state.Latest=latest
 local maximum=latest+state.Bars*0.8*interval
 local minimum=math.min(earliest+math.min(6,state.Bars*0.5)*interval,maximum)
 state.Right=math.clamp(state.Right,minimum,maximum)
 local right=state.Right local left=right-state.Bars*interval
 -- One extra candle each side so partially visible bodies are drawn and clipped, not popped.
 local first=lowerBound(candles,left-interval) local last=lowerBound(candles,right+interval)-1
 local visible=table.move(candles,first,math.max(first-1,last),1,{})
 local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(visible)do
  if c.Time>=left-interval*0.5 and c.Time<=right+interval*0.5 then low=math.min(low,c.Low) high=math.max(high,c.High) end
 end
 if low==math.huge then local c=candles[math.clamp(first,1,#candles)] low=c.Low high=c.High end
 -- While following, keep the live price and the open position's levels in view.
 if state.Follow then for _,price in ipairs(levels or {})do low=math.min(low,price) high=math.max(high,price) end end
 local padding=math.max(tick*2,(high-low)*0.08)
 local targetLow,targetHigh=low-padding,high+padding
 state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh=targetLow,targetHigh
 local auto=state.AutoY~=false
 local lo,hi
 if auto then
  if not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=targetLow,targetHigh end
  lo,hi=state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh
 else lo,hi=state.Low,state.High end
 if hi-lo<tick then local mid=(lo+hi)/2 lo,hi=mid-tick/2,mid+tick/2 end
 return {Left=left,Right=right,Low=lo,High=hi,Bars=state.Bars,Interval=interval,Data=visible,First=first,
  Earliest=earliest,Latest=latest,Minimum=minimum,Maximum=maximum,MinBars=minBars,MaxBars=maxBars,Tick=tick,
  Follow=state.Follow==true,AutoY=auto,TargetLow=targetLow,TargetHigh=targetHigh,
  Live=state.Follow==true and auto}
end
-- Eases the displayed auto-fit range toward its target. Returns true while still moving.
function Viewport.Ease(state,dt,snap)
 if state.AutoY==false or not state.TargetLow then return false end
 if snap or not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false end
 local range=math.max(1e-9,state.TargetHigh-state.TargetLow)
 local dl,dh=state.TargetLow-state.ShowLow,state.TargetHigh-state.ShowHigh
 if math.abs(dl)<range*0.0005 and math.abs(dh)<range*0.0005 then
  state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false
 end
 local k=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/Viewport.EaseSeconds)
 state.ShowLow+=dl*k state.ShowHigh+=dh*k
 return true
end
function Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction) return view.Left+(view.Right-view.Left)*fraction end
function Viewport.PriceAt(view,fraction) return view.High-(view.High-view.Low)*fraction end
function Viewport.X(view,time,width) return (time-view.Left)/(view.Right-view.Left)*width end
function Viewport.Y(view,price,height) return (view.High-price)/(view.High-view.Low)*height end
local function refollow(state)
 if state.Latest and state.Interval then state.Follow=state.Right>=state.Latest+state.Interval*0.5 end
end
-- Manual price scale: fix the current range so later changes are explicit.
local function manual(state,view)
 if state.AutoY~=false then state.AutoY=false state.Low,state.High=view.Low,view.High end
end
function Viewport.Pan(state,start,dx,dy,width,height)
 state.Right=math.clamp(start.Right-dx/math.max(1,width)*(start.Right-start.Left),math.min(start.Minimum,start.Maximum),start.Maximum)
 -- Auto-fit keeps the price axis fitted to the candles; a manual scale pans vertically with the pointer.
 if not start.AutoY then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
function Viewport.Zoom(state,view,factor,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 local bars=math.clamp(view.Bars*factor,view.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,view.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction)
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-fraction)*bars*view.Interval
 -- Zooming out reveals more history, not empty future: the right edge never moves past where it was
 -- (or the live candle's usual margin), so the extra room goes to older candles.
 if bars>view.Bars and view.Latest and view.Interval then
  state.Right=math.min(state.Right,math.max(view.Right,view.Latest+Viewport.RightMargin*view.Interval))
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Two-finger gesture: the time under the starting midpoint stays under the current midpoint.
function Viewport.Pinch(state,start,fromFraction,toFraction,ratio,dy,height)
 local bars=math.clamp(start.Bars*ratio,start.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,start.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(start,math.clamp(fromFraction,0,1))
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-toFraction)*bars*start.Interval
 if not start.AutoY and dy then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Y-axis drag: down expands the visible price range (candles shorter), up compresses it (taller).
function Viewport.ScalePrice(state,start,dy,height)
 local factor=math.exp(math.clamp(dy,-2000,2000)/math.max(120,height)*1.6)
 local mid=(start.Low+start.High)/2
 local half=math.clamp((start.High-start.Low)/2*factor,(start.Tick or 0.01)*2,math.max(1,math.abs(mid))*2)
 state.AutoY=false state.Low=mid-half state.High=mid+half
end
function Viewport.AutoFit(state)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.Low,state.High end
 state.AutoY=true state.Low=nil state.High=nil
end
-- Follow the live candle again at the current zoom. A manual scale is re-centred on the live price.
function Viewport.GoLive(state,price)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low and price then
  local half=(state.High-state.Low)/2 state.Low=price-half state.High=price+half
 end
 state.Right=nil state.Follow=true
end
function Viewport.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state)
end
Viewport.Manual=manual
local niceSteps={1,2,2.5,5}
-- Round-number price grid; every label is a multiple of the contract tick.
function Viewport.PriceTicks(low,high,tick,count)
 local range=math.max(high-low,tick) local raw=range/math.max(1,count)
 local magnitude=10^math.floor(math.log10(raw)) local step
 for _,m in ipairs(niceSteps)do if m*magnitude>=raw then step=m*magnitude break end end
 step=step or 10*magnitude
 step=math.max(tick,math.ceil(step/tick-1e-9)*tick)
 local ticks={} local p=math.ceil(low/step-1e-9)*step
 while p<=high+1e-9 and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,p) p+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
local timeSteps={60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,10800,14400,21600,43200,86400,172800,432000,864000,2592000}
function Viewport.TimeTicks(left,right,interval,count)
 local raw=(right-left)/math.max(1,count) local step=timeSteps[#timeSteps]
 for _,s in ipairs(timeSteps)do if s>=interval and s>=raw then step=s break end end
 local ticks={} local t=math.ceil(left/step)*step
 while t<=right and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,t) t+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
return Viewport

local V=require(script.Parent.ChartViewport)

return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 local function series(n,interval)

  local c={} for i=1,n do local o=100+math.sin(i/7)*5 c[i]={Time=(i-1)*(interval or 60),Open=o,High=o+2,Low=o-2,Close=o+(i%3==0 and -1 or 1),Volume=i} end return c

 end

 local candles=series(700)

 -- Deep zoom-out is limited by history and by plot width (7 px per candle).

 local minBars,maxBars=V.Limits(#candles,1266)

 check(minBars==10 and maxBars==math.floor(1266/7),"700 candles: zoom-out respects readable spacing: "..maxBars)

 local _,wide=V.Limits(1440,1266) check(wide==math.floor(1266/7),"Long history: zoom-out is limited by plot width at 7 px per candle: "..wide)

 local _,narrow=V.Limits(1440,500) check(narrow==math.floor(500/7),"Narrow plots still allow readable spacing")

 local _,cap=V.Limits(5000,4000) check(cap==V.MaxBars,"Absolute render ceiling")

 local _,small=V.Limits(30,1266) check(small==math.max(40,math.ceil(30*1.15)+5),"Zoom limits follow available history")

 local state={} local live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(live.Live and live.Follow and #live.Data<#candles,"Starts following live with a navigable window")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,1.4,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==maxBars,"Zoom out reaches the practical limit and stops")

 check(live.Right<=candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60+1e-6 and #live.Data<=maxBars+3 and live.Interval==60,"Zoom keeps real one-minute candles and a bounded readable count")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,0.5,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==minBars,"Zoom in stops at the minimum")

 -- Cursor-anchored zoom keeps the time under the pointer fixed (away from bounds).

 V.Reset(state) local v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(state,v,400,0,1266,300) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 for _,f in ipairs({0.1,0.37,0.8})do

  local anchor=V.TimeAt(v,f) V.Zoom(state,v,1.3,f) local z=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(z,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom out keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

  anchor=V.TimeAt(z,f) V.Zoom(state,z,0.7,f) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(v,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom in keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

 end

 -- Detached viewport is preserved when candles arrive; following scrolls with them.

 check(not v.Follow,"Panning into history stops following")

 local right,low=v.Right,v.Low

 local grown=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=130,Low=90,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local after=V.Resolve(state,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(after.Right==right and after.Bars==v.Bars,"New candles do not move a detached viewport")

 local follow={} local f1=V.Resolve(follow,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 local f2=V.Resolve(follow,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(f2.Right-f1.Right==60 and f2.Follow,"Following scrolls by exactly the new candle")

 -- Auto-fit pan moves time only; manual scale pans price too.

 local pan={} local p0=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,p0,100,80,1266,300) local p1=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(p1.AutoY and p1.Right<p0.Right,"Auto-fit drag pans time and keeps auto scale")

 -- Y-axis drag: up = taller candles (narrower range), down = shorter; persists until auto-fit.

 V.ScalePrice(pan,p1,-60,300) local tall=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(not tall.AutoY and tall.High-tall.Low<p1.High-p1.Low,"Dragging the axis up compresses the range")

 V.Pan(pan,tall,-30,40,1266,300) local moved=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs((moved.High-moved.Low)-(tall.High-tall.Low))<1e-9 and moved.Low>tall.Low,"Manual scale survives panning and pans price")

 local grown2=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown2,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=400,Low=10,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local still=V.Resolve(pan,grown2,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(still.Low==moved.Low and still.High==moved.High,"Manual scale persists across live updates")

 V.ScalePrice(pan,moved,80,300) local short=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(short.High-short.Low>moved.High-moved.Low,"Dragging the axis down expands the range")

 V.AutoFit(pan) local fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(fitted.AutoY and fitted.Low==short.Low,"Auto-fit starts from the current scale")

 for _=1,200 do V.Ease(pan,1/60) end fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs(fitted.Low-fitted.TargetLow)<1e-9 and math.abs(fitted.High-fitted.TargetHigh)<1e-9,"Auto-fit settles exactly on the visible candles")

 local lo,hi=math.huge,-math.huge

 for _,c in ipairs(fitted.Data)do if c.Time>=fitted.Left-30 and c.Time<=fitted.Right+30 then lo=math.min(lo,c.Low) hi=math.max(hi,c.High)end end

 check(fitted.Low<lo and fitted.High>hi,"Auto-fit contains every visible candle")

 -- Go to live keeps the zoom; reset restores defaults.

 V.Zoom(pan,fitted,1.5,0.5) local zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,zoomed,600,0,1266,300) zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.GoLive(pan,101) local back=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(back.Follow and back.Bars==zoomed.Bars and back.Right==candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60,"Go to live keeps zoom and follows")

 V.Reset(pan) local reset=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(reset.Bars==V.DefaultBars.Desktop and reset.Live,"Reset view restores default zoom, auto-fit and live")

 -- Pinch keeps the time under the start midpoint under the current midpoint.

 local pinch={} local pv=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 local anchor=V.TimeAt(pv,0.4) V.Pinch(pinch,pv,0.4,0.55,0.6,0,200)

 local pz=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(pz,0.55)-anchor)<1e-6 and pz.Bars<pv.Bars,"Pinch zoom anchors to the midpoint")

 -- Bounds and degenerate data.

 V.Pan(state,v,-1e8,0,1266,300) local b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right<=b.Maximum,"Right bound")

 V.Pan(state,b,1e8,0,1266,300) b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right>=b.Minimum and #b.Data>0,"Left bound keeps candles visible")

 local one=V.Resolve({},{{Time=0,Open=100,High=100,Low=100,Close=100,Volume=1}},"1D",0.25,false,{100},500)

 check(one.High>one.Low and one.Right>one.Left,"Single flat candle has a valid view")

 -- Ticks are round multiples of the tick size and inside the range.

 local ticks,step=V.PriceTicks(5801.3,5843.9,0.25,6)

 check(step%0.25==0 and #ticks>=3 and ticks[1]>=5801.3 and ticks[#ticks]<=5843.9,"Price ticks")

 for _,t in ipairs(ticks)do check(math.abs(t/step-math.round(t/step))<1e-6,"Price ticks are aligned") end

 local tt,ts=V.TimeTicks(3000,9000,60,6) check(ts>=60 and tt[1]%ts==0,"Time ticks aligned")

 check(candles[1].Time==0 and candles[700].Time==699*60,"Navigation never mutates candles")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Zoom limits, cursor/pinch anchoring, follow vs detached, auto-fit pan, manual Y scale, auto-fit easing, go live, reset, bounds, ticks"}

end
shared/Confetti.luau:
-- Lightweight celebration effects shared by the loading screen and the welcome guide. One Heartbeat
-- connection animates a burst; every piece is destroyed when it lands. Calm (reduced motion) bursts
-- fade a few sparkles in place instead of throwing pieces across the screen.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Confetti={}
Confetti.Palette={Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160),Color3.fromRGB(255,222,40),Color3.fromRGB(0,220,255),Color3.fromRGB(190,132,255),
 Color3.fromRGB(255,120,168),Color3.fromRGB(245,249,255)}
local function sparkle(parent,x,y,size,color,z)
 local s=Instance.new("Frame");s.Name="Sparkle";s.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);s.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
 s.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size);s.BackgroundTransparency=1;s.ZIndex=z;s.Active=false
 for i=0,1 do
  local ray=Instance.new("Frame");ray.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);ray.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5);ray.BorderSizePixel=0
  ray.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,.24);ray.Rotation=45+i*90;ray.BackgroundColor3=color;ray.ZIndex=z
  local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.5,0);c.Parent=ray;ray.Parent=s
 end
 s.Parent=parent
 return s
end
Confetti.Sparkle=sparkle
-- Burst from (x, y) in the parent's offset space. opts: Count, Power, Spread (radians), Calm, ZIndex, Duration.
function Confetti.Burst(parent,x,y,opts)
 opts=opts or {}
 if not parent or not parent.Parent then return end
 local z=opts.ZIndex or 50
 if opts.Calm then
  for i=1,math.min(6,opts.Count or 6)do
   local a=(i/6)*math.pi*2
   local s=sparkle(parent,x+math.cos(a)*28,y+math.sin(a)*22,14,Confetti.Palette[(i-1)%#Confetti.Palette+1],z)
   for _,ray in ipairs(s:GetChildren())do
    ray.BackgroundTransparency=1
    local t=TweenService:Create(ray,TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,true),{BackgroundTransparency=0})
    t:Play()
   end
   task.delay(.8,function()s:Destroy()end)
  end
  return
 end
 local count=opts.Count or 24;local power=opts.Power or 420;local spread=opts.Spread or math.pi*.9
 local pieces={}
 for i=1,count do
  local p=Instance.new("Frame");p.Name="Confetti";p.BorderSizePixel=0;p.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);p.Active=false;p.ZIndex=z
  local round=math.random()<.35
  p.Size=round and UDim2.fromOffset(8,8)or UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(6,10),math.random(10,15))
  p.BackgroundColor3=Confetti.Palette[math.random(#Confetti.Palette)]
  if round then local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.5,0);c.Parent=p else local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,2);c.Parent=p end
  local angle=-math.pi/2+(math.random()-.5)*spread
  local speed=power*(.45+math.random()*.65)
  pieces[i]={F=p,X=x,Y=y,VX=math.cos(angle)*speed,VY=math.sin(angle)*speed,R=math.random(0,360),VR=math.random(-540,540),Flip=math.random()*6,W=p.Size.X.Offset,H=p.Size.Y.Offset}
  p.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y);p.Parent=parent
 end
 local life=opts.Duration or 1.25;local age=0;local connection
 connection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  age+=dt
  local fade=math.clamp((age-(life-.35))/.35,0,1)
  for _,q in ipairs(pieces)do
   q.VY+=980*dt;q.VX*=(1-1.6*dt);q.X+=q.VX*dt;q.Y+=q.VY*dt;q.R+=q.VR*dt
   local f=q.F;f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(q.X,q.Y);f.Rotation=q.R;f.BackgroundTransparency=fade
   -- Flutter: the piece's width breathes as it tumbles.
   f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2,q.W*math.abs(math.cos(age*9+q.Flip))),q.H)
  end
  if age>=life or not parent.Parent then
   connection:Disconnect()
   for _,q in ipairs(pieces)do q.F:Destroy()end
  end
 end)
end
-- A shower across the top of the parent (the "You're ready!" moment).
function Confetti.Shower(parent,opts)
 opts=opts or {}
 if not parent or not parent.Parent then return end
 local w=parent.AbsoluteSize.X
 if opts.Calm then Confetti.Burst(parent,w/2,parent.AbsoluteSize.Y*.3,{Calm=true,ZIndex=opts.ZIndex});return end
 for i=0,2 do
  Confetti.Burst(parent,w*(.2+i*.3),parent.AbsoluteSize.Y*.42,{Count=opts.Count or 22,Power=opts.Power or 620,Spread=math.pi*.55,ZIndex=opts.ZIndex,Duration=1.6})
 end
end
return Confetti

function Purchase.new(session,preview,changed,services)
 services=services or{}

  Marketplace=services.Marketplace or game:GetService("MarketplaceService"),
  Player=services.Player or game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer,Clock=services.Clock or os.clock},Purchase)
 if not preview then
  self.Connection=self.Marketplace.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player,id,purchased)
   if player~=self.Player or id~=self.PromptPass then return end
   self.Prompting=false;self.PromptPass=nil

 if not self.Alive or self.Preview then return end
 local access=self.Session.DepthAccess or{}
 local id=access.PassId

end

function Market.Money(value) return "$"..Market.Number(value) end

   for key,quote in pairs(self.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  end

  return self

 end

 self.Remote=root:WaitForChild("OrderRequest",60)

 local update=root:WaitForChild("MarketUpdate",60)

 if not self.Remote or not update then self.Regime="Exchange unavailable" return self end

 self.Connection=update.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)

  self.DepthAccess=packet.DepthAccess or {Allowed=false,State="Checking"}
  self.DepthReceivedAt=os.clock();self.DepthContract=packet.Contract
  self.DepthLive=not packet.StatusOnly and packet.CanTrade==true
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed or not self.DepthLive then
   for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end
  end

  self.CanTrade=packet.CanTrade==true self.ConnectionStatus=packet.ConnectionStatus self.PersistenceMode=packet.PersistenceMode
 self.RequestSession=packet.RequestSession or self.RequestSession
 self.NextId=math.max(self.NextId,packet.RequestHigh or 0)

  -- Atomic funded portfolio and live unlock projection arrive with each price batch.

  if packet.Portfolio then
   self.Portfolio=packet.Portfolio
   if not self.PreferencesDirty and not self.PreferencesPending then
    self.ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(packet.Portfolio.ProtectionPreferences)
   end
  end
  -- Lifetime stats are computed and persisted by the server; sent when they change.

  if packet.Stats then self.Stats=packet.Stats self.StatsAt=os.clock() end

  if packet.StatusOnly then
   self.MarketEvent=nil;self.News=nil

   if packet.NoAccount then

    -- No trading account yet (first join): clear any previous account view.

    self.Ready=false self.AccountKey=nil self.AccountToken=nil self.Positions={} self.Orders={} self.History={} self.Fills={}

   end

   for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {})do self:_reply(reply)end
   for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

   self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()return
  end

  self.Ready=true self.Base=packet.Base self.AccountKey=packet.AccountKey self.AccountToken=packet.AccountToken self.Positions=packet.Positions

  self.Orders=packet.Orders or self.Orders self.History=packet.History or self.History self.Fills=packet.Fills or self.Fills

  self.SummaryData=packet.Summary self.Quotes=packet.Quotes self.Time=packet.Time
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed then for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end end

  -- Server-computed maximum new order per instrument/side (same rule the exchange enforces).

  self.Capacity=packet.Capacity self.Limit=packet.Limit self.Triggers=packet.Triggers or {}

  self.Regime=packet.Regime self.News=packet.News self.MarketEvent=packet.MarketEvent self.Speed=packet.Speed self.Step=packet.Step

  for key,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  local cacheKey=packet.Contract..":"..packet.Timeframe

  -- A subscription can be dropped by the server's request rate limit (fast contract/timeframe

  -- switching). If the server is still streaming another series, ask again instead of waiting forever.

  if(packet.Contract~=self.Contract or packet.Timeframe~=self.Timeframe)and os.clock()-(self.SubscribedAt or 0)>1.5 then

   self:Subscribe(self.Contract,self.Timeframe)

  end

  if packet.Full then self.Cache[cacheKey]=packet.Candles else

   local data=self.Cache[cacheKey] or {} self.Cache[cacheKey]=data

   for _,candle in ipairs(packet.Candles) do

    local found=false

    for i=math.max(1,#data-2),#data do if data[i].Time==candle.Time then data[i]=candle found=true break end end

    if not found then table.insert(data,candle) end

   end

   while #data>Config.MaxCandles do table.remove(data,1) end

  end

  for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {}) do self:_reply(reply) end
  for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

  self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()
 end)

 self:Subscribe(Config.ContractOrder[1],"1m")

 local start=os.clock() while not self.Ready and not self.ConnectionStatus and os.clock()-start<45 do task.wait(0.1) end

 return self

end

-- Server events (unlocks, depletion notices) are announced once. Events that arrive before the UI

-- listens (the first packets after joining or reconnecting) are kept and replayed to OnEvent.

function Session:_event(event)
 if (event.Kind=="RankUp" or event.Kind=="Milestone")and event.Id then
  self.ProgressionEvents=self.ProgressionEvents or {};local key=event.Kind..":"..event.Id
  if self.ProgressionEvents[key]then return end;self.ProgressionEvents[key]=true
 end
 if event.Kind=="TradeClosed"then
  -- Execution identity, not price or a disappearing position, is the source of confirmation.
  if not event.Account or not event.TradeId then return end
  local key=event.Account..":"..event.TradeId
  if self.ClosedEvents[key]then return end
  self.ClosedEvents[key]=true;table.insert(self.ClosedEventOrder,key)
  if #self.ClosedEventOrder>128 then self.ClosedEvents[table.remove(self.ClosedEventOrder,1)]=nil end
 end
 if self.EventHandler then self.EventHandler(event) else table.insert(self.EventBacklog,event) end

 self.Events:Fire(event)

end
function Session:_reply(reply)
 self.Pending[reply.RequestId]=nil
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if pending and pending.Id==reply.RequestId then
  self.PreferencesPending=nil
  if reply.Ok and Protection.SamePreferences(self.ProtectionPreferences,pending.Value)then self.PreferencesDirty=false end
  -- A retry can be rejected during an exchange pause; retain the latest local intention.
  self.PreferencesRetryAt=os.clock()+(reply.Ok and 0 or 2)
 end
 self.Replies:Fire(reply)
end
function Session:_flushPreferences(force)
 if self.Preview or not self.PreferencesDirty or not self.CanTrade then return end
 if not force and os.clock()<(self.PreferencesRetryAt or 0)then return end
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if not force and pending and os.clock()-pending.At<2 then return end
 if pending then self.Pending[pending.Id]=nil end
 local value=table.clone(self.ProtectionPreferences)
 local ok,_,_,id=self:Send("ProtectionPreferences",table.clone(value))
 if ok then self.PreferencesPending={Id=id,Value=value,At=os.clock()}end
end
function Session:SetProtectionPreferences(value)
 local clean=Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if not clean then return false,"Check your stop loss and take profit settings. Use amounts greater than $0."end
 self.ProtectionPreferences=clean;self.PreferencesDirty=true;self:_flushPreferences(true)
 return true
end
function Session:OnEvent(fn)

 self.EventHandler=fn

 local backlog=self.EventBacklog self.EventBacklog={}

 for _,event in ipairs(backlog) do fn(event) end

end

function Session:Send(action,request,expectedAccount)

 if self.Preview then return false,"Edit preview only. Press Play to trade." end

 if not self.Remote then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"and not self.CanTrade then return false,self.ConnectionStatus or "Waiting for the exchange."end

 local now=os.clock()
 -- Bound pending acknowledgements even when the server rate-limits or loses a reply.
 local pendingCount,oldestId,oldestAt=0,nil,math.huge
 for id,at in pairs(self.Pending)do
  if now-at>30 then self.Pending[id]=nil else
   pendingCount+=1;if at<oldestAt then oldestId=id;oldestAt=at end
  end
 end
 if action=="Place"then
  self.PlaceTokens=math.min(6,(self.PlaceTokens or 6)+(now-(self.PlaceTokenTime or now))*5);self.PlaceTokenTime=now
  if self.PlaceTokens<1 then return false,"Orders are arriving too quickly. Wait a moment before placing another."end
  self.PlaceTokens-=1
 end

 self.NextId+=1 request=request or {} request.Id=self.NextId request.Action=action
 request.RequestSession=self.RequestSession

 request.ExpectedAccount=expectedAccount or self.AccountToken

 -- These read requests are answered by a snapshot, not a request acknowledgement.
 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"then
  if pendingCount>=64 and oldestId then self.Pending[oldestId]=nil end
  self.Pending[self.NextId]=now
 end
 self.Remote:FireServer(request)

 return true,"Order sent to exchange.","Orders",self.NextId

end

function Session:Subscribe(key,tf)

 self.Contract=key self.Timeframe=tf self.SubscribedAt=os.clock() self:Send("Subscribe",{Contract=key,Timeframe=tf})

end

function Session:Candles(key,tf) return self.Cache[key..":"..tf] or {} end

function Session:Pnl(p) return p.Unrealized or 0 end

function Session:Summary() return self.SummaryData end

function Session:Working() return self.Orders end

function Session:Cancel(id,protection) return self:Send("Cancel",{OrderId=id,Protection=protection}) end

function Session:AmendProtection(key,id,field,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:AmendOrder(key,id,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendOrder",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:Close(key) return self:Send("Close",{Contract=key}) end

-- Lifecycle requests always include ExpectedAccount through Send.

function Session:Start() return self:Send("Start",{}) end

function Session:Restart() return self:Send("Restart",{}) end
function Session:ResetAccount(expectedAccount) return self:Send("ResetAccount",{},expectedAccount) end
function Session:AcknowledgeAway(id) return self:Send("AcknowledgeAway",{SummaryId=id})end
function Session:CreateProtection(key,id,field,price,quantity)
 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=quantity})
end

function Session:Flag(stage) return self:Send("Flag",{Stage=stage}) end

function Session:RefreshStats() return self:Send("Stats",{}) end

-- orderType: "Market", "Limit" (price = limit) or "Stop" (price = stop trigger; an entry that becomes a

-- market order when a trade reaches it). The server validates every field.

function Session:Place(key,direction,quantity,orderType,price,stopDollars,targetDollars,execution)

 if not self.Ready then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 return self:Send("Place",{Contract=key,Direction=direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=orderType,Execution=execution or "Immediate",

  Price=(orderType=="Limit" or orderType=="Stop") and price or nil,StopDollars=stopDollars,TargetDollars=targetDollars})

end

-- Largest order the exchange currently accepts for this instrument and side (nil until the first packet).

function Session:MaxOrder(key,direction)

 local c=self.Capacity and self.Capacity[key]

 return c and (direction>0 and c.Buy or c.Sell) or nil

end

function Session:Destroy()

 if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect() end self.Changed:Destroy() self.Replies:Destroy() self.Events:Destroy()

end

return Market

function Mascot:SetMood(mood)

-- Human-entered decimal numbers; field-specific bounds and rounding stay with the caller.
local NumberInput={}
local multipliers={k=1e3,m=1e6,b=1e9,t=1e12}
function NumberInput.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string"then return nil end
 local raw=text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
 if raw:sub(1,1)=="$"then raw=raw:sub(2):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")end
 local amount,suffix=raw:match("^(.-)%s*([kKmMbBtT])$")
 amount=amount or raw
 local sign,whole,decimal=amount:match("^([+-]?)([%d,]*)%.?(%d*)$")
 if not whole or whole==""and decimal==""then return nil end
 if whole:find(",",1,true)then
  local first,rest=whole:match("^(%d%d?%d?)(,.*)$")
  if not first or rest:gsub(",%d%d%d","")~=""then return nil end
 end
 local value=tonumber(sign..whole:gsub(",","").."."..decimal)
 if not value then return nil end
 value*=suffix and multipliers[suffix:lower()]or 1
 if value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return nil end
 return value
end
return NumberInput

-- Shared definitions and pure presentation. Only FundedAccounts awards progression.
local Config=require(script.Parent.ProgressionConfig)
local Rules={}
function Rules.Rank(id)
 for index,r in ipairs(Config.Ranks) do if r.Id==id then return r,index end end
 return nil
end
function Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins)
 return math.max(0,m.Kind=="Trades" and trades or m.Kind=="Wins" and wins or net)
end
function Rules.Qualifies(r,net,trades,wins)
 return trades>=r.Trades and wins>=r.Wins and (r.Profit==0 or net+1e-6>=r.Profit)
end
function Rules.Obsolete(title)
 return title:match("^Legacy .*Trader$")~=nil or title:match("^%d+K Trader$")~=nil or title=="Legacy Top Tier Complete"
end
function Rules.Normalize(p,at)
 if p.ProgressionVersion==Config.ProgressionVersion then return false end
 p.LegacyProgression=p.LegacyProgression or {Titles=table.clone(p.Titles or {}),Rank=p.Rank}
 p.Awards=p.Awards or {};p.AlumniTitles=p.AlumniTitles or {}
 local known={};for _,m in ipairs(Config.Milestones)do known[m.Title]=m; if m.OldTitle then known[m.OldTitle]=m end end
 local seen={};for _,title in ipairs(p.AlumniTitles)do seen[title]=true end
 for _,title in ipairs(p.Titles or {})do

-- Smooth, transparent native rings. Circular strokes keep the inner/outer curves concentric;
-- a radial half-plane cuts each coloured prefix at the exact statistical angle.
-- No uploaded textures, pixel wedges, tessellation seams, or opaque centre masks.
local Charts={}
function Charts.Draw(ctx,parent,name,cx,cy,radius,thickness,win,loss,half,colors)
 local container=ctx.frame(parent,name,cx-radius-thickness/2-2,cy-radius-thickness/2-2,
  radius*2+thickness+4,(half and radius or radius*2)+thickness+4,colors.Neutral,4)
 container.BackgroundTransparency=1
 local margin=thickness/2+2 local center=radius+margin
 win=win and math.clamp(win,0,1) or nil
 loss=win and math.clamp(loss or 0,0,1-win) or 0
 container:SetAttribute("Renderer","CircularStroke")
 container:SetAttribute("WinShare",win)
 container:SetAttribute("LossShare",loss)
 container:SetAttribute("NeutralShare",win and math.max(0,1-win-loss) or 1)
 container:SetAttribute("Thickness",thickness)
 container:SetAttribute("ArcDegrees",half and 180 or 360)
 local function layer(label,color,share,z,side)
  if share<=0 then return end
  local clip=ctx.frame(container,label,side=="Right"and center or 0,0,
   half and center*2 or center,half and center or center*2,color,z)
  clip.BackgroundTransparency=1 clip.ClipsDescendants=true
  local disk=ctx.frame(clip,"Circle",side=="Right"and -radius or margin,margin,radius*2,radius*2,color,z)
  disk.BackgroundTransparency=1 ctx.round(disk,radius)
  local stroke=ctx.stroke(disk,color) stroke.Thickness=thickness stroke.BorderStrokePosition=Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Center
  if share<1 then
   local rotation=half and 90-share*180 or (side=="Right"and share*180 or 180+share*180)
   local cut=Instance.new("UIGradient") cut.Name="RadialBoundary" cut.Rotation=rotation
   local first,last=half and 1 or 0,half and 0 or 1
   cut.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,first),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4995,first),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5005,last),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,last)})
   cut.Parent=stroke
  end
 end
 local function prefix(label,color,share,z)
  if half then layer(label,color,share,z,"Top")
  else
   layer(label.."Right",color,math.clamp(share*2,0,1),z,"Right")
   layer(label.."Left",color,math.clamp(share*2-1,0,1),z,"Left")
  end
 end
 prefix("Track",colors.Neutral,1,4)
 if win then
  prefix("Loss",colors.Loss,win+loss,5)
  prefix("Win",colors.Win,win,6)
 end
 return container
end
return Charts

local function ratio(v,noLoss) return noLoss and "∞" or v~=nil and string.format("%.2f",v) or "—" end

-- Consumes the same aggregate fields as src/StatsView.luau.
-- Ratios are supplied by the exchange; this adapter only formats them.
function Kit.FromAggregate(a)
 a=a or {}
 local complete=not a.Partial and not a.CountUnknown
 local noLoss=complete and a.NoLosses
 local net=a.Net or 0
 local daily=a.DailyComplete==true
 local best= daily and net>0 and a.BestDayShare or nil
 local unknown="Earlier breakdown unavailable"
 return {
  {Key="Total",Title="Realized profit",Value=money(net),Caption="Current account · closed trades",Color=net<0 and T.Loss or net>0 and T.Gain or T.Text,
   Help="Net profit or loss from closed trades in this account. Excludes open profit and starting money."},
  {Key="Trade",Title="Trade win rate",Value=complete and percent(a.WinRate) or "—",
   Caption=complete and string.format("%d wins / %d trades · %d even",a.Wins or 0,a.Trades or 0,a.Even or 0) or unknown,
   Bars=complete and {a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable closed trades divided by all closed trades, including break-even trades. Each closing fill counts as one trade."},
  {Key="Average",Title="Avg win / avg loss",Value=complete and ratio(a.WinLossRatio,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No losing trades" or "Average win ÷ absolute average loss",
   Bars=complete and {a.AvgWin or 0,a.AvgLoss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Avg win",money(a.AvgWin)},{"Avg loss",a.AvgLoss and money(-a.AvgLoss) or "—"}} or nil,
   Help="Average profit per winning trade divided by average loss per losing trade. ∞ means wins with no losses."},
  {Key="Day",Title="Day win rate",Value=daily and percent(a.DayWinRate) or "—",
   Caption=daily and string.format("%d profitable / %d UTC days",a.WinningDays or 0,a.DayCount or 0) or "Needs complete trade dates",
   Bars=daily and {a.WinningDays or 0,math.max(0,(a.DayCount or 0)-(a.WinningDays or 0)),0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable days divided by days with closed trades in this account. Days run from midnight to midnight UTC. Days without trades do not count."},
  {Key="Factor",Title="Profit factor",Value=complete and ratio(a.ProfitFactor,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No gross losses" or "Gross wins ÷ absolute gross losses",
   Bars=complete and {a.Gains or 0,a.Loss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Gross wins",money(a.Gains or 0)},{"Gross losses",money(-(a.Loss or 0))}} or nil,
   Help="Total profits divided by total losses from closed trades. The bar compares those two totals."},
  {Key="Best",Title="Best day share",Value=percent(best),
   Caption=not daily and "Needs complete trade dates" or net<=0 and "Needs realized profit above $0" or "Best daily net profit ÷ realized profit",
   Help="Your best day's net profit divided by this account's realized profit. Losses on other days can push this above 100%. Needs complete trade dates and realized profit above $0."},
 }
end

local function setText(root,name,value)
 local o=root:FindFirstChild(name,true)
 if o then o.Text=tostring(value)end
 return o
end
local function setBar(root,name,values,complete)
 local bar=root:FindFirstChild(name,true);if not bar then return end
 for _,v in ipairs(bar:GetChildren())do if v:IsA("Frame")then v:Destroy()end end
 local total=0;for _,v in ipairs(values)do total+=math.max(0,v)end
 if not complete or total==0 then return end
 local x=0;local names={"Win","Loss","Even"};local tops={"#29F9BA","#FF85B9","#85A8DB"};local bottoms={"#0AD59E","#F65096","#5977A6"}
 for i,v in ipairs(values)do
  if v>0 then
   local node={kind="Frame",name=name..names[i],x=x*bar.Size.X.Offset,y=0,w=v/total*bar.Size.X.Offset,h=21,top=tops[i],bottom=bottoms[i],radius=10}
   local part=build(node,bar)
   part.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x,0);part.Size=UDim2.fromScale(v/total,1)
   x+=v/total
  end
 end
end
function Kit.ApplyAggregate(root,a)
 local metrics=Kit.FromAggregate(a)
 local names={"Total","Trade","Average","Day","Factor","Best"}
 for i,m in ipairs(metrics)do
  local label=setText(root,names[i].."Value",m.Value)
  if label and i==1 then label.TextColor3=m.Color end
 end
 setText(root,"TradeCaption",string.format("%d wins / %d trades",a.Wins or 0,a.Trades or 0))
 local complete=not a.Partial and not a.CountUnknown
 if not complete then setText(root,"TradeCaption","Earlier breakdown unavailable")end
 for _,pair in ipairs({{"Average",3},{"Factor",5}})do
  local details=metrics[pair[2]].Details
  setText(root,pair[1].."Detail0",details and details[1][2]or"—")
  setText(root,pair[1].."Detail1",details and details[2][2]or"—")
 end
 setText(root,"AttemptsLabel",tostring(a.Attempts or 0).." attempts")
 setText(root,"ClosedTradesLabel",tostring(a.Trades or 0).." closed trades")
 setText(root,"CoverageCopy",not complete and "Trade breakdown incomplete.\nRatios are unavailable."
  or not a.DailyComplete and "Some trades have no dates.\nDaily stats are unavailable."
  or(a.Net or 0)<=0 and "UTC days. Best-day share needs\nrealized profit above $0."
  or "Current account only.\nTrading days use UTC.")
 setBar(root,"TradeBar",{a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0},complete)
 setBar(root,"AverageBar",{a.AvgWin or 0,a.AvgLoss or 0},complete)
 setBar(root,"FactorBar",{a.Gains or 0,a.Loss or 0},complete)
 return metrics
end
-- Root is the Stats viewport. Popups account for inherited scaling and stay inside it.
function Kit.BindDropdown(root,trigger,items,selectedKey,onChoose)
 local connections={}
 local opened,overlay,selected=false,nil,selectedKey
 local previousSelection

  for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==selected then setText(trigger,trigger.Name.."Label",item.Label);return end end
 end
 function api:Close()
  opened=false

  if previousSelection and previousSelection.Parent then GuiService.SelectedObject=previousSelection end
  previousSelection=nil
 end
 function api:Set(key)selected=key;caption()end
 function api:Choose(key)
  local exists=false;for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==key then exists=true end end
  if not exists then return false end
  local accepted=not onChoose or onChoose(key)~=false
  if accepted then self:Set(key)end

 end
 function api:Open()
  if self:IsOpen() then self:Close();return end
  -- One menu at a time in the assembled canvas.
  local old=root:FindFirstChild("DropdownOverlay");if old then old:Destroy()end
  opened=true;previousSelection=root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")and GuiService.SelectedObject or nil
  overlay=make("TextButton","DropdownOverlay",root,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=100,Selectable=false})
  overlay.Activated:Connect(function()self:Close()end)
  local scale=root.Size.X.Offset>0 and root.AbsoluteSize.X/root.Size.X.Offset or 1
  scale=math.max(.01,scale)
  local x=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.X-root.AbsolutePosition.X)/scale
  local y=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.Y-root.AbsolutePosition.Y+trigger.AbsoluteSize.Y)/scale+8
  local w=trigger.AbsoluteSize.X/scale
  if w<1 then w=trigger.Size.X.Offset end
  w=math.min(w,math.max(1,root.Size.X.Offset-16))
  local h=math.min(#items*50+12,312,math.max(56,root.Size.Y.Offset-16))
  x=math.clamp(x,8,math.max(8,root.Size.X.Offset-w-8))
  if y+h>root.Size.Y.Offset-8 then y=math.max(8,y-h-trigger.Size.Y.Offset-16)end
  y=math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,root.Size.Y.Offset-h-8))
  local menu=build({kind="Frame",name="DropdownMenu",x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,top="#0A3274",bottom="#031B4E",edge="#487DDB",stroke=2,radius=12},overlay);menu.ZIndex=101
  local list=make("ScrollingFrame","Options",menu,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#items*50),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ZIndex=102})
  for i,item in ipairs(items)do
   local row=build({kind="TextButton",name="Option"..i,x=0,y=(i-1)*50,w=w-12,h=46,
    top=item.Key==selected and "#863AFF"or"#0A3274",bottom=item.Key==selected and"#491BCD"or"#062250",radius=8,
    text="   "..item.Label,size=18},list);row.ZIndex=103
   row:SetAttribute("Key",item.Key)
   -- A gradient on a TextButton also tints its own text. Keep the label on an un-tinted child.
   row.Text=""
   local label=build({kind="TextLabel",name="Label",x=12,y=0,w=w-36,h=46,text=item.Label,size=w<300 and 14 or 18},row)
   label.ZIndex=104;label.TextScaled=true
   make("UITextSizeConstraint","TypeSize",label,{MinTextSize=10,MaxTextSize=label.TextSize})
   row.Activated:Connect(function()self:Choose(item.Key)end)
   if item.Key==selected and UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and row:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")then GuiService.SelectedObject=row end
  end
 end
 function api:IsOpen()return opened and overlay~=nil and overlay.Parent~=nil end
 function api:Get()return selected end
 function api:Destroy()self:Close();for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end
 table.insert(connections,trigger.Activated:Connect(function()api:Open()end))
 table.insert(connections,UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if api:IsOpen() and (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)then api:Close()end

 caption();return api
end

-- Stats page: trading performance for the current account. Every number is computed and
-- persisted by the server (TradeStats / FundedAccounts:Stats). Only Stats content is drawn here, using
-- individual editable components from 06 - Polished Stats Pieces. TerminalUI owns all shared navigation.
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local Kit=require(script.Parent.StatsPieces)
local View={}
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local TOP=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
local AtEnd=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local BODY=Enum.Font.GothamMedium

local function commas(n)
 local raw=tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n or 0)+0.5))
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..raw:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
end
local function plural(n,word) return commas(n).." "..word..(n==1 and "" or "s") end
local function pct(rate) return rate and string.format("%.1f%%",rate*100) or "—" end
local function measure(value,size,width,font) return math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(value,size,font or FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(1,width-4),10000)).Y*1.12)+8 end
View.Commas=commas

-- Always use the current account, including when an older UI state selected another period.
-- Do not display a previous account's cached packet while a restart is loading.
function View.Resolve(data,state,portfolio)
 local list=data and data.Scopes or {};local scope=list[1]
 state.StatsScope="ALL";state.StatsPeriod="Current"
 local agg=scope and scope.Current
 if data and portfolio and data.Run and portfolio.Run and data.Run~=portfolio.Run then agg=nil end
 return scope,agg,"Current",list
end
function View.OpenFor(scope,pf,agg)return pf and pf.Open or agg and agg.Open or 0 end
function View.Describe(scope,agg,period)
 return "Current account only. Starting money and open profit are excluded."
end
function View.Coverage(agg,signed)
 if agg.Partial then
  local count=agg.UntrackedTrades>0 and (" across "..(agg.CountUnknown and "at least " or "")..plural(agg.UntrackedTrades,"earlier trade"))
   or (agg.CountUnknown and " across an unknown number of earlier trades" or "")
  return "Results without a full breakdown (net "..signed(agg.UntrackedNet)..count..") are included in realized profit. Ratios need a complete trade breakdown."
 elseif agg.Recovered then
  return "Includes earlier trades rebuilt from your saved trade history."
 end
 return nil
end

 -- routed into the chart pool) or stop later frames. Errors are reported once and the chart recovers.

 local function chart(x,y,w,h,mobile,compact,short,updating)
  local ok,err=xpcall(chartView.Paint,debug.traceback,chartView,x,y,w,h,mobile,compact,updating)
  if ok then
   if chartFault then chartFault=nil;root:SetAttribute("ChartError",nil)end
   -- Phones: a slimmer rim leaves more of the screen to candles.
   local p=mobile and not updating and canvas:FindFirstChild("Chart")
   if p and p:FindFirstChild("Border")then p.Border.Thickness=2;p.Corners.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)end
   return
  end
  painting=nil;chartView:Reset()
  local message=tostring(err)
  if message~=chartFault or os.clock()-faultAt>10 then warn("[Get Funded!] Chart paint failed; recovering: "..message)end
  chartFault=message;faultAt=os.clock();root:SetAttribute("ChartError",message:sub(1,200))

  task.delay(updating and 1 or 0,function()if alive then fullRefreshPending=false;refresh()end end)
 end

 local function numericStepper(p,name,x,y,w,value,step,minimum,maximum,setter,formatter,enabled,direct,onExceeded)
  local height=direct and 52 or 44;local bw=direct and 0 or math.min(44,math.floor((w-32)/2))
  local shell=frame(p,name,x,y,w,height,C.Bg,p.ZIndex);round(shell,10);stroke(shell,Color3.fromRGB(26,99,212)).Thickness=2
  local current=value
  local function upperBound()return type(maximum)=="function"and maximum()or maximum end
  local field=make("TextBox","Value",shell,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(bw,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w-bw*2,height),BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Text=formatter and formatter(value)or tostring(value),TextColor3=enabled==false and C.Muted or C.Text,Font=B,TextSize=24,TextScaled=true,TextStrokeColor3=SC.Ink,TextStrokeTransparency=.55,
   ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextEditable=enabled~=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=shell.ZIndex+1})
  make("UITextSizeConstraint","TextSize",field,{MinTextSize=10,MaxTextSize=24})
  local function display(n)return formatter and formatter(n)or tostring(n)end

   if enabled==false then return true end

   if onExceeded and n and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge and n>maximum then
    current=maximum;field.Text=display(current);setter(current);s.Error=nil;onExceeded(maximum);return false
   end
   if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge or n<lower or n>maximum or(step==1 and n%1~=0)then
    s.Error=step==1 and(maximum<minimum and "No contracts available for this order."or "Enter a whole number from "..minimum.." to "..maximum..".")or("Enter an amount from "..display(lower).." to "..display(maximum)..". You can use k, m, b or t.")
    field.Text=display(current);fail(s.Error);if fx then fx:Shake(shell)end;return false
   end

  end

   if not commit()then return end
   -- Keep the clicked control alive when an input loses focus to a button.

shared/TradeProtection.luau:
-- One dollar-to-tick calculation shared by the ticket and authoritative exchange.
-- Dollars are the estimated TOTAL for the requested quantity, excluding slippage.
local Protection={}
Protection.MaxDollars=1e9
Protection.Defaults={StopOn=true,TargetOn=true,StopDollars=500,TargetDollars=1500}
-- Preferences are dollar intentions, independent of the current instrument/quantity.
-- The ticket, saved preferences and exchange share the same dollar ceiling.
function Protection.Preferences(value)
 local result={}
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v;if type(value)=="table"then v=value[key]end
  if type(default)=="boolean"then
   if type(v)=="boolean"then result[key]=v else result[key]=default end
  else result[key]=type(v)=="number"and v==v and v>=.01 and v<=Protection.MaxDollars and v or default end
 end
 return result
end
function Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return nil end
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v=value[key]
  if type(v)~=type(default)then return nil end
  if type(v)=="number"and(v~=v or v<.01 or v>Protection.MaxDollars)then return nil end
 end
 return Protection.Preferences(value)
end
function Protection.SamePreferences(a,b)
 for key in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do if a[key]~=b[key]then return false end end
 return true
end
function Protection.MaximumTicks(spec,quantity)
 -- Include the nearest tick at the dollar ceiling, including the one-tick minimum.
 return math.max(1,math.round(Protection.MaxDollars/(spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity)))
end
function Protection.Resolve(spec,quantity,dollars,entry,direction,field)
 if type(quantity)~="number" or quantity<1 or quantity%1~=0 then return nil,"Enter a whole number of contracts, starting at 1." end
 local unit=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 if type(dollars)~="number" or dollars~=dollars or dollars<.01 or dollars>Protection.MaxDollars then
  return nil,"Enter a protection amount from $0.01 to $1,000,000,000."
 end
 local ticks=math.max(1,math.round(dollars/unit))
 local result={Ticks=ticks,Dollars=ticks*unit,TickDollars=unit}
 if entry then
  local side=(field=="Stop" and -1 or 1)*(direction or 1)
  result.Price=math.round((entry+side*ticks*spec.Tick)/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick
  result.Dollars=math.abs(result.Price-entry)*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 end
 return result
end
return Protection

-- Interaction feedback for the Get Funded! GUI: hover/press/release tweens, selection pops, popup
-- transitions and a small palette of UI sounds. Presentation only; it never changes trading state.
-- The GUI is rebuilt on refresh, so per-control state (hover, last press, selection) is remembered by
-- the control's path. A rebuilt control continues its animation instead of snapping or replaying it.
-- Calm mode (reduced motion) keeps colour and sheen feedback but drops scaling, bouncing and shaking.
